projects.ov: Tomorrow Commercial Tower is a commercial development by Tomorrow World Properties, a subsidiary of the Tomorrow World Group. The building combines ground-floor retail units with office floors above, following a typical floor plan repeated across upper levels, with several office layout configurations available to suit different tenant sizes. The tower is designed with an all-glass curtain wall façade and positioned as a business platform for companies ranging from startups to established corporations.

Tomorrow 166 project is a stunning residential development located on Dubai Islands, designed to offer an elevated and peaceful lifestyle within a vibrant waterfront setting. It features a variety of thoughtfully designed units, including 1, 2, 2.5, and 3-bedroom apartments, all crafted to harmonize with nature while offering expansive interiors and private outdoor spaces. The architectural concept, inspired by the form and efficiency of a dragonfly, blends organic curves with modern elegance, creating a building that stands out while remaining in harmony with its lush surroundings.

Azure by Lapis rises on Al Marjan Island as a refined waterfront landmark shaped around tranquility, nature, and architectural elegance. Its curved silhouette, expansive terraces, and flowing lines echo the meeting point of sea and sky, creating a serene visual identity that reflects the calm rhythm of coastal living. The tower stands within one of Ras Al Khaimah’s most prestigious island destinations, surrounded by beaches, promenades, and resort landscapes.

Orvessa Residences is a refined residential development by BNW Developments, located in the well-established community of Al Furjan. The project is defined by contemporary architecture with elegant wave-inspired balconies, lush greenery, and a balanced podium-and-rooftop composition that creates a strong visual identity. Designed to blend tranquility with urban energy, Orvessa offers a boutique residential experience that combines thoughtful design, comfort, and a sophisticated lifestyle setting within one of Dubai’s most family-oriented districts.

Aqua Maya is a boutique coastal residential development by BNW Developments, located on Al Marjan Island. Designed as a serene island address, the project blends contemporary architecture with a calm, nature-led lifestyle, drawing inspiration from the rhythm of the sea and the balance of natural elements. The building’s sculptural, balcony-led façade mirrors soft ocean waves, while the landscaped podium and open layouts create a seamless connection between indoor spaces and the surrounding environment.

La Perla by BNW Developments is a refined residential development set along the shoreline of Al Marjan Island, conceived as an expression of timeless island living. The project’s architecture draws inspiration from the natural rhythm of the coast, with fluid lines, layered terraces, and open perspectives that blur the boundary between indoor spaces and the surrounding seascape. Designed as a low-density, elegant address, La Perla offers a calm, resort-like atmosphere shaped by light, water, and thoughtful proportions.

projects.n: Tonino Lamborghini Residences by BNW Developments
projects.ov: Tonino Lamborghini Residences by BNW Developments rises on Al Marjan Island as a bold architectural statement where Italian sophistication meets the raw beauty of the coast. Inspired by the Tonino Lamborghini ethos of elegance, innovation, and uncompromising style, the project translates the rhythm of waves and dunes into cascading terraces, sky gardens, and sculpted forms. Natural textures, refined metallic accents, and carefully proportioned balconies create a harmonious balance between privacy, openness, and uninterrupted sea views, forming a timeless coastal landmark.

Ramada Residences by Wyndham is a contemporary residential development designed around the concept of “Architecture of Belonging,” where modern design meets a strong sense of community. The project features clean architectural lines and balanced geometry, creating a refined urban presence while maintaining a sense of privacy and comfort. Offering thoughtfully designed one- and two-bedroom apartments, each residence is shaped by open layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and an abundance of natural light, delivering a harmonious living environment that blends functionality with understated elegance.

Acacia by BNW Developments is a refined waterfront residence set on the prestigious shores of Al Marjan Island, where island serenity meets contemporary architectural elegance. The project offers a curated selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, along with exclusive 4-bedroom penthouses, all designed with flowing layouts, expansive glazing, and seamless indoor-outdoor connection. Its sophisticated design embraces panoramic sea views, natural light, and open living concepts, creating a calm yet stylish environment shaped by modern coastal living.

Taj Wellington Mews is a refined waterfront development on Al Marjan Island, where heritage-inspired elegance meets contemporary architectural expression. Defined by two interconnected towers rising above a circular podium, the design creates a distinctive silhouette shaped by fluid lines and thoughtfully integrated balconies. The architecture balances grandeur with subtlety, while expansive layouts and panoramic glazing invite natural light and frame serene coastal views, delivering a living experience rooted in sophistication and calm.

Aquino at Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah is a refined waterfront residential development that redefines coastal living through a balance of elegance, tranquility, and contemporary design. Set along the shores of the Arabian Gulf, this low-rise community offers a peaceful retreat where architecture and nature exist in perfect harmony, creating an atmosphere of understated luxury and calm.

Pelagia is a refined waterfront development on Al Marjan Island, where contemporary architecture is shaped by the fluid elegance of the sea. The project offers a curated selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, alongside exclusive 4-bedroom penthouses with private pools. Its design is defined by sweeping, wave-inspired balconies and graceful lines that create a sense of movement, while expansive glazing and open layouts fill each residence with natural light, delivering a calm and sophisticated coastal living experience.

Radisson Blu Hotel & Residences by BNW Developments is a landmark hospitality-led destination designed to redefine serviced living with global standards and contemporary elegance. The project is thoughtfully divided into a Residential Tower offering studio, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments, and a Hotel Tower featuring studio and 1 bedroom apartments, creating a perfect balance between private living and hotel-style comfort. Inspired by the legacy of Radisson Blu, it delivers a dynamic environment where design, service, and lifestyle come together seamlessly.

Carmel Residence is a modern boutique residential complex by Uniestate Properties. Featuring elegant architecture and a stylish facade, the complex offers an exceptional selection of studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments designed for modern living. Every home reflects a perfect balance of privacy, comfort, and style, making it ideal for both individuals and families. The residence radiates sophistication and resort-style living, with contemporary architecture, beautiful landscaping, and inviting spaces that blend luxury, community, and convenience in perfect harmony.

Playa Viva is an exclusive coastal community, offering an elevated lifestyle where the gentle rhythm of the sea meets contemporary luxury. Featuring three interconnected residential towers with sleek architecture and expansive glass façades, the development is designed to maximize panoramic ocean views and natural light. This waterfront retreat stands as a symbol of refined living, where every detail is curated to reflect elegance, tranquility, and effortless comfort.

Divine Elements is a masterpiece of modern architecture, defined by its sleek glass façade, clean geometric lines, and an elegant sense of balance shaped by natural light. This stunning development offers an array of residences, including studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom homes, each boasting spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and private balconies that seamlessly blend indoor comfort with outdoor openness.

Divine Al Barari Residences is a masterpiece of residential development, where residents can live surrounded by lush greenery, shimmering water features, and warm evening light. This exceptional project offers a thoughtfully curated range of residences, including Studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, two-bedroom with Study, two-bedroom with Maid's Room, three-bedroom, and three-bedroom Duplex Penthouses, each designed to feel like a private retreat.

Eywa Way of Water is an ultra-luxury residential masterpiece that redefines wellness-driven living in Dubai. The development offers an exclusive collection of 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, alongside expansive duplexes and signature penthouses designed by Zane Tetere-Sulce of OAD. Its architecture reflects a refined European approach to contemporary design, combining sculptural form, natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor connections. Each residence is carefully planned with generous proportions, panoramic views, and private lift access, creating a sense of elevated privacy and understated elegance.

Eywa stands as a visionary residential creation, masterfully blending architecture, nature, and symbolism into a breathtaking living entity. Drawing inspiration from the majestic Banyan tree and the ethereal floating landscapes of Avatar's Hallelujah Mountains, this development embodies a profound sense of growth, balance, and timeless wisdom, as evidenced by its organic form, branching silhouettes, and lush, layered greenery. The result is a sculptural landmark that not only feels deeply connected to nature but also proudly asserts its futuristic persona.

Sorrento emerges as an exceptional residential masterpiece, developed by DAMAC, and showcases elegant curves coupled with balanced proportions that lend each home a modern yet warm ambience. The offering comprises thoughtfully planned studio and one‑bedroom apartments where open‑plan layouts maximize space and light. Architectural intent focuses on bright interiors and soothing natural tones, creating residences that feel effortlessly refined.

Iris Park is a boutique collection of townhouses developed by AB Properties, located in Jumeirah Village Circle. The project offers a harmonious residential concept where indoor and outdoor living are seamlessly integrated. Comprising three-storey townhouses with four-bedroom layouts, the development is defined by its classic architectural language, featuring soft beige facades, Mediterranean-inspired rooflines, and elegant proportions that create a calm and cohesive streetscape.

Greenfield Living is a boutique residential development designed around the concept of urban elegance and natural harmony, the project blends contemporary architecture with serene green surroundings. The development reflects Dubai’s forward-looking vision, combining smart infrastructure, connectivity, and community-focused living. The project features a G + 4floors residential building comprising 52 thoughtfully designed units, including 1- and 2-bedroom apartments.

Amaris Tower, presented by Synergy Properties, stands as a masterpiece of contemporary residential design, showcasing elegant architecture, functional layouts, and high-quality finishes that come together to create a profoundly comfortable and sophisticated residential environment. This exemplary development rises above a ground level and three basement parking levels, presenting a carefully curated selection of one and two-bedroom apartments featuring remarkably efficient layouts, exquisite finishes, and integrated kitchen appliances designed to maximise natural light, comfort, and practicality.

SOL Bay is an opulent residential and commercial tower by SOL Properties. Rising to seventeen storeys, this latest development offers studios and one and two-bedroom apartments with direct views of the Burj Khalifa, creating an unparalleled luxury living experience. The building features high-end retail outlets and restaurants on the ground floor, offices on the podium levels, and residential apartments above, offering a seamless blend of urban living and convenience.

Enaya Residences is a masterful creation where luxury and comfort converge in perfect harmony, boasting exquisitely crafted apartments with one and two-bedroom layouts, each adorned with an array of luxurious amenities and finishes that epitomize refinement and sophistication. As residents step into their Enaya Residence, they are enveloped in a sense of warmth and comfort, with every detail meticulously designed to enhance their living experience, from the spacious living areas to the tranquil bedrooms.

Ghadeer is a nature-inspired residential building nestled within the heart of Expo Valley Views, where architecture gently blends with the surrounding landscape. Designed to follow the natural contours of the valley, Ghadeer rises organically from the terrain, opening toward light, greenery, and expansive views, and offers a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences arranged across multiple floors. A sense of calm, balance, and connection to nature defines the character of this residence, reflected in its soft architectural lines, earthy tones, and tranquil outdoor settings.

Canal One is designed by Killa architects renowned for creating timeless, transformative, adaptive yet resilient buildings and designs that are unique, innovative, embrace sustainability and are contextually inspired with a vision for shaping a brighter future. Their award-winning studio is committed to realizing notable and high-quality projects and is reputed of being highly creative with ideologies and design philosophies that are passionate about innovation, smart technologies and futuristic design and respectful to social and ecological sustainability, space making and urban realm.

Casa Canal by AHS Properties is an exclusive collection of luxury residences on the Dubai Water Canal, designed around the idea of villas in the sky. The building offers penthouses, sky villas, sky mansions and a sky palace, with expansive layouts, soaring ceilings, private pools, generous terraces and elegant double-height spaces. Living areas are set along the waterfront to capture sweeping views of the canal and the Downtown skyline through floor-to-ceiling curved glass windows.

Casa AHS by AHS Properties is an ultra-luxury residential landmark on the Dubai Water Canal, designed by Killa Design with interiors by HBA Residential. The building presents an exclusive collection of penthouses, sky villas, sky mansions and sky palaces, each conceived as a private home in the sky. Residences feature striking double-height ceilings, private infinity-edge pools, jacuzzis and expansive terraces with open views over the canal, Safa Park and the city skyline.

Volta is a premium residential development by DAMAC Properties, strategically located in the heart of Downtown Dubai. The project offers a collection of luxury 1 and 2-bedroom apartments alongside super luxury 3 and 4-bedroom residences, catering to a variety of lifestyle needs. Designed to combine contemporary architecture with urban sophistication, Volta provides residents with direct access to one of Dubai’s most dynamic districts while delivering a refined and modern living environment. The development also features a dedicated 13-storey podium parking structure, enhancing convenience and functionality within the community.

Valencia is a contemporary residential development within the DAMAC Lagoons District, conceived as a human-centric urban enclave where Mediterranean inspiration meets modern city living. The project is designed to offer residents an everyday escape without leaving Dubai, combining elegant architecture with water-focused landscapes, walkable retail, and vibrant communal spaces. Valencia forms part of a larger mixed-use destination that integrates homes, lifestyle amenities, and social hubs into a cohesive, thoughtfully planned environment.

Shoreline is a thoughtfully designed residential development that combines the comfort of private living with the atmosphere of a luxury resort. The project is centered around the concept of creating a permanent holiday lifestyle, where elegant architecture and carefully planned living spaces provide both relaxation and sophistication. Its design philosophy is heavily influenced by nature, particularly the fluidity of water and the organic beauty of sand dunes, resulting in a harmonious environment that blends contemporary architecture with natural inspiration.

Smart Heights by DAMAC is a distinguished commercial development designed to combine functionality, flexibility, and a premium business environment within one sophisticated destination. The project offers a selection of fitted and shell-and-core office spaces, complemented by retail units on the ground floor, providing an attractive mix of commercial opportunities for both businesses and investors.

Safa Two is an exclusive residential development by Damac Properties, representing the second chapter of the developer’s Nature of Luxury collection. Located on the edge of Safa Park in Dubai, the project offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments within a striking twin-tower complex. The architecture is defined by its distinctive diamond-inspired form and an extraordinary hanging garden that seamlessly connects the towers, creating a landmark design that is instantly recognizable on the city skyline. Grand entrance areas adorned with jewel and gemstone-inspired elements further reinforce the project's luxury identity.

Safa One de Grisogono is an iconic twin-tower residential development by Damac Properties, strategically located with panoramic views of Safa Park and the Dubai Canal. The project stands out for its distinctive architecture and design concept created in collaboration with the luxury jewelry brand de Grisogono, drawing inspiration from the brilliance and elegance of precious gemstones. The development introduces a new level of luxury living through its innovative design, premium residential spaces, and a unique rooftop ecosystem that creates a landmark presence within Dubai’s skyline.

Damac Properties presents Riverside, an exclusive residential townhouse development located in Dubai along the Dubai Water Canal. The project consists of contemporary 4 and 5 bedroom townhouses designed for modern urban living, combining waterfront positioning with strong connectivity to key city areas. The architecture emphasizes a low-rise, community-oriented layout within a master-planned environment, where each residence is designed to maximize views of the canal and surrounding skyline while maintaining privacy and comfort.

Piazza Roma by DAMAC is a striking development within DAMAC Lagoons, designed to bring together stylish living and modern business in one thoughtfully planned destination. The project offers premium office spaces, creating a versatile and sophisticated environment for working.

Golf Greens at Damac Hills is an exclusive residential development by DAMAC Properties, situated within the prestigious golf community of Damac Hills. The project offers a collection of elegantly designed apartments that combine contemporary architecture with panoramic views of the Trump International Golf Club Dubai. Floor-to-ceiling windows, spacious layouts, and a design philosophy focused on connecting indoor spaces with the surrounding greenery create a refined living environment that blends modern sophistication with the tranquility of nature.

Damac Riverside Views is a luxury waterfront residential community by DAMAC Properties. The development is designed to combine modern architecture with a nature-oriented lifestyle, creating a serene living environment centered around water features and landscaped surroundings. Characterized by sleek contemporary design, expansive glass façades, and panoramic views of the waterway and city skyline, the project offers a sophisticated residential experience that balances urban convenience with a sense of tranquility.

Damac Elo 2 and 3 is a contemporary residential development located within the vibrant DAMAC Hills 2 community in Dubai. The project consists of two modern 14-storey towers offering a collection of thoughtfully designed 1- and 2-bedroom apartments. Developed with a focus on modern urban living, the architecture combines clean contemporary lines with functional layouts that maximize space, comfort, and natural light. Positioned within a growing master-planned community, the development provides residents with a balanced lifestyle surrounded by green spaces, leisure facilities, and essential everyday conveniences.

Damac Elo is a contemporary residential development located within the master-planned DAMAC Hills 2 community in Dubai. The project consists of two modern 14-storey towers offering a collection of thoughtfully designed 1- and 2-bedroom apartments. Created to meet the needs of modern urban lifestyles, the development combines contemporary architecture, efficient layouts, and functional living spaces, providing residents with a comfortable environment within one of Dubai’s rapidly growing residential destinations.

Elegance Tower, branded by the illustrious Zuhair Murad, epitomizes luxury and sophistication, with its exquisite design and impeccable craftsmanship, reflecting the renowned fashion designer's undying quest for perfection. The tower's architecture is a masterpiece, boasting transformable floor plans, secret doors, and an array of lavish spaces, including a grand lobby with a soaring height, opulent bedrooms, and sumptuous bathrooms. The Elegance Tower's configuration is a testament to innovative design, featuring sprawling living areas, majestic master bedrooms, and extravagant amenities, all of which embody the essence of luxurious living.

Safa Gate is a landmark luxury residential tower designed to redefine contemporary urban living in Dubai. Characterized by its striking glass façade and elegant architectural form, the development creates a powerful presence on the city skyline while offering panoramic views of Dubai’s most iconic landmarks. The project features a curated collection of 1- and 2-bedroom apartments as well as exclusive 3- and 5-bedroom penthouses, combining innovative design, sophisticated architecture, and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living through sky gardens and elevated viewing spaces.

Damac Lagoons Views Phase 3 is a contemporary residential development set within the vibrant DAMAC Lagoons master community, inspired by the relaxed elegance of Mediterranean coastal destinations. The project is designed as part of a large-scale waterfront lifestyle concept, where architecture, water features, and landscaped surroundings come together to create a calm yet dynamic living environment. Positioned within a well-connected district, the development offers residents a sense of retreat while remaining closely linked to key areas of Dubai.

Damac Islands Phase 1 and 2 is a master-planned residential community inspired by some of the world’s most iconic tropical island destinations. The development features a mix of contemporary townhouses, luxury villas, and apartments designed to create a resort-style lifestyle environment centered around nature, water, and outdoor living. The project combines modern residential architecture with immersive island-inspired landscapes, offering residents a unique balance between tranquility and vibrant community living within a carefully planned setting.

Damac Islands Phase 2 presents an island‑inspired master community featuring luxury villas, twin villas and townhouses, each offering family‑sized layouts and dedicated maid’s rooms. The development clusters bear the names of tropical island destinations and follow an eco‑living philosophy that intertwines nature, wellness, adventure, social life and culture. Architectural highlights include cross‑ventilated floor plans, private gardens, rooftop terraces and, for the villas, secluded private pools that merge indoor comfort with outdoor freedom.

Damac Islands Phase 1 is a master-planned residential community inspired by some of the world’s most iconic tropical island destinations. The development features a mix of contemporary townhouses, luxury villas, and apartments designed to create a resort-style lifestyle environment centered around nature, water, and outdoor living. The project combines modern residential architecture with immersive island-inspired landscapes, offering residents a unique balance between tranquility and vibrant community living within a carefully planned setting.

projects.n: Damac Hills 2 - Hotel Edge by Rotana
projects.ov: Damac Hills 2 – Hotel Edge by Rotana is a modern hospitality development located within the growing DAMAC Hills 2 community in Dubai. Managed by the internationally recognized Edge by Rotana brand, the project is designed as a contemporary three-star hotel offering both hospitality services and investment opportunities. Positioned within a large master-planned residential community, the hotel combines modern accommodation with access to a wide variety of lifestyle and entertainment attractions, creating an appealing destination for both visitors and investors.

Damac District is a contemporary residential project located within the master community of Damac Hills in Dubai. The development offers a collection of thoughtfully designed 1- and 2-bedroom apartments that emphasize modern architecture, functional layouts, and strong visual connection to the surrounding landscaped greens, water features, and golf community environment. Positioned within an established and well-planned suburban district, the project benefits from a calm residential atmosphere while maintaining convenient access to major road networks and key destinations across Dubai.

Damac Casa is a luxury residential development by Damac Properties located in Dubai Media City, offering an exclusive urban lifestyle with panoramic views of Palm Jumeirah. The project is positioned in one of Dubai’s key media and business districts, combining a prime central location with scenic waterfront and skyline vistas.

Samana Business Park emerges as a visionary mixed-use development that is redefining the commercial landscape, seamlessly integrating modern workspaces, dynamic retail outlets, and leisure experiences in one thriving hub designed to foster growth, collaboration, and success. This exceptional destination by Samana is more than just a commercial development — it is a thriving ecosystem where cutting-edge architecture meets intelligently planned spaces, creating an environment where businesses can flourish and brands can expand.

Samana Portside emerges as a landmark development that signals long-horizon developer conviction, offering convertible one and two-bedroom homes with private pools in one of Dubai's most strategically positioned corridors. This exceptional project by Samana, a pioneer of residential plunge pools and one of the fifth-largest off-plan developers in Dubai, brings together turn-key solutions, premium international brands, and a quality ecosystem that spans design, engineering, construction, and community management.

Samana Greenfield 2 emerges as a new expression of calm, a refined residential development that brings together elegant architecture, resort-inspired living, and the kind of unhurried ease that feels increasingly rare in a city that never slows down. Building on the legacy of its predecessor, this exceptional community offers one and two-bedroom homes, each designed to adapt across life stages and hold long-term value, with flexible configurations and consistent quality that set a new standard for considered living.

Samana Waves is an ultra-high-end residential development by Samana Developers, located in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. The project comprises 213 luxury apartments across 26 floors, offering studios, one- and two-bedroom units, including duplex layouts with private pools. Designed to embody a resort-style lifestyle, the architecture features modern elegance, spacious interiors, panoramic elevators, and breathtaking views, creating a sophisticated and vibrant living environment for residents seeking comfort and exclusivity.

Samana South Haven is a beautifully considered residential community where purpose truly shapes every space, delivering a lifestyle that feels natural, comfortable, and complete. Designed around the way people actually live, it brings together thoughtful layouts, modern architecture, and resort-inspired landscaping to create homes that feel intentional at every turn. The collection offers a wonderful range of residences, from smart studios to spacious one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, ensuring there is a perfect home to suit every stage of life.

Green Field is a thoughtfully designed residential development that introduces a calm and refined approach to modern urban living. Located in Al Warsan, the project combines contemporary architecture, greenery, and flexible living spaces to create a balanced lifestyle environment. The development features innovative convertible residences that can transform from one-bedroom to two-bedroom homes and from two-bedroom to three-bedroom residences, offering homeowners the freedom to adapt their living space as their lifestyle evolves.

Samana Boulevard Heights is a refined residential development located in the one of Dubai’s most thoughtfully planned communities. Defined by symmetry, clean proportions, and refined details, the architecture reflects a quiet confidence, creating a visual harmony that stands out while blending seamlessly into its surroundings. More than a home, this is a sanctuary for families seeking balance, where every space blends sophistication with comfort, ensuring life's quiet moments are cherished as much as its biggest celebrations.

Samana Imperial Garden is a stunning residential development that redefines modern living with a touch of nature’s elegance. The project offers studios and one and two-bedroom apartments with private pools, thoughtfully designed with flexible layouts that can easily adapt to your lifestyle. Every detail, from sunlit balconies to spacious interiors, is crafted to create a sense of harmony, comfort, and timeless sophistication.

Ocean Crest is a refined coastal sanctuary where contemporary elegance meets the calming rhythm of the sea. Every space is thoughtfully designed to reflect harmony, with interiors inspired by soft textures, natural light, and a timeless color palette. The result is a home that offers not just style, but a deep sense of comfort and connection to its surroundings.

Samana Ocean Bay is a luxurious waterfront sanctuary, where modern architecture and the natural rhythm of the sea come together in perfect harmony. Inspired by the flow of waves and the openness of the sky, the building's curvilinear form, luminous façade, and coastal textures create a serene visual language that transforms everyday life into a resort-inspired experience. More than a residence, Ocean Bay is a retreat that captures the essence of island elegance in the heart of Dubai.

Samana Barari Heights is an elegant residential development that rises above the ordinary, blending architectural brilliance with tranquil surroundings in the heart of Majan. Its signature panoramic design offers breathtaking views of Dubai's skyline and the lush greenery of Al Barari, creating a world of timeless sophistication. From the moment residents enter, they are welcomed into a space where every detail is meticulously crafted for comfort, reflection, and elevated daily living.

Samana Parkville is a masterpiece of modern luxury, offering a selection of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, each featuring a private pool. Designed to intertwine elegance with timeless sophistication, every residence is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring that comfort and style are seamlessly blended. With sleek interiors, open spaces, and a serene ambiance, these homes provide an unmatched retreat from the ordinary.

Rome by Samana Developers is an exquisite residential project that perfectly reflects the beauty and eternal charm of the iconic Italian city, offering a contemporary urban lifestyle that seamlessly blends modern design with luxurious amenities. This meticulously crafted development embodies the breathtaking Roman elegance, taking residents on a surreal journey where every detail reflects a unique vision of sophisticated living. Meticulously designed for the discerning few, Rome offers the perfect balance between urban convenience and tranquility.

Samana Barari Lagoons is an exclusive residential development where well-being takes center stage, offering calm amidst the city hustle and a sanctuary for mental and physical rejuvenation. This stunning tribute to nature-inspired living seamlessly integrates with the natural environment, making every day transcend into something extraordinary. It's not just a residence; it's a haven where residents can reconnect with their true self and embrace a lifestyle that is truly desirable.

Samana Ibiza is a vibrant residential development located in the dynamic and bustling community, where every day becomes a joyful journey and life turns into a never-ending celebration. Designed for those who seek something extraordinary from each moment, this well-curated fusion of contemporary comfort and conventional charm features studios and one and two-bedroom apartments with private pools. The development offers a seamless blend of elegance and excitement, with every detail crafted to enhance a lifestyle of relaxation and vibrancy.

Samana Park Meadows is an exclusive retreat where modern architecture harmoniously blends with the beauty of nature. Set amidst a lush landscape, this thoughtfully curated development embodies a dedication to an environmentally conscious way of life. Clean lines, expansive glass facades, and high-quality materials reflect the contemporary design philosophy, while the thoughtful inclusion of traditional elements ensures the development blends seamlessly into its natural surroundings with smart home automation. Every detail is curated to create a haven where residents can truly relax and recharge.

Ocean Pearl 1 and 2 is a visionary residential project by Samana Developers, redefining the concept of waterfront luxury. This majestic ode to the sea features a collection of one, two, three, and four-bedroom residences, where the rhythm of nature flows and serenades the soul. Rising gracefully along the waterfront, the magnificent structure exemplifies the flawless union of modern luxury and natural beauty, with sleek, contemporary lines complemented by expansive glass windows that reflect the shimmering waters and vibrant hues of the sky.

Samana Skyros by Samana Developers is a stunning residential property that captures the essence of Greece in Dubai. This development is designed around the philosophy of living every day as if it were a holiday. From lush greenery to serene water features and private pools, every aspect of Samana Skyros is inspired by the tranquility and beauty of a tropical vacation, offering an escape from the stresses of everyday life.

IVY Gardens by Samana Developers presents a thoughtfully designed residential concept that blends contemporary architecture with a nature-inspired lifestyle. The project offers a collection of stylish apartments, created for those who value comfort, privacy, and a refined living environment. With its clean lines, modern façade, and seamless integration of greenery, the development stands out as a peaceful yet sophisticated urban retreat.

SOL Terra Gardens introduces an ultra‑luxury enclave of studios, one‑bedroom and two‑bedroom homes where verdant landscaping frames every living space. The design weaves abundant foliage with architecture, allowing daylight to filter through canopy‑like corridors and creating a sense of calm balance. A single‑loaded corridor concept ensures each residence enjoys unobstructed views of the surrounding greenery.

The Ritz-Carlton Residences is a legendary residential property, managed and serviced by one of the world's most distinguished hospitality brands. Rising above the serene Dubai Water Canal in the vibrant Business Bay district, this unparalleled development offers refinement and legendary service synonymous with The Ritz-Carlton name. Find solace in an environment that echoes your unique elevated style and sensibility, where every detail is crafted to exceed the expectations of the most discerning residents.

Park Residency is a contemporary residential development designed to offer a balanced lifestyle where modern architecture meets everyday functionality. Positioned within a well-connected urban setting, the project combines a calm residential atmosphere with easy access to key city destinations. The development features a collection of thoughtfully planned residences, including studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments. Each unit is designed to maximize space efficiency and natural light, creating interiors that feel open, practical, and comfortable for both end-users and investors.

Elevia Residences 3 is a distinguished residential development by Valores, a collaboration between one of the UAE's largest contractors and a leading property management expert, delivering a community that transforms real estate into a true living sanctuary. The project offers a thoughtfully curated collection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, all designed with sleek modern architecture and impeccable craftsmanship in the vibrant community.

The Views by Ardee Developments presents a contemporary residential offering framed by two elegant towers set atop a landscaped podium. The project comprises 616 residences, including studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, a three-bedroom Sky Collection, and townhouses, with architecture centred around two towers framed by a landscaped podium.

Cordoba at Bloom Living is a prestigious residential development offering exclusive design townhouses and villas within a Mediterranean-inspired community. This first phase of development presents a limited collection of stylish villas and townhouses in a gated community, inspired by the rustic vibes of the Mediterranean and named after the historic Andalusian city. The sophisticated collection presents a robust yet welcoming impression leading to vaulted doorways, bringing a fresh opportunity to free the mind and enrich the soul.

Bloom Living - Alhambra by Bloom Holding is a premium low-rise residential development inspired by Mediterranean Spanish architecture and designed for elegant modern living. It offers studios, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, a limited collection of 3-bedroom townhouses, and exclusive 4-bedroom penthouses, giving buyers an excellent choice of spacious homes.

RR Grand by Red Rose Properties is a thoughtfully designed residential project that brings together modern architecture, comfort, and everyday practicality in one elegant address. The development offers a curated selection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, with layouts carefully planned to maximise space, natural light, and functionality. With its refined contemporary design, balanced interiors, and strong attention to detail, RR Grand creates a lifestyle that feels sophisticated, welcoming, and effortlessly comfortable.

projects.n: Brabus Island Chapter Two - The Villas
projects.ov: Brabus Island Chapter Two - The Villas is a project designed for those who demand uncompromising luxury and individuality. Here, the world-renowned brand has translated its vision into architecture, turning each residence into a true masterpiece. The result is an environment of privacy and refined comfort that redefines contemporary living.  The architecture translates the Brabus automotive design philosophy into tailor-made residential form, featuring bold geometric facades, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and dark sculptural exteriors that create a distinctive and uncompromising visual identity.

Amra Residences stands as a benchmark in wellness-inspired living, seamlessly blending hospitality and holistic design within five elegant, sea-facing towers in Umm Al Quwain. Developed with a vision of balance and longevity, the project reflects an architectural philosophy rooted in tranquility, sustainability, and connection to nature. Each structure harmonizes with the surrounding lagoon and mangroves, creating an atmosphere where serenity and sophistication coexist.

The Residences by DIFC mark the first residential chapter within the visionary DIFC Zabeel District, redefining contemporary urban living in the very heart of Dubai. Comprising two architecturally striking towers with sculptural silhouettes, the project introduces a refined residential destination seamlessly integrated into a dynamic mixed-use environment. Designed as an extension of DIFC’s prestigious legacy, the development blends business, culture, lifestyle, and leisure into a cohesive urban ecosystem, offering residents iconic views across Dubai’s most prominent landmarks.

Mr. C Residences Downtown is a breathtakingly elegant branded residential development that embodies the revered Cipriani family's hospitality legacy, offering an extraordinary fusion of classic European flair and contemporary sophistication. Every residence within this stunning development is basked in an abundance of natural light and epitomizes Italian refinement, thus exuding an aura of effortless glamour and refined poise.

Hermina by Casagrand is an extraordinary seafront residence on Dubai Islands, offering an exclusive lifestyle where the vibrance of the city meets the calm of the coast. The project presents a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3.5 bedroom apartments along with opulent 3 and 4 bedroom penthouses, each thoughtfully designed to maximize space, privacy, and breathtaking views of the waterfront and Dubai skyline. Every residence features double-height balconies, abundant natural light, and fully furnished premium branded layouts.

Radiant Terrace emerges as a stunning landmark, a soaring tower that blends indoor comfort with open‑air living. The development presents a curated collection of studios, one‑, two‑, three‑ and four‑bedroom homes, each designed to capture abundant natural light through floor‑to‑ceiling glazing that frames sweeping city and sky panoramas. Every residence reflects a refined approach to spatial planning, offering generous layouts that feel far larger than their footprints.

projects.d: Arabian Hills Investment and Real Estate Development
projects.ov: Arabian Hills Estate presents a master‑planned community that marries expansive living spaces with a verdant backdrop. The development offers four exclusive plot categories, ranging from elegant villa plots to grand estate plots that emphasize spaciousness and distinction. A thoughtful layout integrates lush greenery and the soothing blues of nature to create an environment where ambition and elegance converge.

Miraggio is a sculptural architectural masterpiece. Inspired by the movement of the sea and the tranquility of nature, its cascading terraces and curved façade seamlessly blend with the surrounding landscape. More than a residence, Miraggio is a sanctuary of art, architecture, and sensory well-being, where every moment is shaped by the rhythm of the ocean, the warmth of the sun, and the organic flow of design.

Y Views is an exclusive residential enclave of private villas, thoughtfully positioned within the coastal master community of BAYN in Ghantoot. The project is designed around the idea of elevated waterfront living, where architecture, landscape, and natural light come together to create a serene and highly private environment. Set between the sea and sculpted green spaces, Y Views offers residents uninterrupted views, direct access to beaches and waterways, and a lifestyle shaped by calm rhythms and resort-style surroundings.

Rixos Al Reem Residences is a premium branded residential development that combines contemporary architecture with the signature hospitality standards of the Rixos brand. The project features a collection of one- to four-bedroom apartments and exclusive loft residences, thoughtfully designed with generous layouts, expansive terraces, and panoramic floor-to-ceiling glazing that enhances natural light and creates seamless indoor-outdoor living.

Bashayer is a vibrant coastal community developed by Modon, where stunning natural beauty meets exceptional living. Inspired by Europe's coastal villages, this refined enclave features elegant villas and residences set within lush surroundings, offering stunning views of Abu Dhabi's skyline. The community embodies a new chapter of refined coastal living, just minutes from the heart of the capital.

projects.n: The Residences at The Dubai Beach EDITION
projects.ov: The Residences at The Dubai Beach EDITION by H&H Development is an exceptional beachfront address that brings the iconic EDITION lifestyle into a private residential setting. Comprising four elegant towers with 165 full-service homes, the project offers spacious two, three, and four bedroom apartments, each designed for elevated seaside living. As the only EDITION in the world with its own private beach, it delivers a rare resort-style experience where panoramic sea, skyline, and harbour views become part of everyday life.

Valore is a contemporary residential development, designed as a refined expression of modern urban living in Dubai. The project features a groung floor, 3 podium plus 16 residential floors, offering a curated collection of studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, including spacious layouts with maid’s rooms. Set within Jumeirah Village Circle, it combines elegant architecture with strong investment appeal, high rental demand, and seamless connectivity to key destinations across the city.

Rabdan Avenue stands as a contemporary residential destination created for those who value connection, comfort, and considered design, bringing together modern residences, lifestyle amenities, and convenient retail spaces within an intimate low-rise setting. This exceptional development introduces a limited collection of one, two, and three-bedroom residences, including distinctive duplex homes, where every element is planned to support a more balanced way of living.

Onda by Kasco is a contemporary residential development in Dubai that brings together modern architecture, coastal inspiration, and refined urban living. Designed as an elegant sanctuary within the city, the project offers a curated collection of studios, 1.5-, 2-, 2.5-, and 3-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully crafted to reflect a seamless connection between sophisticated interiors and the calming rhythms of nature. The architecture and design language are inspired by the nearby waterfront, creating an atmosphere of tranquility and understated luxury in the heart of a dynamic urban environment.

Berkshire Park by Nshama Group offers a refined urban lifestyle through a collection of contemporary one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious three-bedroom duplexes. Ideally positioned near the gateway to the main park, the development combines the tranquility of green open spaces with the convenience of a well-connected community, making it especially appealing to families, young professionals, and residents seeking a balanced everyday lifestyle. Thoughtfully designed interiors feature bright, spacious layouts, elegant porcelain flooring, and a modern aesthetic that reflects both comfort and functionality.

Savannah is a contemporary residential development offering a refined collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed to balance modern comfort with a strong connection to nature. Located in a vibrant and desirable neighborhood, the project combines clean architectural lines, expansive windows, and elegant contemporary styling to create a sophisticated urban address. The residences are thoughtfully planned to maximize natural light and provide a serene living environment, making Savannah an ideal choice for those seeking both convenience and tranquility.

Masaar 3 Layan by Arada is the fifth phase of the forested Masaar community, where homes blend gracefully with lush planting and open lawns. Stylish contemporary facades sit within a green landscape, while the homes rise from a ground floor to one or two upper levels. The collection offers townhouses with two to four bedrooms and spacious villas with four and five bedrooms, each with dedicated relaxation areas, a private lawn, shaded terraces and covered parking for the whole family.

Fairmont Residences Al Marjan Island by Ardee Developments is a branded waterfront community created with the Fairmont hotel brand. The architecture is inspired by the natural rhythm of the coastline, with flowing silhouettes, panoramic glazing, spacious terraces and expressive facade geometry. The project combines residential towers that rise above a basement and a ground floor with one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, three-bedroom townhouses and exclusive sea villas, all designed to frame open views of the sea.

Port de La Mer by Meraas offers a refined island-inspired lifestyle with breathtaking views of the open sea and Dubai skyline. Designed with a Mediterranean architectural concept, the development blends timeless elegance with contemporary interiors, creating a unique coastal retreat within the city. The project features a curated selection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to maximize space, light, and panoramic waterfront vistas.

The Riff by Arada is a collection of six mid-rise residential buildings within East Village, a creative neighbourhood at the heart of the community that also includes the Link and Solo projects. Clean exterior design is enlivened by bold vertical lines on the facades, while each building rises above two basement parking levels and a spacious ground floor to six residential floors. The collection offers stylish studios and one-bedroom apartments designed for students, young couples, creatives and professionals.

Mondrian is a striking beachfront development that seamlessly blends contemporary architecture with the natural beauty of Al Marjan Island. Inspired by the fluidity of the sea and the rhythm of coastal landscapes, the design features organic forms, stacked balconies, and expansive glass facades that maximize natural light and uninterrupted ocean views. The complex offers a selection of residences, from one- to three-bedroom apartments to townhouses, a penthouse, and sky villas.

Maison Cannelle Residence by Casa Moderna reimagines contemporary luxury in the heart of Al Furjan, one of Dubai's most sought-after residential communities. This iconic development introduces a collection of private residences designed for elegant city living infused with tranquility and sophistication. Each home reflects a refined architectural vision, balancing sleek minimalism with natural harmony through expansive glass façades, smooth contours, and warm tones that maximize light and outdoor integration.

Guzel Towers, a remarkable project by Tiger Properties, showcases two high-rise towers elegantly connected by a breathtaking central swimming pool. This luxurious development perfectly balances modern sophistication with tranquil design, offering residents a unique blend of elegance and comfort. With expansive windows, premium finishes, and thoughtful layouts, Guzel Towers provides a living experience that embodies luxury and style in the heart of Dubai.

Tiger Sky Tower by Tiger Properties is a planned architectural jewel, set to become the world's highest complex with the most luxurious amenities. Featuring an iconic design and fascinating scenic views, this remarkable development offers notably designed flats with world-class restaurants, great adventures, and elegance in every detail. From the highest infinity pool in the world to the highest restaurant, Tiger Sky Tower perfectly represents Dubai's opulence and vibrancy, offering a seamless blend of urban allure and luxury at every turn.

Ananda Residences is a fifty-four-story twin-tower development by Tiger Properties. Inspired by the Sanskrit word for bliss, happiness, and pure joy, this architectural marvel is set to redefine urban sophistication, offering residents an unparalleled blend of comfort, convenience, and contemporary design. Ananda is more than a residence — it is a lifestyle of serenity and fulfillment, where luxury meets tranquility in the heart of the city.

Auresta Tower is more than a tower — it is a symbol of aspiration, achievement, and architectural excellence, rising gracefully above the skyline. Developed by the visionary minds at Tiger Properties, this sixty-three-story statement of modern luxury offers a journey through refined design from the moment you enter. Clean lines, ambient lighting, and thoughtful details create a tranquil atmosphere that whispers luxury without saying a word.

Orchid Towers Phase 1 introduces a landmark lagoon-front community where modern glass towers rise around a serene private waterfront. The master plan blends contemporary architecture with abundant greenery, elevated pathways, sculptural features, and immersive water elements that shape a calm yet dynamic environment. Designed as a destination where nature and urban living merge seamlessly, the development offers tranquil lagoon views, cascading water features, and a vibrant central plaza that becomes the heart of the community.

Lily Tower, envisioned by Tiger Properties, rises as a high‑rise residential landmark defined by sleek modern architecture and meticulous aesthetic detail. The tower climbs thirty‑four residential levels and rests upon ten parking tiers, including two subterranean decks, a ground floor and seven above‑ground decks, while offering six hundred ninety‑one premium apartments ranging from intimate studios to expansive three‑bedroom homes. Its design integrates a robust structural framework that supports both urban vibrancy and tranquil living for today’s city dweller.

Voxa Pantheon is a striking residential development that brings a new expression of luxury living to Dubai. The complex includes a basement level, a ground floor, a four-level podium with offices and commercial premises, and twenty-nine residential floors. Designed to cater to a variety of lifestyles, the project offers a curated selection of fully furnished residences, from stylish studios and elegant one- and two-bedroom apartments to expansive four-bedroom penthouses.

Maison Elysee by Pantheon is a contemporary residential development located in the vibrant community of Jumeirah Village Circle, offering a refined urban lifestyle. The project offers both commercial spaces and residential spaces - thoughtfully designed 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, combining modern architecture with elegant interiors. With its twin towers rising up to 22 floors, Maison Elysee stands as a striking addition to the skyline, reflecting a balance of sophistication, comfort, and everyday practicality.

Omya Residence stands as a contemporary branded residential tower in Jebel Ali’s freehold enclave. The sleek façade embraces clean lines and practical elegance while framing open vistas toward Yalayis Street and the surrounding urban fabric. A mix of studios, one‑bedroom and two‑bedroom homes offers efficient layouts that capture abundant natural light for a vibrant city‑centric lifestyle.

One Central is an exceptional mid-rise development that offers a unique blend of luxury living and innovative workspaces. Designed with precision and thoughtfulness, the project comprises three residential buildings and one commercial space, each crafted to meet the highest standards of contemporary design. It creates an environment where community, connection, and modern lifestyle aspirations come together seamlessly.

Mayfair Nexus is a boutique residential community by Seven Mayfair, thoughtfully conceived as a low-rise lifestyle destination in Wadi Al Safa 7. Comprising nine elegant buildings, the project is designed to create a calm, connected, and design-led living environment where architecture, greenery, and everyday comfort come together seamlessly. With a refined contemporary identity and a strong focus on community, Mayfair Nexus offers a more intimate residential experience—one that feels both peaceful and connected to the rhythm of Dubai.

Coral by Vision is a masterful creation that epitomizes the perfect harmony of elegance and spaciousness, redefining the standards of residential living. With its thoughtfully designed units, each featuring floor-to-floor windows and open views, residents can bask in the grandeur of maximizing space and light, creating an ambiance of serenity and openness. The generous layouts are a testament to the developer's understanding of modern families' and singles' desires for comfort and sophistication, making Coral by Vision an exemplary choice for those seeking refined living.

Aark Terraces is a contemporary residential development located in Dubailand Residence Complex, designed to deliver a refined urban lifestyle with a resort-inspired atmosphere. The project features a modern architectural concept with clean lines and thoughtfully designed spaces, offering a collection of 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, many enhanced with private jacuzzis for an elevated living experience. The building stands as a stylish addition to the area, combining functionality with aesthetic appeal to meet the expectations of both end-users and investors.

Rabdan Gates is a contemporary residential development in Majan, designed to offer a stylish and well-balanced urban lifestyle in a vibrant community setting. With its elegant architectural expression and thoughtfully planned living spaces, the project presents a modern residential environment tailored to a wide range of lifestyles. Offering a collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, Rabdan Gates is conceived as a place where comfort, practicality, and contemporary design come together to create a welcoming home for individuals, couples, and families alike.

Celeste by HRE is a refined residential address set along Al Jaddaf Waterfront, where contemporary architecture is expressed through clean lines, soft proportions, and expansive glazing. Designed with a focus on light, space, and clarity, the development offers a curated collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences with open layouts and panoramic windows. The overall concept is calm and understated, creating a balanced environment where modern design meets a tranquil waterfront setting.

Celia Gardens is a residential building by Abou Eid within the Nad Al Sheba Gardens masterplan, offering a calm and green setting for everyday living. The project features one- and two-bedroom apartments designed with practical layouts and a contemporary architectural character, providing a comfortable home for professionals, couples and families who value a quieter residential atmosphere.

La Cle by MAAIA is a contemporary residential development designed to combine modern architecture, functional living spaces, and a nature-inspired design philosophy. The project offers a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences, including selected units with private pools, all thoughtfully planned to maximize comfort, natural light, and everyday practicality. Warm contemporary interiors, efficient layouts, and carefully considered design details create a welcoming residential environment that caters to a variety of lifestyles, from individuals to growing families.

La Vue is a contemporary residential development inspired by refined French design and modern urban elegance. The project features sophisticated architecture characterized by clean lines, expansive balconies, and floor-to-ceiling windows that maximize natural light and create bright, open living spaces. Designed to offer a harmonious balance between style and functionality, the residences reflect a timeless aesthetic where carefully considered layouts, elegant interiors, and modern comforts come together to create an elevated living experience.

Waada Dubai South is a visionary master-planned community that redefines contemporary urban living through a seamless blend of architecture, sustainability, and connectivity. Designed with a distinctive cascading architectural style, the development creates a dynamic yet harmonious skyline complemented by wide green promenades and thoughtfully curated public spaces. The project offers a diverse collection of residences, from modern apartments to spacious townhouses and exclusive villas, each designed with open layouts, panoramic views, and a strong connection between indoor and outdoor living, delivering both privacy and refined comfort.

Al Hamra Greens is a nature-led residential community of mid- and high-rise buildings surrounded by greenery. The architecture embraces simplicity, with clean lines, calm spaces and a palette of soft whites, quiet browns, warm woods and touches of green that blend seamlessly with the outdoors. Native trees, blooming corners and shaded courtyards run through the masterplan. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with the larger homes including a maid's room, for individuals, couples and families.

311 Boulevard by BAMX Development is a contemporary residential building with a distinctive architectural identity, combining modern design with functionality. The concept is based on a balance between flowing lines and precise geometry, while green alleys, lush planting and modern lighting create a calm, welcoming environment. The building rises above three basement levels and a ground floor to fifteen residential floors and a roof with shared amenities, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments.

Hawa Residence by Al Marwan Developments is a contemporary low-rise residential community set on a generous plot within a calm suburban neighbourhood. The building rises from a ground floor to four residential floors, with smooth, flowing lines, a modern design and natural colours. Large windows bring in daylight and open views. The project offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with the larger homes including a maid's room, together with covered parking for residents.

Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers is a landmark residential development set within the iconic Emirates Towers district in Dubai, where sculptural architecture meets refined urban living. Designed in collaboration with SCDA Architects, the tower is defined by its striking cantilevered form and seamless integration into the skyline, appearing to float while framing panoramic views of the city’s most recognizable landmarks. The architecture emphasizes openness, privacy, and elegance, creating a distinctive presence that redefines contemporary sophistication.

Beverly Grande by HMB Homes is a contemporary residential landmark set within the vibrant community of Motor City, where bold architecture meets a refined urban lifestyle. Defined by its sleek façade and clean geometric lines, the building reflects a modern design language infused with energy and elegance. The residences are thoughtfully positioned to capture natural light and openness, creating a living environment that feels both dynamic and balanced within one of Dubai’s most active neighborhoods.

Alton by Nshama Group is a contemporary residential development in Town Square Dubai, offering a refined collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed for modern urban living. Ideally positioned at the edge of Town Square Park, the project combines sweeping views of lush green spaces and the central boulevard with a calm, family-friendly atmosphere. Its architecture is defined by clean lines, warm natural tones, and expansive windows, creating bright, elegant interiors that balance style, comfort, and everyday functionality.

Santorini Residences is a refined low-rise development. Inspired by the timeless elegance of Mediterranean architecture, the project brings the serene charm of Santorini to the vibrant energy of Dubai. With its clean geometric lines, soft white façade, and lush landscaped surroundings, this boutique community offers a peaceful, aesthetically harmonious environment that redefines urban living with a coastal soul. Featuring studios to two-bedroom units, each residence reflects a seamless blend of style and functionality.

Sobha Aquamont redefines the paradigm of beachfront living, situating residents amidst a breathtaking tapestry of shoreline charm and architectural ingenuity. As the Arabian sea's gentle waves caress the horizon, this landmark development begins to take shape, its very essence infused with the soothing cadence of the ocean. Every element, from the private berths where morning sails commence to the open-air performances that unfold along the water's edge, is meticulously crafted to stir the senses and evoke a profound sense of belonging.

Marquis Vista, features a contemporary collection of elegantly designed residences that embody modern sophistication and refined craftsmanship. Clean architectural lines, bespoke interiors, and thoughtfully planned layouts create living spaces that seamlessly combine style with functionality. Selected residences are enhanced with exclusive features such as private plunge pools, artisan-crafted wardrobes, and panoramic skyline views, offering a private sanctuary where every detail reflects timeless luxury and exceptional comfort.

Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is a branded luxury residential development that combines private residences with an elevated hospitality concept. The project is designed to deliver a highly curated living experience focused on exclusivity, privacy, and premium service standards. The tower features contemporary architecture, sophisticated interiors, and a residents-only lifestyle concept centered around personalized services and access to exclusive facilities. A key component of the development is the private members-only club, offering a refined social environment tailored to residents seeking a high-end residential experience.

Woodland Crest by AMIS is a boutique residential building where urban energy lives peacefully with nature. Contemporary architecture with clean lines, panoramic windows and high-quality materials blends harmoniously with the surrounding landscape. The building rises above a basement and a spacious ground floor to five residential levels and a rooftop leisure deck, offering one- and two-bedroom apartments designed to high standards of comfort, together with a small selection of retail units at ground level.

Esplora is a distinctive residential development designed for those who appreciate refined living and meaningful design, offering a lifestyle that blends vibrancy, tranquility, and modern sophistication. Set within a dynamic and forward-thinking community, the project stands as a statement of architectural intent, where every element is carefully curated to create a harmonious and inspiring living environment.

Selora Residences is an exclusive gated community of thirty thoughtfully designed villas, inspired by the elements of nature and located in one of Dubai's most prestigious communities. Developed by Swank Development, this sanctuary blends luxury with mindful living, where the essence of nature meets artful design. Featuring four to six-bedroom villas, each residence is a masterpiece of unique design, embracing natural finishes and earthy tones to cultivate an inviting, warm, and enduring charm.

Forest City 2 is a masterpiece of residential design, where the boundaries between architecture and nature are beautifully blurred, resulting in a serene and idyllic urban oasis. This exquisite development presents a refined collection of spacious, fully furnished smart homes, meticulously crafted to meet the needs of modern families, with clean architectural lines, expansive glazing, and lush landscaped surroundings creating a symphony of comfort, elegance, and natural beauty.

Stamn Nautis Residences is an ocean-inspired luxury development in one of Dubai's most ambitious waterfront projects. The project takes the ocean as its design inspiration, blending modern design with natural elements and featuring unique wave-shaped balconies that endow the architecture with aesthetic appeal. Offering a diverse range of layouts from versatile one-bedroom units to spacious luxury four-bedroom residences, each home is designed to cater to differentiated living needs, enabling architecture and nature to coexist in harmony.

Luzora Residences by DIA Development is a refined coastal address set within the tranquil surroundings of Dubai Islands, offering a harmonious blend of modern architecture and seaside serenity. The eight-storey building is defined by clean lines, minimalist geometry, and expansive glass façades that frame uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf. Designed to maximize light and openness, the residences range from elegant one-bedroom apartments to spacious three-bedroom homes, each featuring open-plan layouts and a seamless indoor-outdoor flow that reflects a calm, contemporary lifestyle.

Villa Del Gavi by Mr. Eight Development is an exclusive boutique residential project that sets a new benchmark for luxury living in Dubai. Designed as a collection of branded residences, the development combines refined architecture, bespoke interiors, and exceptional craftsmanship to create an atmosphere of timeless elegance. Each home is thoughtfully planned with expansive living spaces, panoramic windows, and seamless indoor-outdoor connections, complemented by private pools, landscaped gardens, and rooftop lounges that enhance the sense of privacy and sophistication.

Isolana Residences by Hayaat Developments is a distinctive waterfront address set within Dubai Islands, where architecture is shaped by movement, light, and a strong connection to nature. Designed by Tony Ashai, the building is defined by fluid balconies and a sculptural façade that reflects the rhythm of wind and sea. The project offers a refined collection of residences, from one-bedroom apartments to expansive four-bedroom penthouses, all thoughtfully designed to create a calm, contemporary living environment rooted in natural harmony.

Luxury Canal Residences by Prestige One is a serene waterfront retreat nestled along the harbor of Dubai Islands, offering an elegant fusion of tranquility and modern sophistication. Thoughtfully designed for those who appreciate peaceful, elevated living, the development mirrors the gentle rhythm of the sea, creating an atmosphere where life flows effortlessly. With its graceful architecture and seamless connection to nature, the residences exude timeless charm and refined simplicity.

Island Heights is an exclusive collection of meticulously crafted residences ideally situated to take advantage of the many amenities and attractions of Al Marjan Island. Perfectly positioned close to the region's first interactive gaming resort and within walking distance of the beach, Island Heights promises enviable living and engaging entertainment. Architecturally, the development pays homage to classic elegance, its geometric silhouette defined with sleek sculptural precision, balancing visual appeal with functionality to create a residence that is at once aesthetically striking and eminently liveable.

Skyvue Stellar is a pinnacle of luxury living, set within the prestigious Sobha Hartland II community in Dubai. As the tallest tower in the Skyvue collection, it offers breathtaking panoramic views of Downtown Dubai and the serene Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. Designed with sophistication, each residence features floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light and provide an immersive living experience. The tower's striking architecture, with its zig-zag facade and triangular floor plan, enhances the aesthetic appeal while ensuring an open, airy atmosphere.

Starline Beach Residences embodies an exquisite beachfront lifestyle, located on the picturesque Sobha Siniya Island. This exclusive development consists of four elegant towers offering 1-2 bedroom apartments and 3 bedroom duplexes with breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea. The project seamlessly blends modern comfort with natural beauty, creating an atmosphere of absolute serenity and luxury.

Olivia Gardens by Segrex is a premium residential development. This elegant project offers a refined lifestyle in one of Dubai's most well-connected and dynamic neighborhoods, making it an attractive choice for both end-users and investors. Featuring a collection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, the development showcases Segrex's commitment to quality with high-end materials, tasteful finishes, and layouts that prioritize both functionality and aesthetics.

Zyra Vista Residence is a contemporary residential development designed to combine modern architecture with refined interior design and practical living spaces. The project features thoughtfully planned residences with spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and bright open interiors that maximize natural light and create a sense of openness throughout each home. Clean architectural lines, elegant detailing, and a focus on comfort define the development, creating a residential environment that balances functionality with sophisticated contemporary living.

Estrella by Nexus is a true masterpiece in luxury living, redefining sophistication and comfort in the heart of Dubai. Developed by Nexus, a company renowned for its innovative approach to residential developments, this project is designed to offer an extraordinary living experience. With stunning architectural design and high-quality finishes, every detail of Estrella by Nexus radiates elegance and modernity.

D Villas is a collection of luxury residences developed by Dar Global, designed to combine contemporary architecture with spacious layouts and refined living environments. The villas feature expansive interior spaces, elegant architectural detailing, and a design philosophy that emphasizes privacy, comfort, and sophistication. High-quality materials and carefully considered finishes throughout the residences create a premium residential offering tailored to modern family living.

Celeste Heights is a refined mid-rise development where architecture is shaped by rhythm, balance, and a sense of quiet elevation. Rising across eight residential floors with podium and rooftop levels, the project presents a curated collection of one- to three-bedroom residences and premium apartments. The design is defined by alternating floor layouts that create variation and individuality, ensuring each home feels distinct while maintaining a cohesive architectural identity. Clean lines, thoughtful proportions, and elevated vantage points come together to create a calm, contemporary living environment above the city.

Barajeel Tower B by GJ Properties is the second landmark tower within the Barajeel Towers residential development in Ajman, offering a contemporary interpretation of traditional regional architecture. The building features a ground floor, five podium levels, and thirty residential floors, forming a strong vertical presence within the city skyline. Its design is inspired by classic Barajeel wind towers, expressed through warm sand-toned façades, clean geometric lines, and expansive glazing that enhances natural light and city views while maintaining a distinctive architectural identity.

High Best Tower is a symbol of luxury and innovation. This urban oasis combines natural beauty with the vibrant energy of city life, surrounded by lush greenery that provides a peaceful retreat amidst Dubai's dynamic atmosphere. Featuring contemporary design paired with state-of-the-art technology, the tower offers spacious interiors, breathtaking city views, and a perfect blend of living and working spaces. As a cultural landmark that seamlessly merges heritage with modernity, High Best celebrates the richness of Dubai's history while embracing cutting-edge innovation.

Chelsea Gardens is a boutique residential building by Alaia Developments that combines contemporary design with premium finishes and a calm, green setting. The project offers a curated collection of studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, alongside a small number of retail units at ground level, creating an intimate address for residents who value quality and privacy in the heart of the city.

Skyvue Spectra at Sobha Hartland II emerges as the crowning jewel of the northern skyline, a stunning tower that takes opulence to extraordinary new heights while remaining perfectly centered within one of Dubai's most prestigious communities. This magnificent residence follows the extraordinary success of its predecessor, offering uninterrupted panoramic views that stretch all the way to the horizon, where floor-to-ceiling windows invite an abundance of natural light and fill every home with warmth and blissful tranquility.

City Walk Crestlane is a masterpiece of contemporary design, where the beauty of waterfront living converges with the vibrancy of urban life, yielding a unique and captivating destination. The architecture is a symphony of clean lines, fluid forms, and thoughtful orientation, creating a seamless harmony between the built environment and the natural surroundings, with expansive façades and open layouts that maximize breathtaking views and bath the spaces in an abundance of natural light.

Design Quarter by Meraas boasts a sophisticated architectural design, characterized by modern, expressive lines and dynamic forms that capture the artistic essence of its surroundings, with a curated selection of one to three-bedroom apartments that epitomize contemporary elegance. The residences are thoughtfully designed to maximize natural light and open views, creating living spaces that feel both inspiring and refined, perfect for individuals seeking a creative and innovative lifestyle. The development's overall aesthetic is a masterful blend of form and function, resulting in a truly unique living experience.

Me Do Re Business, a cutting‑edge office development, delivers fully customizable workspaces that adapt to startups and established corporations alike, while showcasing refined architectural detailing and a sleek, modern silhouette. The tower incorporates high‑speed elevators, electric‑vehicle charging stations for premium offices, and an intelligent entry system that blends convenience with efficiency. Smart infrastructure runs throughout, ensuring every business enjoys a seamless, future‑ready environment.

Muheira Maysan is a residential masterpiece, comprising two elegantly designed towers that rise from a ground-floor, podium configuration, blending seamlessly into the dynamic urban landscape.
