This exceptional complex boasts an array of modern one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, meticulously laid out to provide spacious living areas, high-quality finishes, and a harmonious environment that effortlessly caters to the diverse needs of families, couples, and young professionals.

Wadeem Gardens emerges as a truly exceptional gated residential community, a distinctive destination centred around a vibrant spine that brings together everyday living, leisure, and wellbeing in one beautifully connected place. This remarkable development offers a collection of four, five, and six-bedroom villas, presented in both Arabian and Modern façades, with thoughtfully designed layouts that provide space, flexibility, and a profound sense of belonging.

Tara Park is a contemporary residential development by Modon located on Reem Island in Abu Dhabi, designed to create a balanced lifestyle where urban convenience meets a calm, community-oriented environment. The first phase features two residential towers offering thoughtfully planned apartments surrounded by landscaped greenery and open public spaces. Positioned directly opposite Reem Mall and close to key destinations such as Al Fay Park, Sorbonne University, and major business districts, the project combines accessibility with a sense of tranquillity and everyday comfort.

The Heart of Europe - Portofino is a magnificent five-star, family-only hotel destination that transports guests to the stunning Italian Riviera, designed by Italian architects and surrounded by glistening turquoise oceans. This architectural marvel features contemporary Mediterranean design with spacious sea view suites and rooftop villas featuring private plunge pools, all exuding Italian style with modern, contemporary flair. Every space has been thoughtfully designed using ancient Feng Shui practices, creating a calming and inviting energy that promises a more than royal welcome from the attentive Italian staff.

Hudayriyat Golf Estates is a prestigious residential development by Modon, set alongside sweeping fairways and serene water channels. This exclusive precinct features a collection of golf mansions, fairway villas, range villas, golf homes, and townhomes with four to six-bedroom layouts. Designed in Andalusian-inspired architecture, the estate offers a distinguished living experience where pristine nature, world-class amenities, and the gentle rhythm of the game come together in perfect balance.

Amali Island is an exclusive collection of ultra-luxury beachfront villas by Amali, the developer founded by Ali and Amira Sajwani, set on two connected private islands and celebrating exquisite simplicity. Architecture by EL ASTIC, interiors by Hirsch Bedner Associates and landscaping by SquareM create residences that complement their beachfront setting. Four villa typologies, each in a Grande or Minima style, rise from a ground floor to two upper floors, offering five-, six- and seven-bedroom homes with sweeping sea and skyline views.

X11 is a residential development by BAMX Developments - a district defined by long-term planning, connectivity, and steady urban growth. Conceived as a response to its evolving surroundings, the project reflects a philosophy of intentional design, where architecture, environment, and lifestyle are aligned to create a calm and future-oriented living experience. Positioned within a rapidly developing area with strong infrastructure and accessibility, X11 is designed for residents who value clarity, balance, and thoughtful urban living.

Mirasol is a resort-inspired residential development located on Mina Al Arab, offering a refined island lifestyle surrounded by panoramic sea views and natural beauty. The project features a selection of studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, spacious 3-bedroom duplexes, and exclusive penthouses, all designed to capture breathtaking sunsets and uninterrupted waterfront vistas from cascading rooftops.

Trace Park rises with a façade that melds classical detailing and modern comfort, highlighted by an elegant dome and a grand entrance that commands attention. The tower presents a thoughtful selection of studio, one‑ and two‑bedroom apartments, catering to both owner‑occupiers and investors seeking a refined urban residence. Its architectural composition projects a timeless presence within Dubai’s dynamic skyline.

Do Hotels and Residences on Dubai Islands is a distinctive beachfront development created by One Development in collaboration with global music icon Amr Diab. Blending contemporary architecture with musical inspiration, the project introduces a vibrant lifestyle concept where design and creativity intersect. A selection of studios to three-bedroom serviced apartments is thoughtfully planned to maximize natural light and spatial flow, creating an atmosphere that is both dynamic and uplifting.

Laguna Residence is a distinctive residential development centered around a landmark lagoon concept, creating a serene oasis within an urban setting. Designed to reflect the essence of waterfront living, the project features the largest podium lagoon in the UAE, offering residents a unique environment where relaxation, recreation, and nature come together. The overall concept blends modern city living with a resort-like atmosphere, delivering a balanced and tranquil lifestyle.

Symphony on the Park is a vibrant residential development by Nshama. Featuring a mix of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, the intuitive layouts are contemporary, keeping in mind privacy and comfort. With unique character and calm curves of architecture, the development offers unparalleled views to the lush green vistas of the boulevard, creating a living space that blends vibrancy with serenity.

Olbia is a contemporary residential development designed to combine refined architecture with the comfort of community-focused living. Thoughtfully planned to balance modern sophistication and everyday practicality, the project features elegant design, inviting communal spaces, and bright interiors that create a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Open-plan living and dining areas are enhanced by abundant natural light, while smart layouts and well-proportioned bedrooms ensure both functionality and comfort in every home.

Augusta by Nshama Group is a contemporary residential development in Town Square Dubai, offering a collection of thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious three-bedroom duplexes. Set near Town Square Park, the project combines modern architecture with a strong sense of community, creating a balanced lifestyle where urban energy meets green open spaces. With elegant design lines, bright interiors, and seamless access to the surrounding retail, dining, and entertainment options, Augusta is designed to meet the needs of modern residents seeking both comfort and connectivity.

Mirasol II is a waterfront residential development located in Mina Al Arab, designed to reflect the essence of refined coastal living. The architecture is shaped by space, light, and thoughtful details, blending contemporary design with the calm rhythm of the sea. Positioned along the marina, the project offers direct access to promenades, yachts, and vibrant waterfront experiences within a well-planned community.

Arisha Terraces is a masterpiece of contemporary design, weaving together the essence of traditional Arabian architecture with the comforts of modern living, to create a truly unique residential experience. This captivating development, comprising four elegant eight-storey buildings, is centered around a lush central courtyard, fostering a sense of community and tranquility in the heart of Dubai.

projects.d: SAAS Properties and Royal Development Company
projects.ov: Seamont Autograph Collection Residences, developed by Seamont, showcases a sophisticated waterfront silhouette shaped by Marriott’s Autograph Collection design ethos. The architecture embraces natural materials and soft architectural flows, creating an urban retreat that mirrors the rhythm of sea and sky. A portfolio ranging from intimate one‑bedroom sanctuaries to expansive townhouses and penthouses offers diverse living options.

Reportage Village is a townhouse development by Reportage Properties, consisting of 1,767 units, situated within the Arabian Ranches 3 area of Dubai. The community features two phases of elegant townhouses with white facades, designed to meet modern standards. Residence formats include 2 to 4 bedroom townhouses, with the option of internal elevators in four-bedroom units. Views are available from private balconies and terraces.

Hayyan by Alef Group is an inspiring natural villa community designed to reflect the idea of a life well lived, where people connect with nature in a tranquil habitat. Architecture embodies the spirit of the emirate in every design detail, creating an intimate, genuine neighbourhood shaded by native Ghaf trees. Homes rise over two or three floors, and the collection includes two-, three- and four-bedroom townhouses, premium townhouses, four-bedroom villas and luxury villas with up to six bedrooms.

Mansory Residences by Amaal is a groundbreaking collaboration between Amaal Emirates and Mansory, the legendary name in supercar customisation, bringing performance-inspired design into luxury living. Two towers rise above a shared ground floor and eight podium levels, one to forty-one residential floors and the other to forty-nine, topped by amenity rooftops. Aerodynamic contours, carbon-inspired accents and contrasting materials express the brand's style. The project offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, including four-bedroom duplexes.

Eden Golf Views 1 presents a refined architectural expression shaped around clean forms, expansive openings, and a harmonious integration with golf fairways, mangrove forests, the marina, and the golden coastline. The development is conceived as a serene escape where modern architecture meets the richness of nature, creating a living environment defined by calmness, elevated aesthetics, and panoramic scenery at every turn.

projects.n: The Unexpected Al Marjan Island Hotel and Residence
projects.ov: The Unexpected Al Marjan Island Hotel and Residence by Almal Real Estate Development brings a legendary hospitality brand, born on a Mediterranean party island and famous for music, luxury and irreverence, to the shores of the Arabian Gulf. The building rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to eight residential floors and a rooftop. Light-coloured materials create a clean, inviting look by day, while an illuminated archway and a roof canopy of backlit fabrics transform it at night.

Liora by Jaiedco Development is a refined residential project that brings elegant coastal living into a beautifully designed modern residence. The project offers a curated selection of spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive 4-bedroom duplexes, each thoughtfully planned for comfort and everyday luxury. With its timeless architecture, golden accents, and harmonious design, Liora presents a serene and sophisticated lifestyle experience.

Butterfly Towers is a striking twin-tower development that defines contemporary living through architectural elegance and thoughtful design. The project’s form reflects a harmony between nature and modernity, with fluid lines and balanced proportions creating a distinctive silhouette on the skyline. Designed to maximize light and openness, the residences feature panoramic views and airy interiors, offering a refined living environment where sophistication meets a sense of calm and privacy.

Sky Gardens Tower by GJ Properties is a contemporary residential development located in Emirates City, offering a balanced combination of modern design, practicality, and urban convenience. The tower features a clean architectural expression with a focus on functionality, efficiency, and comfortable living. Its strategic location ensures easy access to major highways and key destinations across the UAE, making it a strong choice for both end-users and investors. The project offers thoughtfully designed two-bedroom apartments that emphasize space, privacy, and everyday comfort.

Infinity Tower rises as a striking landmark in Ajman’s Al Ameera district, merging contemporary luxury with urban convenience. Its soaring architectural profile and clean modern lines establish a strong visual presence, reflecting GJ Properties’ vision of upscale living supported by elegant design. Surrounded by a rapidly developing cityscape, the tower offers residents a modern lifestyle anchored in comfort and connectivity.

Trio Isle Queen B by Durar Group and OCTA is an exceptional beachfront development that brings a high level of luxury living. The project offers a carefully curated collection of elegant 1 and 3-bedroom apartments, combining stunning architecture, breathtaking sea views, and beautifully designed interiors to create a truly exclusive residential experience.

Trio Isle features three stunning buildings, each offering world-class design and impeccable finishes. With three levels of exceptional amenities, Trio Isle creates a harmonious blend of luxury and comfort. Residents will enjoy a unique blend of experiences, from the serene beach to the refreshing pool and lush garden, all designed to elevate your lifestyle to new heights. Trio Isle is where elegance meets innovation, making it the perfect destination for those seeking the ultimate in coastal living.

Al Ghaf 2 is a boutique residential development by Jersey Real Estate Development, a Dubai-based developer with over two decades of experience. This thoughtfully designed community is inspired by the graceful poise of the Ghaf tree. Offering a collection of elegant homes, Al Ghaf 2 creates a sanctuary shaped by gardens, soft light, and quiet strength — where life doesn’t rush, but settles and grows with purpose.

Brand Centro is a modern residential development that redefines premium living with a blend of comfort, convenience, and style. This ten-story architectural masterpiece features a fluidic design that enhances the skyline, offering a sleek and sophisticated aesthetic with meticulously designed interiors and floor-to-ceiling windows. Every corner of Brand Centro is crafted for luxury and comfort, representing a new standard in premium living.

Muraba Veil is a landmark residential development by Muraba Properties that redefines vertical luxury living in Dubai. Rising 380 meters across 73 storeys, the tower is an architectural masterpiece designed by the internationally renowned consultancy WSP Parsons Brinckerhoff. With its elegant silhouette and striking contemporary design, Muraba Veil offers an exclusive collection of residences that combine exceptional craftsmanship with breathtaking panoramic views of the Dubai skyline. Every aspect of the project reflects a commitment to timeless architecture, innovation, and sophisticated urban living.

The Royal Yacht by Palladium Prime Real Estate Development is envisioned as a stunning hospitality project inspired by the elegance of a modern superyacht, blending fluid architecture with a calm, contemporary atmosphere. Designed as a sculpted, refined structure where architecture moves like the sea, it offers spacious layouts that feel open, bright, and luxurious. The project includes beautifully crafted studio apartments, each created to provide comfort, clarity, and a unique maritime-inspired character.

The Winslow is a contemporary residential development, designed to offer a refined and balanced lifestyle just moments from Dubai’s key destinations. The tower rises 23 floors above ground, with residences positioned from the 6th to the 23rd level, ensuring privacy and elevated views. The project features a curated selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, catering to both individuals and families seeking spacious, modern living. Complementing the residential offering are retail spaces on the ground floor and office units across the podium levels, creating a fully integrated mixed-use environment.

Whitecliffs Residences by AG Properties is a contemporary residential tower that rises above podium parking levels, with modern apartments, rooftop access and a full range of indoor facilities. The project offers one-bedroom apartments, two- and three-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, and four-bedroom penthouses with informal living areas, a prayer room and generous balconies. A clean, geometric entrance leads into a reception and lift lobby defined by stone, light and carefully balanced proportions.

The Chedi Private Residences is the world's first standalone private branded residence under The Chedi name, rising over fifty storeys above the city. Designed by the award-winning Studio Bruno Guelaff, the tower features a sleek glass facade and an exclusive collection of sky villas. Residences range from two-, three- and four-bedroom villas to five-bedroom duplex villas with private pools, a six-bedroom Sky Mansion and the eight-bedroom triplex Pinnacle Mansion crowning the building.

Al Waleed W.S 1 is a contemporary residential building that blends architectural simplicity with functional elegance. A calm design language, neutral tones and generous balconies create a modern, welcoming character, while smart layouts make the most of space and natural light. The building rises above a basement, a ground floor and a two-level parking podium to twelve residential floors and a rooftop, and offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments designed for families, couples and professionals.

Solanki One is an inspiring development by Solanki Realty, offering a variety of studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments thoughtfully designed for modern lifestyles. Each home is spacious, filled with natural light, and crafted to provide the perfect blend of comfort and elegance. The project ensures easy access to Dubai's most important destinations while being surrounded by a welcoming community atmosphere.

The Ritz-Carlton Residences is a landmark residential tower by SAAS Properties, created with Killa Design and Tara Bernerd & Partners, where The Ritz-Carlton's celebrated philosophy of gracious living, exquisite service and effortless luxury becomes part of everyday life. Its slender silhouette, with elegant vertical fins, finely detailed louvres and deep continuous terraces, beautifully balances openness and privacy while allowing every home to capture natural light and sweeping panoramic views.

Verdana V is a contemporary high-end residential community, offering a luxurious lifestyle with close proximity to most of Dubai's attractions. This integrated community of townhouses and apartments is designed to provide a serene and fulfilling life, surrounded by parks, schools, mosques, and community retail outlets. Some townhouses feature double-height living rooms, sky roofs, and internal elevators, enhancing the sense of space and luxury, creating homes where modern elegance meets nature's touch.

Arthouse Hills Arjan is a stunning collection of branded and fully furnished residences that sets an inspiring new standard for refined living. Carrying over a century of timeless Arthouse heritage and blending it with subtle Japanese-inspired design, the tower celebrates balance, calm, and beautifully considered geometry throughout. The residences span a thoughtful range of layouts, from efficient and open studios to graceful one-bedroom homes and spacious two-bedroom residences designed for both gathering and retreat.

Palazzo Tissoli is a distinctive waterfront development on Al Marjan Island, created in collaboration with Pininfarina. The architecture reflects a seamless fusion of art, design, and coastal nature, inspired by the meeting of desert, sea, and mountains in Ras Al Khaimah. Flowing terraces, sculpted façades, and panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf define the project’s identity, while every detail expresses Italian precision and a contemporary vision of refined living.

Longfor International Center is a premium commercial office development designed for modern business needs, offering 72 well-planned offices in a refined and professional setting. The project combines thoughtful layouts, light-filled workspaces, and an elegant overall design to create an excellent environment for businesses seeking comfort, prestige, and functionality.

Casa Altia is a contemporary residential development designed to elevate everyday living through refined architecture and thoughtful vertical planning. Rising across multiple residential levels above podium parking and curated lifestyle spaces, the project blends modern aesthetics with functional elegance. Its clean façade, balanced proportions, and integrated rooftop amenities create a cohesive urban statement that reflects sophistication at every level.

AB Cleo is a boutique residential building that brings a calm, considered approach to everyday living. The low-rise building offers studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments shaped by functional layouts, warm materials and clean lines, creating homes that feel easy to live in. The project balances privacy with accessibility, providing a quiet and practical setting for residents who value comfort, clarity and simplicity in their daily routines.

Blue Pearls by Ajmal Makan delivers a collection of studio, one‑bedroom and two‑bedroom homes set within two six‑storey towers that together house three hundred twenty‑four residences. The design emphasizes efficient layouts, while large balconies and terraces frame uninterrupted sea panoramas. Each unit showcases a thoughtful blend of space and coastal character.

Seef Residences by Alef is a waterfront residential community with direct beach frontage, canal waterfront and lagoon frontage, arranged around a landscaped internal garden. Some buildings front the beach, others rise above a podium, and sea views open from multiple sides. The contemporary coastal architecture carries restrained Neo-Art Deco references: horizontal balcony bands follow the horizon, curved corners soften the buildings and selective arches draw on local heritage. Recessed glazing brings in light, and deep balconies create shade.

Marea Residences is a masterful creation of refined coastal living, meticulously crafted by the visionary developers of world-class hospitality experiences, epitomizing timeless craftsmanship and exclusivity through its flowing architectural form, sculpted façades, and thoughtfully curated details. This serene retreat offers an elevated living environment where elegance, comfort, and artistry converge seamlessly, as every residence embodies exceptional quality, from premium materials to carefully designed layouts that maximize natural light and spatial harmony.

Arthouse Residences by Clédor is a boutique residential development on Al Marjan Island, conceived as a refined sanctuary for those drawn to art, culture, and contemporary design. The project blends coastal serenity with a curated creative atmosphere, where architecture, natural surroundings, and artistic expression come together in harmony. Its intimate scale and thoughtful design create a sense of exclusivity, offering residents a tranquil lifestyle immersed in beauty and inspiration.

projects.a: Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour
projects.ov: Life at Altan is a blissful getaway, where the creek shimmers, the city skyline inspires, and nature invites you to unwind. Glide through calm waters, stroll through vibrant promenades, and find peace in lush gardens. At Altan, home is more than just a place—it’s an experience.

S1LV1ANA Park is a contemporary residential development inspired by the concept of living in harmony with nature. Drawing its identity from the word “Silva,” meaning forest, the project is designed as a tranquil urban retreat where greenery, open spaces, and modern architecture come together to create a balanced lifestyle. The development offers a selection of studio, 1, 1.5, 2, and 2.5-bedroom residences, combining functionality, comfort, and contemporary design. Every aspect of the project reflects a commitment to well-being, sustainability, and a strong connection to the natural environment.

IR1DIAN Park 2 is a contemporary residential development located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), inspired by the concept of iridescence and the ever-changing interaction between light, color, and nature. Designed to create a vibrant yet comfortable living environment, the project combines modern architecture with practical layouts and abundant natural light. Its strategic location within one of Dubai’s most established residential communities provides residents with convenient access to major destinations across the city while maintaining a peaceful, neighborhood-oriented atmosphere.

projects.a: Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour
projects.ov: Albero is an exceptional new residential development offering a variety of stylish living options, including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments as well as spacious 3-bedroom townhouses. Nestled amidst lush greenery with views of creeks, cityscapes, and serene landscapes, Albero blends elegance and nature in perfect harmony.

V1STARA House 2 is a contemporary residential development designed to deliver a refined lifestyle centered on comfort, elegance, and modern functionality. Featuring sophisticated architecture and thoughtfully planned living spaces, the project combines contemporary design with practical everyday living. Located in the well-connected Al Furjan community, the development offers residents convenient access to key areas of Dubai while maintaining a peaceful, family-oriented atmosphere.

Golf Grove by Regent is a contemporary residential development where nature and refined design come together to create a მშვიდ and balanced living environment. Inspired by organic forms, the architecture blends clean lines with soft textures, allowing spaces to flow seamlessly between indoors and outdoors. Expansive windows invite natural light into every residence, enhancing the sense of openness and creating a calm, serene atmosphere throughout the project.

Perched on the edge of Emaar South Golf Course, Golf Verge is a gateway to endless green vistas and infinite inspiration. Here, vast emerald fairways unfold before you, an ever-changing landscape that mirrors your aspirations. Expansive glass windows frame sun-drenched views, turning every moment into a chance to dream, breathe, and embrace boundless potential.

Golf Meadow isn’t just about breathtaking views—it’s about the feeling these homes inspire. With floor-to-ceiling windows framing lush, endless greens, every home is a reminder that the best stories begin with a view. Some see a golf course; you see a canvas where your story to begins.

The Wilds by Aldar is a nature-led villa community where homes are designed to live as part of nature rather than apart from it. The community brings together Cassia Villas with three to five bedrooms, Ravenna Residences with four and five bedrooms, a majlis and driver's room, and a rare collection of five- and six-bedroom Moringa Mansions designed by Nabil Gholam Architects. Homes rise from a ground floor to one or three upper floors, and the mansions add a basement and a private rooftop terrace.

VERDANIA 2 is a nature-inspired residential development built around the principles of sustainability, wellness, and modern urban living. Drawing inspiration from the concept of “verde,” which symbolizes growth, renewal, and vitality, the project creates a harmonious connection between architecture and the natural environment. The development emphasizes green spaces, thoughtfully designed communal areas, and contemporary residences that provide a peaceful retreat from the fast-paced city lifestyle.

AYA Beachfront Residences is a contemporary residential development comprising 442 carefully designed residences. The project is distinguished by its fluid architectural language inspired by natural forms, with cascading terraces and a design approach that emphasizes harmony between built spaces and the surrounding environment. The development combines modern architecture with refined interior design, creating residences that prioritize natural light, spacious layouts, and a sophisticated yet understated aesthetic.

Parkwood offers an elevated living experience with stunning views of the Dubai skyline, blending nature and modern design. Developed to inspire community and connection, every detail is made to help you create lasting memories. Unwind, play, connect, or enjoy stunning views of Hillside Park at Parkwood. In this haven, life balances between tranquillity and activity.

Eden House The Park is a sophisticated residential community designed to offer an elegant and harmonious lifestyle. Featuring seven low-rise buildings, the community combines contemporary architecture with lush green landscapes, creating a peaceful urban sanctuary. Currently, only the first three buildings have been launched, introducing a selection of exquisitely designed residences that blend modern aesthetics with timeless comfort.

IR1DIAN Park is a contemporary residential development inspired by the concept of iridescence, where the interplay of light, color, and architectural form creates a distinctive living environment. The project is designed to blend modern aesthetics with practical functionality, offering residents a refined lifestyle defined by elegance, comfort, and visual harmony. Thoughtfully planned residences feature spacious layouts and abundant natural light, while the overall architectural design reflects a commitment to creating a vibrant and sophisticated community atmosphere that complements its surroundings.

Mews Mansions is an exclusive collection of just ten ultra-luxury residences, offering a refined interpretation of modern villa living. Each five-bedroom mansion is designed with a focus on elegance, space, and architectural clarity, combining contemporary forms with timeless detailing. The project features two distinct typologies — Noble and Royal — both crafted with expansive layouts, high ceilings, and a seamless indoor-outdoor flow that enhances privacy and sophistication, creating a true sanctuary of upscale living.

Marriott Residences Sheikh Zayed Road is a prestigious residential development offering a home where elegance meets comfort, blending inviting amenities with the world-renowned hospitality of Marriott Hotels. This exceptional project offers a choice of Two, Three-Bedroom, and Duplex Apartments, each crafted for modern sophistication with innovative appliances and contemporary design. Every residence features a modern, open-concept kitchen and living space, a spacious balcony with breathtaking views of Dubai, and large windows throughout that allow ample natural light.

Firoza is a refined residential development set within Dubai Islands, offering a curated collection of fully furnished apartments, townhouses, and duplexes. The project rises across eight residential floors with a dedicated parking level, presenting a contemporary architectural design defined by clean lines and balanced proportions. Each residence is thoughtfully planned with spacious layouts and modern interiors, creating a seamless blend of functionality, comfort, and understated elegance in a coastal-inspired setting.

Golf Dale is a stunning residential project located within the serene Emaar South community, offering an array of thoughtfully designed homes to suit different lifestyles. The development features modern 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and exclusive 3-bedroom townhouses, all meticulously crafted with spacious layouts and elegant finishes. Surrounded by lush greenery and set against the backdrop of a championship golf course, Golf Dale provides a tranquil escape for those seeking comfort and sophistication. The seamless blend of contemporary architecture with nature ensures that every home is a haven of peace and inspiration.

Golf Acres is a serene residential community located near Emaar South, offering a harmonious blend of modern living and natural surroundings. Designed as a peaceful retreat from the city, the development combines contemporary architecture with lush greenery, creating an environment focused on well-being, relaxation, and a balanced lifestyle.

Hillsedge is a premium residential development located within the vibrant Dubai Hills Estate, a pioneering destination in the heart of Dubai. Part of the expansive Mohammed Bin Rashid City, this exceptional community is nestled between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina, offering easy access to key city attractions and districts. Its strategic location provides a perfect blend of serene surroundings and proximity to the energetic urban lifestyle, making it an ideal place to call home.

TETR1S Tower is a distinctive residential development located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, combining contemporary architecture with artistic design elements. The tower is defined by its elegant curved form and interconnected architectural sections, creating a visually striking structure that symbolizes both individuality and unity. Designed to reflect Dubai’s spirit of innovation and luxury, the project offers a modern residential environment where sophisticated aesthetics, functional layouts, and high-quality construction come together to create a unique urban living experience.

Peace Homes Development presents a contemporary residential project Peace Lagoons 2, designed to bring together comfort, functionality, and a sense of private luxury. The development offers a thoughtfully curated selection of studios, one-bedroom residences with a study, and two-bedroom homes with a study, all created for modern lifestyles that value both practicality and elegance. What makes the project especially distinctive is the inclusion of a private pool with every residence, transforming each home into a personal retreat defined by privacy and relaxation.

Park Five is a contemporary residential development comprising five residential buildings, with the initial phase introducing Towers A and B. The project offers a selection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments designed around a concept that combines modern architectural forms with subtle traditional Arabian design influences. Geometric façades, biophilic design principles, spacious balconies, water features, and thoughtfully integrated communal elements create a cohesive residential environment focused on comfort, functionality, and community living.

Zephyra Residences by Arsenal East is a premium waterfront development of two contemporary buildings set within a calm island setting. Cascading balconies inspired by sand dunes create a striking facade that blends with the natural landscape. Each building rises above parking levels to ten residential floors, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom duplexes, townhouses and three-bedroom penthouses, catering to a wide range of lifestyles from couples to growing families.

Mandarin Oriental Residences is an exclusive branded collection created by Aldar in collaboration with the world-renowned Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group. Two elegant buildings, each rising from a ground floor to nine residential floors, feature light facades, natural materials and flowing lines that radiate calm and harmony, with the warmth of wood complemented by metallic accents. The collection ranges from one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom residences to five-bedroom penthouses, offering views of landmark museums.

ESSENL1FE Residence is a contemporary residential development located in Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT), conceived around the concept of balance and well-being inspired by the essence of life. The project is designed to create a calm and purposeful living environment within the city, offering residents a sense of harmony amid Dubai’s dynamic urban rhythm. Through thoughtful architecture and a refined aesthetic, ESSENL1FE Residence positions itself as a modern sanctuary for individuals and families seeking comfort, meaning, and everyday serenity.

Rivage is a luxury residential development offering a diverse collection of residences, including one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, duplexes, sky villas, and ultra-exclusive sky palaces. The project is defined by its contemporary architecture, characterized by sculptural forms and elegant lines inspired by natural elements. Residences are designed with spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and an emphasis on natural light, creating sophisticated living environments that combine modern design with a strong sense of openness.

AUREL1A Residence is a contemporary residential development designed to offer a harmonious balance between modern living, comfort, and functionality. The project features a collection of studios, 1, 2, and 3.5-bedroom apartments, catering to a wide range of lifestyles and household sizes. Characterized by its contemporary architecture and thoughtfully planned layouts, the development is positioned within one of Dubai’s dynamic residential communities, providing residents with a sustainable and community-oriented living environment. The project also incorporates smart home technology, enhancing convenience and efficiency in everyday life.

Mamsha Gardens is an elegant residential community on Saadiyat Island, thoughtfully designed to bring together contemporary architecture, lush natural surroundings, and the cultural richness of Abu Dhabi’s most prestigious district. Comprising seven beautifully crafted buildings, the development offers a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside spacious two- and three-bedroom townhouses. Located just moments from world-renowned landmarks such as Louvre Abu Dhabi and the future Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, Mamsha Gardens creates a refined living environment where art, nature, and modern design exist in perfect harmony.

The Community Sports Arena by AQUA Properties is a vibrant mixed-use residential tower designed around convenience, wellness and an active, connected lifestyle. Contemporary architecture with a striking silhouette combines form and function, while the building rises above four basement levels and a ground floor to twenty-one residential floors. The collection offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, complemented by retail outlets and on-site services that keep everyday needs within walking distance of every home.

The Corner is a contemporary residential development designed to deliver a balanced lifestyle through modern architecture and functional living spaces. The project offers a diverse collection of residences, including studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious three-bedroom duplexes. Clean architectural lines and thoughtfully planned layouts create a sense of openness and comfort, making each home both practical and refined for everyday living.

Marina Cove is an exclusive development nestled in one of the most desirable locations within Dubai Marina, seamlessly blending the vibrancy of city living with the serenity of waterfront life. This unique community offers residents a perfect balance of luxury, convenience, and tranquility, making it an ideal retreat for those seeking a refined urban lifestyle.

Natuzzi Harmony Residences is a refined waterfront development on Dubai Islands, created to bring together the serenity of island living and the sophistication of contemporary design. Developed by Peace Homes Development, the project offers a distinctive residential experience shaped by elegant architecture, a calm coastal atmosphere, and a strong sense of privacy. Positioned in one of Dubai’s most promising beachfront destinations, it presents a lifestyle defined by comfort, beauty, and effortless connection to the city.

V1STARA House is envisioned as a symbol of growth, prosperity, and boundless potential, drawing inspiration from the Sanskrit word “Vistara,” meaning expansion. The project presents a striking residential tower that seamlessly blends contemporary luxury with timeless design principles, creating an environment where families can truly thrive. More than just a place to live, V1STARA House is conceived as a space that encourages aspiration, balance, and long-term wellbeing.

Porto View is a luxurious waterfront residential development located in the prestigious Mina Rashid district of Dubai. Offering breathtaking views of the marina and beyond, the project is designed to enhance these panoramic vistas with expansive windows that invite natural light and frame the serene surroundings. With lush greenery and the tranquil ambiance of the marina, each residence at Porto View is a retreat into luxury and nature.

The new global destination for discerning yacht owners to experience Dubai’s buzzing scene in an elegant environment where beauty and luxury collide. Designed to encapsulate the ultimate modern architecture, it combines luxury residences and a full-service marina with an appealing mix of restaurants and shops, creating a unique definition of “living at sea”.

Golf Hillside is first and foremost a place designed to nurture well-being. Every apartment is carefully planned to flood your space with natural light, offering a sense of openness and tranquility. From balcony, you’ll look out onto the vast green fairways of the Dubai Hills Golf Course and the charming villa communities nearby. This is where comfort meets nature, in the best possible way.

V1VID Tower is a contemporary residential development in Dubai that presents a refined approach to modern urban living. The project is designed to combine comfort, functionality, and a high standard of design, offering residents a well-balanced lifestyle within a dynamic city environment. Thoughtfully planned residences cater to a wide range of living preferences, creating an address that appeals to both end-users and long-term residents seeking quality and convenience.

The architectural style of Golf Point combines modern design with natural elements. Featuring a contemporary façade and an earthy palette both inside and out, the buildings harmoniously blend with the surrounding landscape, offering a sophisticated and tranquil living environment.

Emaar Properties presents Club Place, a premium residential development offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. The project combines contemporary sophistication with the refined elegance associated with Palace Hotels Resorts, surrounded by lush greenery.

Altus by Emaar offers a diverse selection of city-inspired residences. The 1-bedroom units, perfect for individuals or couples, provide expansive living spaces and stunning city views. The 2 and 3-bedroom suites elevate the luxury experience, featuring modern bathrooms, spacious closets, and panoramic balconies that create spaces truly at the heart of urban living.

Ghaff Land Residence is a contemporary mid-rise development designed to offer a balanced and comfortable urban lifestyle. Rising eight storeys, the project features a clean architectural expression with well-proportioned façades and thoughtfully arranged living spaces. A selection of studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious duplex units, are designed with smart layouts and large windows that maximize natural light, creating bright, airy interiors that feel both modern and welcoming.

Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Ocean Cove, where nature and city life come together to create a truly captivating atmosphere. Nestled in the heart of Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Cove offers a refined lifestyle that blends the peaceful charm of a luxurious waterfront community with the vibrant, diverse energy of Dubai. It’s a place where luxury meets comfort, all set against the tranquil backdrop of a lush greenery.

Verdes by Haven is an apartment collection within the first wellness-inspired community in the city, created by Aldar to bring health, comfort and nature into everyday life. The development is made up of residential buildings ranging from four to seventeen storeys, with selected buildings including a podium, and an iconic Treehouse at the entrance built around a majestic tree. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom duplexes, finished in light and dark schemes with natural tones.

Offering breathtaking views of the Creek and Creek Island, Palace Residences Creek Blue has style of the prestigious Palace hotel brand. The property is nestled in a special district near Creek been meticulously crafted to provide you with not only a home, but also a lifestyle in the true Beach, ideal for those looking for an active way of life.

Peace Lagoons by Peace Homes Group is a contemporary residential development in Dubailand (DLRC), designed around a distinctive water-inspired lifestyle. With its elegant mid-rise architecture, the project brings together modern design and a tranquil resort-like atmosphere, centered around a stunning lagoon and cascading waterfall. The result is a serene and visually striking living environment where the calming presence of water becomes an essential part of everyday life.

Tonino Lamborghini Residences by Gulf Land Property Developers is an exclusive residential address located in Nad Al Sheba, where bold design meets refined Italian-inspired aesthetics. The architecture reflects a contemporary vision defined by clean lines, expressive forms, and a strong attention to detail, creating a distinctive identity within one of Dubai’s most prestigious neighborhoods. Each residence is thoughtfully designed to balance visual impact with functionality, delivering living spaces that feel both dynamic and sophisticated.

Athlon by Aldar is the first community in the city designed to make movement a natural part of everyday life, created by Aldar in partnership with Dubai Holding. Developed around active design principles with leading wellbeing experts and athletes, it seamlessly merges walking and cycling loops with lush green parks and social spaces across nine residential clusters. The community offers luxury four-bedroom townhouses and four-, five- and six-bedroom standard and premium villas, rising from a ground floor to one or two upper floors.

Edgewater Residences 1, 2 & 3 is an exclusive waterfront development on Dubai Islands, offering a refined coastal lifestyle in one of the city's most prestigious destinations. Designed by renowned American architects AYENK, the project combines contemporary architecture with breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf, creating a seamless balance between modern elegance and natural beauty. The development features a curated collection of premium residences thoughtfully designed with spacious layouts, abundant natural light, and expansive terraces that embrace the surrounding waterfront setting.

projects.n: Arka Enclave Residences by Atmosphere Living
projects.ov: Arka Enclave is a refined waterfront development set within Dubai Islands, inspired by the tranquility of Maldivian island living and reinterpreted through contemporary architecture. The design features layered forms, expansive terraces, and full-height windows that invite natural light and sea breezes into every residence, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. With its calm aesthetic and thoughtful composition, the project offers a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes that balance resort-style serenity with modern urban sophistication.

Elle Residences by ANAX Developments is a premium waterfront collection created in partnership with the international lifestyle media brand ELLE, whose editorial aesthetic shapes every architectural detail. Sculpted forms and panoramic glass facades define the building, which rises from a ground floor and a two-level podium to ten residential floors. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with exclusive three- and four-bedroom townhouses, many with expansive terraces overlooking the marina and the open horizon.

Avida Residences is a forward-thinking wellness-focused development set within the evolving waterfront destination of Dubai Islands. The architecture is guided by biophilic design principles, blending soft, organic forms with natural materials and integrated greenery to create a calm and restorative environment. Designed as a holistic lifestyle destination, the project offers a refined collection of one- to three-bedroom apartments and exclusive penthouses, all featuring open layouts, abundant natural light, and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living.

Helvetia Verde presents a refined residential concept where contemporary design meets a sense of privacy and exclusivity. The development comprises a limited collection of just 108 residences, offering thoughtfully planned 1, 2, and 3.5-bedroom apartments. Its architectural approach is defined by clean lines, balanced proportions, and a modern aesthetic that emphasizes both functionality and elegance, creating a calm and sophisticated living environment within a dynamic urban setting.

Future Residence by True Future Real Estate Development is an exceptional residential project poised to redefine luxury living. This modern landmark features sleek lines and warm lighting, blending contemporary design with natural surroundings. Offering a refined selection of one-bedroom apartments, units with private pools, and spacious two-and-a-half-bedroom residences, each home is thoughtfully planned with high-quality finishes and integrated smart home systems, providing sweeping views of Dubai’s iconic skyline and surrounding greenery.

Saray Prime Residences is a modern residential development designed to combine comfort, elegance, and everyday convenience. Rising with a serene presence at the edge of the city, the project offers a curated collection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully designed to maximize space and natural light. With open layouts and high-quality finishes, Saray Prime creates a welcoming environment where residents can enjoy both privacy and a strong sense of community.

Villa Del Arte is a refined residential address located on Dubai Islands, where contemporary elegance meets a sophisticated coastal lifestyle. The project presents a carefully curated collection of apartments and duplex residences, designed with balanced proportions, thoughtful layouts, and a strong emphasis on modern luxury. Set within a prestigious waterfront setting, Villa Del Arte establishes a new benchmark for stylish living defined by quality, comfort, and architectural finesse.

Fiori Residences is a contemporary residential development in Town Square Dubai, offering a refined collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, alongside spacious three-bedroom duplexes. Ideally positioned at the top of Town Square Park, the project combines sweeping views of lush green spaces and the vibrant central boulevard with a calm, family-friendly atmosphere. Its architecture is defined by clean lines, warm tones, and expansive windows, creating bright and elegant interiors that balance modern style, comfort, and everyday functionality.

Enta Residences is a boutique waterfront development located in Mina Al Arab, offering a refined collection of studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments. Each residence is thoughtfully designed with a blend of raw textures, natural tones, and elegant details, creating a distinctive and modern living environment. The project emphasizes individuality, allowing each home to become a personal expression of style and comfort.

Elevia Residences is a modern architectural statement by Valores Property Development, blending sleek lines with timeless design. Developed with a focus on craftsmanship and quality, this contemporary complex offers a collection of studios and one and two-bedroom apartments, where every detail has been carefully considered to deliver a premium lifestyle experience. The minimalist facade features wide panoramic windows and glass balconies, creating an elegant and stylish exterior that stands as a symbol of contemporary living.

Timber Terrace is an elegant residential project, offering a refined lifestyle in a well-planned community. The development features a carefully selected collection of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully crafted with quality finishes, spacious layouts, and attention to detail. Developed by Vakson Development, a trusted name with over five decades of success in Dubai, Timber Terrace combines modern living with excellent long-term value.

Wellington Ocean Walk is a stunning waterfront development that brings the beauty of island living right to your doorstep, just moments from the water. This refined project offers a curated selection of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments designed for modern comfort and stylish living. Every detail reflects quality, creating a home that feels both elegant and welcoming, while the exclusive island setting adds a sense of prestige and serenity.

Sol Luxe is a sixty-three-storey architectural marvel by SOL Properties. Designed as a freehold sanctuary for those who wish to live, work, and thrive at the center of Dubai's beating heart, this landmark tower merges lifestyle, prestige, and connectivity. Inspired by zen philosophy and contemporary minimalism, its fluid forms and reflective surfaces capture light and movement, while bronze-wrapped horizontal bands and curved tinted glass create a rhythm that is both timeless and dynamic.

Emerge Residences is a boutique residential address set within Meydan City, designed to balance contemporary urban living with a calm, retreat-like atmosphere. The architecture combines soft geometry, expansive glazing, and natural stone elements, creating a composition that feels both refined and effortlessly connected to its surroundings. Framed by green corridors and future infrastructure, the development offers a seamless blend of accessibility and privacy, while thoughtfully planned one- to three-bedroom residences feature open layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a strong emphasis on light, flow, and modern elegance.

Mi Casa by London Gate is a boutique residential and commercial development that combines contemporary architecture with a focus on privacy, comfort, and convenience. With a limited collection of just 72 apartments and 4 retail spaces, the project creates an intimate living environment designed for those who value exclusivity and a well-balanced lifestyle. The residences include studios, one- and two-bedroom units, thoughtfully planned to maximize space efficiency and create a warm, modern atmosphere.

Villa Del Brunello at Dubai Islands is a masterpiece that blends Italian elegance with beachfront living, offering an exclusive collection of 1, 2, 3, and 4 bedroom apartments along with 2, 3, and 4 bedroom duplexes. Just a 90-second walk from the beach, this project redefines coastal luxury with refined architecture and carefully curated interiors. Every residence is semi-furnished with premium Italian design, including Antoniolupi bathrooms, SMEG appliances, Zonda lighting, and stylish Italian kitchens.

Mangrove Village is an exclusive gated community of four- and five-bedroom villas that has established itself as one of the most sought-after neighbourhoods in the capital and is open to buyers of all nationalities. Each villa rises from a ground floor to a first floor and is planned around generously proportioned entertaining and living spaces, verandas and expansive private gardens. A maid's room, a separate laundry room, independent chilling systems and ample storage make every home practical for large families.

Manam Pearl is a contemporary residential development inspired by the elegance and timeless beauty of a pearl. Rising 11 storeys, the project offers a collection of one-, two-and-a-half-, and three-and-a-half-bedroom apartments designed to combine modern architecture with functional living. Spacious open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and soft natural color palettes create bright, welcoming interiors that emphasize comfort, sophistication, and everyday practicality. Every residence is thoughtfully designed to provide a refined living environment with a seamless balance of style and functionality.

projects.n: Four Seasons Private Residences Abu Dhabi at Saadiyat Beach
projects.ov: Four Seasons Private Residences Abu Dhabi at Saadiyat Beach is an exclusive beachfront collection of branded suites and villas delivered with the legendary Four Seasons touch. Architecture inspired by the natural surroundings is framed by lush greenery and azure water. The suites building rises above a basement and a ground floor to six residential floors, offering two-, three- and four-bedroom suites, including duplex suites, while the villas rise over two floors and offer five- and six-bedroom homes.

Vida Residences Saadiyat Island is a contemporary, pet-friendly residential building curated for lifestyle seekers, global citizens and cultural enthusiasts. Signature contemporary architecture with flowing lines, panoramic windows and inviting public spaces creates a calm, design-led atmosphere where culture, comfort and community combine. The building rises above a podium level to six residential floors and a roof, offering a limited collection of one-, two- and three-bedroom residences with views towards the beach and the cultural landmarks of the island.

Rivo is envisioned as a living sculpture, where architecture flows with elegance and balance. Its design merges clean white contours, warm wood accents, and expansive glass facades, creating an impression of movement and calm. Each level appears to float above the next, with curves that soften the structure’s presence and invite natural light into every residence. The result is a building that embodies harmony and timeless sophistication.

Belle Vie is a refined residential address by Zimaya Properties, set within the dynamic community of Dubai Silicon Oasis. Rising across eight levels, the architecture reflects a contemporary approach defined by clean lines, balanced proportions, and a focus on light-filled living spaces. The project offers a diverse selection of residences, from studios to expansive multi-bedroom layouts, thoughtfully designed to combine functionality with elegance. Carefully planned interiors, including private study areas and maid’s rooms in select units, create homes that feel both practical and elevated.

The Haven 3 is an exclusive residential development by Meraki Developers that brings together contemporary architecture, elegant design, and a strong focus on quality living. Offering a limited collection of just 83 residences, including studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, the project is designed to provide spacious interiors, abundant natural light, and a tranquil atmosphere. Its clean architectural lines, cascading greenery, and refined aesthetic create a sophisticated environment where modern comfort blends seamlessly with nature.

Beach House at Bay Residences is an exclusive beachfront development that redefines coastal living through sophisticated architecture and direct access to pristine sands. Expansive terraces seamlessly connect indoor spaces with the shoreline, while panoramic sea views create a constant sense of serenity and escape. The project blends elegance with comfort, offering a refined seaside lifestyle where every detail is designed to enhance the natural beauty of the surroundings.

Marquis One is a contemporary residential development that combines elegant architecture with thoughtfully designed living spaces. The project offers a collection of studios and multi-bedroom residences, including exclusive layouts with private pools, creating a refined residential environment tailored to modern lifestyles. Defined by its sleek architectural lines, expansive windows, and carefully planned interiors, Marquis One emphasizes natural light, spaciousness, and functional design while delivering a sophisticated living experience with a strong attention to detail.

Beverly Park at DLRC is a refined low-rise residential development that expresses contemporary elegance through clean architectural lines, soft curves, and warm-toned materials. Designed as a boutique six-storey building, it creates a sense of intimacy while maintaining a strong architectural presence. The project blends modern aesthetics with functional planning, where open layouts, natural light, and thoughtful spatial flow shape a comfortable and balanced living environment aligned with today’s lifestyle needs.

Oasis Residences is a masterpiece of contemporary residential design, distinguished by its polished architectural language and thoughtful design approach, which seamlessly blends functionality with refined elegance. This exquisite development presents a modern silhouette with meticulous proportions, where bold lines converge with elegant detailing, resulting in a sophisticated and comfortable urban living environment. The residence offers a diverse range of layouts, from intimate studios to spacious three-bedroom apartments, each carefully crafted to maximize space, harness natural light, and optimize functionality.

Verde by Vision is a masterfully designed residential development, boasting a thoughtful and well-balanced layout that seamlessly integrates spacious underground parking, a welcoming entrance, and meticulously planned residential levels, all crowned by a rooftop oasis dedicated to leisure and lifestyle amenities. This striking development is home to an impressive collection of modern apartments, each one tailored to provide a harmonious blend of comfort, efficiency, and contemporary elegance, with generous layouts, an abundance of natural light, and a fresh aesthetic that epitomizes the essence of modern urban living.

The Serene at Sobha Central is a breathtakingly beautiful residential project that elevates Dubai's skyline with its cutting-edge, futuristic design, showcasing sleek lines and glass façades that epitomize modern sophistication. Nestled within a lush green landscape and urban framework, the towers rise majestically, their crystalline structures evoking an aura of timeless elegance as they offer unobstructed panoramic views. This masterpiece of architecture seamlessly blends nature and urbanity, creating a unique and captivating ambiance that redefines the concept of luxurious living.

Blue Marina Residence is a visionary waterfront project, offering an elevated coastal lifestyle that combines comfort, connectivity, and convenience. Nestled between serene marina views and lush surroundings, this unique development blends modern architecture with natural beauty, wellness with luxury, and activity with relaxation. Designed for those seeking both a vibrant community and a peaceful escape, it positions residents at the heart of Dubai's newest premium waterfront destination with direct access by land and sea.

SquareX One is a residential development located in the vibrant community. Thoughtfully designed by Tasmeer Indigo Properties, the project brings together sleek contemporary architecture and lush outdoor zones to offer residents a lifestyle rooted in wellness, nature, and urban convenience. With a focus on vibrant city living, the tower features expansive terraces, panoramic views, and a façade that reflects modern elegance, creating homes that are both sophisticated and welcoming.

Trevino by Avelon Developments is a low-rise boutique residential building that brings contemporary architecture and a tranquil natural setting together. Its tiered design creates a cascading composition of levels, where architecture, landscape and comfort meet, and enhances the connection between indoor and outdoor spaces. The building rises above a ground floor and a podium to five residential floors, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments with views over the surrounding green belt.

projects.n: Bab Al Qasr Canal View Residence 22
projects.ov: Bab Al Qasr Canal View Residence 22 is a masterpiece of waterfront development, expertly blending elegant interiors, breathtaking canal views, and the allure of hotel-branded living. This refined residential destination seamlessly merge comfort, luxury, and investment potential, making it a haven for discerning end-users and astute investors seeking a distinctive lifestyle by the water. The development's design showcases sophisticated glass towers, redefining waterfront living with an emphasis on unobstructed canal vistas and serene sea views.

The Weave – Al Ghurair is a contemporary residential building designed by the award-winning Australian architect Joe Adsett. Its facade is inspired by the traditional weaving of palm fronds, with captivating angles and intertwining balconies that create a dialogue between heritage and modernity. The building rises above a ground floor and a five-level podium to thirteen residential floors and a rooftop, and offers one- and two-bedroom apartments and a limited selection of three-bedroom homes with a maid's room or study.

Uno-Luxe by WOW Resorts is a refined residential concept that blends the elegance of five-star hospitality with the intimacy of private living. Designed as a lifestyle-driven sanctuary, the project elevates everyday experiences through thoughtful design, premium service, and a seamless fusion of comfort and luxury. It reflects a vision where every detail contributes to a harmonious and elevated way of life.

Woodland Terraces by AMIS is a refined residential building with minimalist facades, generous glazing and panoramic windows that give it an elegant, contemporary presence. The building rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to five residential floors and a rooftop. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments, one-bedroom apartments with a study and two- and three-bedroom homes with open-plan layouts and high ceilings, together with retail units at ground level for everyday convenience.

Arib Collection by ARIB Developments is a contemporary residential building that blends elegance, comfort and functionality. A modern facade with crisp, clean lines gives the architecture a refined and timeless character, while the building rises from a ground floor to eight residential floors. The collection offers a carefully curated selection of studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, with selected two-bedroom layouts including an additional room suitable for a study or home office.

Berkeley Square by Prestige One is a refined residential development that channels the timeless elegance of Victorian-era London through a distinctly modern lens. With its stately U-shaped façade, classical symmetry, and pale-toned exterior contrasted by dark metal accents, the architecture conveys a sense of quiet sophistication and enduring style. At the heart of the building, a beautifully designed central courtyard draws in light and calm, creating a serene atmosphere that elevates the entire living experience.

Residences Du Port Autograph Collection is an exclusive waterfront development in Dubai Marina, where Riviera-inspired elegance meets contemporary urban living. The architecture reflects a refined European aesthetic, with clean lines, expansive terraces, and a seamless connection to the marina promenade.

Solera Downtown Mina is a refined residential development by RAK Properties, situated in the emerging core of Mina's new downtown. This sophisticated address offers a collection of studios, one, two, and three-bedroom suites, and penthouses, each designed with a nod to classic proportion and quiet grandeur. Here, city living isn't a compromise — it's a statement, where broad boulevards, curated spaces, and effortless sophistication converge just moments from the coast.

Sea Legend Tower One rises gracefully along the shoreline, embodying the future of upscale coastal living. This prestigious residential building blends architectural elegance with advanced smart-home functionality, creating an environment where luxury and innovation coexist seamlessly. Designed to cater to discerning residents seeking both aesthetic appeal and practical comfort, the tower offers a living experience that is both sophisticated and effortlessly connected.

Avana Residences is a stunning masterpiece of modern luxury, where thoughtful architecture and elegant interior design converge to create a refined residential experience. Each residence is a serene oasis of light and space, with expansive windows that seamlessly bridge the indoors and outdoors, while carefully designed layouts prioritize both functionality and aesthetic beauty. The architectural language of the development is inspired by the soothing rhythms of the sea, evident in its soft, flowing lines and subtle design motifs that evoke the tranquility of marine life and coastal serenity.

Viera Residences is a distinctive development, offering a curated selection of studio, one, and two-bedroom apartments with superior finishes and serene views. Designed for those who value style, space, and sophistication, it features exceptional amenities, including a pool, two landscaped outdoor lounges, a children’s play area, a multipurpose hall, a gym, and a sauna. Viera combines modern design with thoughtful details, redefining contemporary living in a tranquil setting.

Gate Eleven Residences stands as a premium development comprising four adjacent buildings that are deliberately positioned to capture uninterrupted lagoon vistas while delivering an elevated aura of exclusivity. The architecture celebrates contemporary elegance, intertwining refined craftsmanship with sustainable design principles, and each interior space balances sophisticated aesthetics with practical functionality. An emphasis on high‑quality construction and innovative urban planning also establishes a new benchmark for administrative environments within the region.

Peninsula Three is a residential tower by Select Group, designed by the architectural studio Killa Design. The slender high-rise rises above a landscaped podium, and its glazed facades are oriented to open up wide views from every apartment. The tower brings together studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, crowned by a viewing deck on its upper level.

Renad Tower by Tiger Group is an exciting launch, marking the developer's first project in the emirate. This thirty-seven-storey tower on the Gulf Coast combines classical architectural elements with refined luxury, offering a wide range of studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments. Each residence is designed in a contemporary style and comes fully furnished, with private balconies featuring panoramic views of the canal and cityscape, promising a luxurious living experience with a breathtaking perspective of nature.

Volga Tower by Tiger is a remarkable development where luxury living reaches new heights. This stunning residence offers fully furnished apartments in one, two, three, and four-bedroom configurations, each with the added luxury of a private balcony pool. Immerse yourself in a lifestyle of opulence and convenience in the heart of this captivating masterpiece, where your dream of luxurious living with every convenience is transformed into reality.

Red Square by Tiger Group is a contemporary residential development located in the vibrant community, introducing a collection of studio, one, and two-bedroom apartments. Standing as a testament to Tiger Group's commitment to delivering quality residences in one of Dubai's sought-after neighborhoods, Red Square seamlessly combines style and functionality, offering residents a comfortable and well-appointed space to call home. These towers represent elegance, providing an unmatched level of comfort and sophistication in everyday lifestyle.

Faradis Tower by Tiger Properties marks a pinnacle of luxurious living a locale revered for its scenic beauty and vibrant lifestyle at the border between Dubai and Sharjah. This fifty-storey residential building offers an array of exquisite apartments for sale, including one, two, three, and four-bedroom units. Designed to cater to a wide range of preferences, each residence features modern interiors and unparalleled views, creating a living experience that is both sophisticated and inspiring.

Jade Tower is a striking reminder of luxury and magnificence, embodying the sophisticated and elegant lifestyle of the area. With contemporary style and streamlined lines that honor refinement and grace, this tower's remarkable presence in the skyline reflects the beauty of its surroundings while serving as a source of inspiration. Every glance from your window promises a new perspective, and every corner whispers tales of indulgence and sophistication.

Trinity Residences is a residential tower by Karma Developers, offering a resort-inspired address that pairs sleek modern architecture with an extensive outdoor amenity podium. The building comprises 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, designed with floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary finishes that bring abundant natural light into every room; select layouts include a private jacuzzi on the balcony. The concept leans into resort living throughout — from the infinity pool at its centre to the landscaped gardens and grand welcome lobby that set the tone on arrival.

Park Beach Residence is a luxury residential development in Ras Al Khaimah, located in a resort setting and designed around modern comfort and coastal living. The development offers a selection of apartments with panoramic views of the sea and white sandy beaches, creating a tranquil residential environment. Its contemporary design combines functionality, comfort, and a sophisticated atmosphere suited to both everyday living and relaxation.

Olivia Residences is a contemporary residential development by Karma Developers, presented by Deca. The building offers a selection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments with spacious floor plans, designed to provide a comfortable residential environment with views of the surrounding greenery. Located adjacent to The Greens community within Dubai Investment Park, the development offers a family-oriented setting surrounded by landscaped areas.

Milos Residences is a residential building by Karma Developers, rising 13 storeys with a distinctive wave-like façade of curved balconies wrapped in white banding against a glass envelope. The architecture centres on a dialogue between indoor and outdoor living: poolside balconies and terraces run throughout the building, offering residents a retreat with views over the Dubai skyline. The development offers 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, each designed with an emphasis on modern elegance, natural light and a calm, uncluttered aesthetic — captured in the project's own positioning as "the gentle side of life."

Fleurs de Jardin is an exclusive limited collection of luxury villas and mansions presented by AMIS Development in collaboration with the legendary jewelry house Jacob & Co. This gated community is inspired by the brand’s signature timepieces, conceived as an ever-changing landscape where form, light, and color come alive. Each residence is defined by bespoke finishes and exquisite craftsmanship, designed to be experienced slowly and lived in fully.

Vision Iconic is a striking Mercedes-branded residential landmark developed by Binghatti in the prestigious Meydan district. The tower features a thoughtfully planned structure comprising a basement level, ground floor, five podium levels, sixty-five residential floors, nine mechanical floors, and a rooftop, creating a bold architectural presence on Dubai’s skyline. The development presents an exclusive collection of one- to five-bedroom apartments, designed to accommodate a variety of lifestyles.

Project Maybach is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, situated in the prestigious Meydan district. The tower features a well-planned structure comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine level, five podium levels, 24 residential floors, a dedicated mechanical floor, and a rooftop. The project offers a curated selection of studios as well as one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit a variety of lifestyles.

One by Binghatti is a distinguished development offering properties designed to provide residents with spacious and comfortable living environments, highlighted by modern interiors and high-quality finishes. The building features a unique façade with intricately designed balconies that offer privacy while ensuring ample natural light and ventilation. Utilizing modern construction techniques and architectural design, this exceptional project represents the perfect blend of contemporary elegance and functional living.

Mercedes-Benz Places | Binghatti is a landmark residential hyper-tower that redefines contemporary architecture through a fusion of innovation, elegance, and iconic design. Inspired by the Mercedes-Benz philosophy of Sensual Purity, the tower features bold proportions, fluid lines, and a distinctive façade incorporating elements of the three-pointed star, creating a powerful and recognizable presence within the skyline. The project embodies a seamless balance between beauty and functionality, offering a new vision of modern urban living shaped by precision and sophistication.

Maybach Ultimate Luxury is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. The project features two striking towers, each comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, and an elegant residential structure - with nineteen floors in Tower A and twenty-five in Tower B. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors.

JAD 288 is a thoughtfully designed residential project that blends modern city living with a calm, wellness-focused atmosphere, creating a truly inviting place to call home. The development offers a selection of stylish studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, each carefully planned to maximize comfort, space, and natural light. With its refined concept rooted in wellbeing and everyday convenience, stands out as an exceptional choice for both living and investment.

Maybach 6 is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development featuring two striking towers by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. Tower A rises with 30 residential floors, while Tower B reaches 34 residential levels, and both buildings are thoughtfully designed with a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, two mechanical floors, and a rooftop, creating an impressive architectural presence. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, carefully planned to suit diverse lifestyles.

J188 is a boutique, wellness-focused residential development by JAD Global. Designed around the principles of neuroarchitecture, the project emphasizes the connection between living spaces and human wellbeing, creating a calm, balanced, and restorative environment for modern urban living. The architecture follows a minimalist approach, with clean lines and carefully articulated facades that play with light and shadow to create a refined and tranquil aesthetic.
