The project offers a selection of thoughtfully designed 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, alongside commercial spaces.

Al Thuraya Island delivers a distinguished portfolio of villas alongside expansive eight‑bedroom mansions, each crafted with a harmonious marriage of sleek modern lines and enduring traditional motifs. The architecture showcases generous living spaces, floor‑to‑ceiling windows and open‑plan layouts that flood interiors with natural light while framing uninterrupted vistas of lush gardens and serene waters. Every residence benefits from thoughtfully positioned balconies that blur the boundaries between indoor comfort and the surrounding seascape.

projects.n: Burj Binghatti Jacob and Co Residences
projects.ov: Burj Binghatti is an iconic ultra-luxury residential tower located in Business Bay, defined by its record-breaking height and distinctive architectural identity. Rising over 112 storeys, the tower features a striking crown-inspired pinnacle designed in collaboration with Jacob & Co, creating a bold silhouette within Dubai’s skyline. The project offers an exclusive collection of two- and three-bedroom suites, as well as exceptional penthouses and sky villas, all designed with expansive layouts, panoramic views, and a seamless blend of elegance and innovation.

Bugatti Residences by Binghatti is an ultra-luxury residential development located in Business Bay, defined by its iconic architectural identity and collaboration with the renowned Bugatti brand. Derby Heights by AMIS is a boutique residential building that offers a quieter kind of city living, with interiors curated as a spatial edit by Casamia. A design that balances simplicity, beauty and comfort creates a calm, contemporary urban retreat. The building rises above a basement and a ground floor to four residential floors and a rooftop, offering one-bedroom apartments with a study, one-and-a-half-bedroom apartments and two- and three-bedroom homes with open-plan layouts.

Elire Managed by LUX is a private sanctuary where contemporary luxury meets serene design, boasting an architecture that seamlessly blends lush gardens, grand interiors, curated amenities, and five-star service into a refined urban retreat. This exquisite development offers a limited collection of exclusively crafted residences, each carefully designed with custom-designed furnishings to cater to those who appreciate quiet elegance. The interiors of these residences embody balance, with spaces that feel both intimate and expansive, and attention to detail permeating every finish, making each home a masterpiece.

Franck Muller Yachting by London Gate is a landmark waterfront development in Dubai Maritime City that redefines modern coastal living through a unique blend of architectural innovation and timeless elegance. Inspired by the heritage of the renowned Swiss watchmaker, the project reflects precision, craftsmanship, and refined design, expressed through its sleek façade and marine-influenced aesthetics, creating a distinctive identity within Dubai’s skyline.

SkyGate Tower by Tiger Properties is an architectural statement, designed to balance urban sophistication with natural serenity. The tower's sleek glass façade rises gracefully against Dubai's skyline, complemented by landscaped atriums and green spaces that breathe life into the structure. Featuring fully furnished residences crafted for contemporary comfort and style, each home blends modern aesthetics with functional design, offering elegant layouts and panoramic views of the city where every detail reflects luxury and refinement.

Nourelle by Meraas is a refined architectural composition set within the prestigious Madinat Jumeirah Living community, where contemporary design meets natural harmony. Sculptural forms, clean lines, and softly layered greenery define the façade, creating a seamless dialogue between urban elegance and tranquil surroundings. The residences, ranging from one- to four-bedroom apartments, are thoughtfully designed with open layouts, expansive terraces, and floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light while framing captivating views of the city skyline.

Reef 997 is an extraordinary residential project, setting a high standard for modern beachfront living. Offering a rare collection of stylish one and two-bedroom apartments, spacious three-bedroom duplexes, and a signature four-bedroom penthouse, each home is carefully designed with high ceilings, panoramic windows, and premium finishes that combine timeless elegance with modern functionality. More than just a residence, Reef 997 is a statement of refined living, offering a serene island retreat with the vibrant heartbeat of Dubai close at hand.

Burj Capital is a landmark commercial development by Centurion Properties, designed as a bold and iconic business destination in Business Bay. The architecture reflects power and exclusivity, with a striking silhouette that defines its presence on the skyline and creates a strong visual identity. Created for visionaries and industry leaders, the project offers premium office spaces that combine functionality with a prestigious corporate image, making it a standout address for ambitious businesses.

Capital One JVC by Centurion Star Developers is a striking commercial development designed around premium office spaces, with a futuristic concept that creates an inspiring and highly professional work environment. The project offers 91 offices, 34 offices with terraces, as well as three retail spaces, providing an impressive variety for modern businesses.

HQ by Arista Properties is a boutique commercial building designed for ambitious businesses, combining contemporary architecture with clean geometry and expressive facade lines. The building rises above three basement levels and a ground floor to seven office floors and a roof. The project offers Grade A office units together with a small selection of ground-floor retail spaces, with flexible layouts, spacious floor plates and a polished, hospitality-inspired environment from the double-height arrival lobby upwards.

Novara Residence by Cavara Developments emerges as a new light for every chapter of home, an elegant low-rise residence, that is designed as an expression of light, balance, and timeless architecture. Inspired by the meaning of its name, this intimate collection of one and two-bedroom residences embraces natural daylight, creating bright, open spaces that feel calm and inviting from the moment you arrive.

Lunara Residence by Cavara Developments, presents an intimate boutique tower that reinterprets residential design through a timeless architectural language. This intimate collection of studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom residences has been designed with intention, where every element is shaped to create a sense of balance, warmth, and timeless character. The result is a residence that feels personal, distinctive, and effortlessly sophisticated — a place where boutique living is reimagined through refined architectural language and carefully considered details.

Delvara Residence by Cavara Developments emerges as a boutique address carved with intention, an intimate collection of just seventy-one residences, where architecture, craftsmanship, and natural light exist in perfect harmony. This ground-breaking residential development rises with quiet confidence, distinguished by warm garnet tones and sculpted architectural forms that create a distinctive identity rooted in enduring elegance. Every element has been carved with purpose, reflecting Cavara's philosophy that true luxury lies not in abundance, but in thoughtful restraint — creating homes that feel intimate, elegant, and deeply livable.

The One by Prestige One Developments is a striking commercial landmark created for modern businesses, combining sophisticated design with practical functionality. The project offers premium office spaces designed to create an inspiring and professional environment, with open layouts that support creativity, collaboration, and productivity.

Monarch is a commercial development by Zane Developments, comprising office and retail units within a single building. The architecture is defined by a layered façade of stone-toned panels, glazing and cantilevered volumes, combining an upper office block with a ground-level retail podium. The project is positioned as a business address, bringing together workspace and street-level commercial units within one development.

Blossom 76, crafted by Tranquil Infra Developers, rises twenty storeys, presenting a sleek silhouette that fuses urban rhythm with tranquil living. The development comprises studios, one‑bedroom and two‑bedroom apartments, with a select handful of residences boasting private plunge pools and dedicated study rooms, totaling one hundred and eleven exclusive homes. Contemporary design cues such as expansive glass façades frame sweeping community vistas, while the building’s leisure‑inspired skin adds a dynamic pulse to the streetscape.

Empire Jebel Ali by Empire Developments is a stylish and thoughtfully designed residential project that combines a modern architectural look with comfortable, well-planned living spaces. The development offers a versatile selection of studio, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments, making it an excellent choice for different lifestyles and family needs.

Miorah Maison by Zoya emerges as a truly exquisite boutique residential development that redefines intimate urban living with its sophisticated low-rise design and uncompromising attention to detail. This stunning building stands as a testament to modern elegance, offering a curated collection of apartments that have been meticulously crafted to provide the perfect sanctuary for discerning residents. Every aspect of this exceptional development has been thoughtfully considered, from the striking architectural lines to the premium rooftop amenities that elevate daily life to new heights of refinement.

Ayamore Residence by AYAT Development is a contemporary waterfront building that pairs refined design with a calm coastal lifestyle. Soft facade lines, floating slabs, glass balustrades and full-height windows fill the interiors with natural light and open up sweeping sea views. The building rises above a ground floor and two amenity podium levels to eight residential floors and a rooftop, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments alongside spacious three-bedroom villas with generous balconies and terraces.

AYAT Parkview by AYAT Development is a residential building that brings calm, considered living to a green, well-connected neighbourhood. Contemporary architecture combines clean facade lines, spacious balconies, a refined neutral palette and geometric forms to create an elegant urban character. The building rises from a ground floor to nine residential floors and a roof, offering one- and two-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts including an additional room suitable for a study or guest room.

Lincoln Star Residence 4 is a contemporary residential development inspired by the timeless elegance of French architecture, where refined design meets modern comfort in a harmonious living environment. Thoughtfully crafted with graceful proportions, clean architectural lines, and beautifully landscaped surroundings, the project creates a peaceful sanctuary that balances sophistication with everyday functionality. Spacious residences are filled with natural light through open-plan layouts and expansive windows, offering bright, elegant interiors designed to foster comfort, tranquility, and a true sense of home.

Solcasa Residence is a contemporary residential development that brings together elegant architecture, modern comfort, and a thoughtfully curated lifestyle. Designed with clean lines and sophisticated aesthetics, the project creates a welcoming atmosphere where functionality meets timeless design. Spacious layouts, expansive windows, and bright interiors maximize natural light, while the carefully planned living spaces offer an ideal balance of style, comfort, and practicality.

The Cape by Al Barari is a residential ensemble of three contemporary low-rise buildings, each rising from a ground floor to eight residential floors. Designed to blend with the surrounding landscape, the architecture uses soft edges, organic forms, earthy tones and expansive panoramic glazing to echo the natural rhythm of water and gardens. The project offers a limited collection of one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, each planned to capture natural light, open views and a calm sense of space.

Maimoon Gardens by Fakhruddin Properties is a striking twin-tower residential development set in Jumeirah Village Circle, designed to deliver a refined urban lifestyle. The project features two interconnected towers rising above a multi-level podium, combining contemporary architecture with elegant proportions and expansive views over the city and surrounding greenery. Offering a selection of studios to spacious three-bedroom apartments, each residence is thoughtfully designed with modern layouts and light-filled interiors, creating a comfortable and stylish living environment.

Treppan Serenique Residences is a striking twin-tower development that brings together contemporary architecture and elevated coastal living. Designed with clean lines and elegant proportions, the project offers a curated collection of spacious two- and three-bedroom apartments, many with panoramic views of the sea and golf course. Expansive layouts, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and signature design elements — including select corner units with private jacuzzis — create a refined residential environment defined by light, openness, and sophistication.

projects.n: Ramada Residences by Wyndham at Dubai Islands
projects.ov: Ramada Residences by Wyndham at Dubai Islands features a collection of residences, including loft apartments, sky homes, penthouses, and triplex villas, designed with an emphasis on modern architecture and expansive views. Residents can anticipate panoramic city views, complemented by access to convenient public transportation and a thriving global hub environment.

Lunaya Terraces is a revolutionary residential experience, masterfully conceived as a seamless extension of the Lunaya landscape, elevating conventional apartment living to a sublime dialogue between architecture and nature. Inspired by the moon's rhythmic dance of reflection and renewal, this visionary development introduces a groundbreaking residential typology, where homes are meticulously crafted as living terraces, effortlessly integrating gardens, water, and open spaces into a breathtaking vertical landscape.

The Strand Lunara is a contemporary residential destination conceived as part of a vibrant, connected community where everyday life unfolds with ease and meaning. Designed around the philosophy of connection, the development brings together modern apartment living, curated retail, culture, and generous green spaces into one cohesive urban ecosystem. Its character is defined by pedestrian-first planning, strong social energy, and a sense of authenticity that makes the community feel lived-in, welcoming, and future-focused.

Nova Tower by Al Ansari Properties is a residential tower where heritage inspiration meets modern living, shaped by a family legacy of quality and trust. The building rises above a basement, a ground floor and a two-level parking podium to a rooftop, and offers one- and two-bedroom apartments complemented by retail units at ground level. Thoughtfully designed for families and professionals at every stage of life, the tower brings comfort, community and sophistication together in a calm, well-planned setting.

Elemental 22 is a boutique residential building developed in collaboration with Al Barari and inspired by titanium and the qualities it represents. The facade combines aluminium cladding with a titanium finish, warm wooden elements and lush vertical landscaping, creating a distinctive contemporary statement. The building rises above a ground floor and a three-level podium to seven residential floors and a rooftop with lounge areas, and offers one- and two-bedroom apartments designed for refined everyday living.

Isola Villa Terra Collection by Atara Development is a luxury standalone residence that reflects contemporary, refined design with clean forms and elegant lines. A facade of natural stone, expansive panoramic glazing and carefully integrated outdoor areas creates a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor spaces. The villa rises above a basement level and a ground floor to a first floor and a roof terrace, offering six bedrooms together with a maid's room, a laundry and a driver's room.

ICONA Residence is a contemporary residential development by Castor Real Estate, located in Al Reeman, Al Shamkha, Abu Dhabi. The project features a modern low-rise architectural design with clean lines and a balanced façade, offering a limited collection of residences within a well-planned community. It comprises a selection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, including layouts with maid’s rooms, all designed with spacious interiors, large windows, and functional layouts that maximize natural light and everyday comfort.

Fauchon Residences by Prestige One presents a more deliberate approach to living, inspired by the Parisian way of life, where everything is considered and nothing feels excessive. This exceptional development represents a structured expression of living, where materials and layouts align seamlessly with the refined French perspective and celebrated art de vivre. The result is homes that feel curated rather than branded, refined rather than overstated, where lifestyle, design, and hospitality align naturally.

Mirari Lagoon by Zoya is a masterpiece of contemporary design, boasting a serene waterfront-inspired community that showcases the perfect blend of modern architecture and nature-infused elements. This exquisite development features a limited collection of fully furnished residences, including studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, with convertible layouts that epitomize versatility and sophistication. The carefully crafted architecture creates a peaceful ambiance where expansive open spaces, an abundance of natural light, and resort-style living converge to offer a refined and relaxing lifestyle.

projects.n: Luluat Marina at Luluat Al Raha
projects.ov: Luluat Marina at Luluat Al Raha is a premium waterfront residential development designed around the concept of “a view for every point of view.” Located within the Marina District, the project offers a collection of studios, lofts, and 1–3 bedroom apartments, including duplex layouts, all thoughtfully positioned to capture marina, sea, and park views. The architecture emphasizes openness, natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor living, creating a refined coastal lifestyle where every residence is connected to water, greenery, and the rhythm of marina living.

Reeman Residence 01 is a masterpiece of contemporary residential design, offering a curated selection of studios, one-bedroom, one-bedroom with study, and two-bedroom with study apartments that embody the perfect blend of elegance and functionality. This exquisite development features a modern low-rise architecture with a limited collection of forty-seven residences, spread across just five floors, creating an exclusive and private living environment that is truly one-of-a-kind.

Ayaan Heights I by Invest Group Overseas is a design-led mixed-use development. Thoughtfully crafted to integrate work, living, and lagoon-front wellness into one effortless daily flow, this visionary project creates a lifestyle of balance and intention. Every element, from its architecture to its amenities, is crafted to help residents live, work, and breathe in one seamless flow, offering enduring value for residents and sustained returns for discerning investors.

Urban - Park Residences is a residential development by Urban Venture, comprising a single 16-storey tower conceived around a concept of style and simplicity. The tower comprises 187 apartments across studio, one-, and two-bedroom formats, designed with the end user in mind. The project positions itself as a straightforward, contemporary residential offering aimed at delivering enduring value for residents and investors alike.

Kabbali Hills by Arif Developments is a one-of-a-kind gated villa community where every home is individually designed by an in-house team of architects. Heritage-inspired design meets contemporary clarity, reinterpreting classical inspiration as quiet luxury with refined proportions and flowing spaces. The villas rise from a ground floor to one or two upper levels, with selected homes adding a basement or roof level, offering signature residences with five, seven and eight bedrooms set within private gardens.

Le Chateau Pietrus by Mr. Eight Development is an exceptional branded boutique residence that brings together elegant design, five-star hospitality, and waterfront living in one exclusive destination. The project offers beautifully designed 2 and 3 bedroom apartments, as well as a magnificent 4 bedroom penthouse, with every home created to provide outstanding comfort, privacy, and timeless luxury.

Sol Terra Casa is a collection of ultra luxury townhouses developed by SOL, a company with decades of experience and over two hundred fifty developments delivered. This premium community moves in harmony with its surrounding greenery, where natural light and gentle shadows sculpt every space, softly blurring the line between indoors and outdoors. Each residence features a private elevator and a rooftop plunge pool, offering a lifestyle of unparalleled comfort and sophistication.

Fay Valley is a sustainable residential community developed by Taraf in partnership with Masdar City, shaped around the connection between wellness, movement, and nature. Featuring a collection of thoughtfully designed villas and townhouses, the community is inspired by landscape, movement, and connection. With a significant portion dedicated to purposeful open space, greenery flows through shaded trails, parks, and walkable corridors that bring calm and balance to everyday life.

Azha Views Residences by Azha Properties is a contemporary residential tower designed around comfort, functionality and modern living. Elegant architecture combines clean lines with efficient space planning, while the tower rises above a ground floor and four podium levels to twenty-five residential floors. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments, one-bedroom homes with a study and two-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts, private balconies and open-plan living areas suited to a wide range of lifestyles.

Armas by Zenith is a contemporary residential development defined by clean architectural lines, expansive glass-fronted balconies, and thoughtfully designed living spaces that emphasize light, openness, and everyday comfort. The project offers a selection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom residences, carefully planned to balance functionality with a refined residential atmosphere. Warm modern architecture, generous outdoor spaces, and elegant proportions create a distinctive living environment with a timeless appeal.

Flow 25 is a contemporary residential development defined by fluid architectural forms, expansive terraces, and a design philosophy centered on comfort, natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. The collection includes one-, two-, three-, and four-bedroom residences, as well as exclusive penthouses and Sky Villas, offering a variety of thoughtfully planned layouts. Soft architectural lines, generous outdoor spaces, and integrated smart-home technology create an elegant living environment where functionality and refined design come together effortlessly.

Palm Central Private Residences Phase 2, crafted by renowned developer Nakheel, is a masterpiece of waterfront design, offering a rarefied resort-inspired lifestyle that epitomizes refinement and sophistication. This exceptional development boasts an outstanding assortment of residences, including one, two, two-point-five, three, and four-bedroom apartments, as well as expansive four and five-bedroom townhouses, all meticulously designed to maximize comfort, natural light, and breathtaking views that seem to stretch on forever.

Weston by Wadan Phase one and two is delivered by WADAN Developments and presents a sleek silhouette of modern residential architecture. The development offers a versatile collection of studio, one, two and three‑bedroom apartments, each crafted to suit a broad spectrum of lifestyles. Elegant spatial layouts and refined exterior detailing give the towers a distinctive contemporary presence.

Blossom 40 by Tranquil Infra Developers is a boutique residential building that blends minimalist luxury with clean architectural lines and a calm, green setting. The building rises above a basement level and a ground floor to nine residential floors and a rooftop, sitting harmoniously within the surrounding landscape like a quiet urban oasis. The collection offers one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, each with an additional room suitable for a home office, nursery or guest space, designed for families and professionals.

Al-Aamra 1 Tower is a masterpiece of modern residential design, offering a unique blend of stylish living and investment opportunities. This sophisticated high-rise boasts a collection of meticulously crafted two-bedroom units, each featuring spacious layouts, a living room, and ample storage, perfectly suited for families and investors alike. The tower's contemporary design, coupled with its flexible payment plan, makes it an attractive proposition for those seeking a new home or a savvy investment in a thriving market.

Kyomi Residences by ANAX Developments is a boutique mixed-use residential building that combines contemporary architecture, functional layouts and everyday convenience. The building rises from a ground floor and a single podium level to six residential floors. Bold horizontal lines, deep balconies, softly curved edges and panoramic glazing create a clean, layered silhouette. The collection offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, complemented by retail units at ground level that bring daily services right to the doorstep.

Lunaya by Zaya is an exceptional villa community created for residents who value nature, privacy, and refined modern living. The project offers an exclusive collection of elegant 4 and 5 bedroom villas designed with flowing architecture, open layouts, and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces. Surrounded by lush greenery, lagoons, and beautifully landscaped surroundings, Lunaya delivers a peaceful lifestyle filled with light, comfort, and understated luxury.

Siana by Zoya is a refined residential destination that brings a fresh sense of grace and contemporary elegance to modern living. Inspired by a name synonymous with timeless beauty, the development is thoughtfully designed to feel both distinctive and deeply personal, offering a home that truly reflects its residents' aspirations. The collection features beautifully crafted studio and two-bedroom residences, each conceived to elevate everyday life with lasting quality and a sense of quiet prestige.

Al Habtoor Polo Resort Villas is a prestigious residential development by the Al Habtoor Group, one of the most respected conglomerates in the region. The community offers an exclusive collection of luxury villas — ranging from semi-detached residences to fully branded homes managed by the resort — all set within a stunning Andalusian-inspired equestrian estate. Each villa type is thoughtfully designed to immerse residents in the world's finest equestrian lifestyle, making this a truly one-of-a-kind address in Dubai.

Flamingo LUX is a boutique residential development by Eminent Real Estate Development. The project features a low-rise structure comprising a ground floor, four residential levels, and a rooftop, offering an exclusive and private living atmosphere within one of the city’s most prestigious and rapidly developing areas. The building’s balanced composition and minimalist aesthetic emphasize sophistication and modernity, allowing it to blend seamlessly into its upscale surroundings while maintaining a distinct visual identity.

Saray South Residences is a contemporary resort-style residential development that combines clean lines, balanced proportions, and a modern urban aesthetic. Designed to redefine modern urban living, the project blends comfort, functionality, and leisure within a fully integrated community environment. With its elegant architecture and thoughtfully planned spaces, Saray South offers residents a lifestyle that goes beyond traditional living - where everyday moments feel like a retreat. The development comprises a G+4 residential building with 104 units, including studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments.

Al Ghaf Tower is a breathtaking 50-floor beachfront landmark rising 210.7 metres above Al Khan, Sharjah, where timeless heritage meets contemporary luxury in perfect harmony. The tower presents a magnificent collection of fully-furnished 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive 4-bedroom duplex residences, totalling 378 homes designed for the finest coastal lifestyle. This iconic development offers sweeping seaside views and an unparalleled living experience along the stunning Al Khan Lagoon.

Ventana Residences is a contemporary mid-rise residential development by Zedor Developments. The project is conceived as a thoughtfully structured building that transitions seamlessly from its basement parking through a refined reception and lift lobby, creating a fluid daily journey for residents. With a selection of studios, one-bedroom apartments, and one-bedroom units with multipurpose spaces, the development focuses on practical urban living, combining efficient layouts with a calm and balanced architectural approach rooted in functionality and movement.

Harbour Lights is a 52-storey waterfront residential tower inspired by the movement of waves and the elegance of maritime living. Designed in collaboration with the luxury fashion and jewellery brand de GRISOGONO, the project reflects a sophisticated nautical concept expressed through fluid architectural elements and refined contemporary styling. The development is positioned as a premium waterfront destination that combines panoramic sea views with a distinctive branded residential identity inspired by luxury cruise experiences.

Damac Bay 2 is the second phase of the DAMAC Bay waterfront developmen. This 49-storey residential tower continues the branded Cavalli-inspired concept introduced in the first phase, offering a refined coastal lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most sought-after waterfront locations. The project is designed as a high-rise luxury residence that combines elegant architecture, sea views, and proximity to marina and beachside attractions, reinforcing its position within an exclusive waterfront community.

Damac Bay by Cavalli is a premium waterfront residential development by DAMAC Properties in collaboration with Cavalli. The project comprises three architecturally striking towers rising between 30 and 40 storeys, designed to deliver an exclusive branded waterfront lifestyle. Positioned in one of Dubai’s most dynamic coastal destinations, the development offers a contemporary residential concept focused on luxury living, sea views, and proximity to major leisure and marina attractions.

Chelsea Residences by DAMAC is an ultra-luxury waterfront development located in Dubai Maritime City. The project consists of six architecturally distinctive towers developed in two phases, offering a curated collection of 1- to 3-bedroom residences.

Chelsea Residences Tower C by DAMAC Properties represents a groundbreaking collaboration with iconic football club Chelsea F.C., bringing the club's passion, prowess, and dedication to perfection to the shores of Dubai for the first time ever. Positioned at the most coveted point within the masterplan, Tower C captures sweeping sea views while affording residents true privacy, representing the collection at its most refined. This is the final opportunity to take your place within a legacy that was always building towards this moment, where ambition meets mastery in every detail.

Cavalli Couture is an ultra-luxury waterfront development in Dubai, offering an exceptional lifestyle defined by glamour, exclusivity, and iconic design. Surrounded by lush greenery and cascading water features, the project creates a unique rainforest-inspired atmosphere in the heart of the city. The development features an exclusive collection of 3-, 4-, and 5-bedroom residences, along with ultra-luxurious 6-bedroom penthouses, all designed to maximize panoramic canal and skyline views.

Canal Heights by DAMAC Properties is an elegant waterfront residential development located in the vibrant Business Bay district of Dubai. Created in collaboration with the luxury jewelry brand de GRISOGONO, the project introduces a sophisticated design concept inspired by contemporary luxury and the beauty of waterfront living. The development features an exclusive collection of canal-facing studios, as well as 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to combine comfort, style, and panoramic city views in one of Dubai’s most prestigious urban destinations.

AYKON City boasts one of the most iconic settings in Dubai, the city’s most important vehicular artery connecting Dubai to Abu Dhabi. The development overlooks the new Dubai Canal network and forms the gateway to the glamorous Burj area.

Golden Woods Albab Views presents a contemporary architectural concept designed to offer comfort, functionality, and elegant simplicity within Dubai South’s rapidly developing community. The low-rise structure, composed of a ground level plus four residential floors, reflects modern urban aesthetics with clean lines, balanced proportions, and thoughtful integration of outdoor spaces. Positioned in a major growth corridor, the development benefits from exceptional connectivity to Expo City, Al Maktoum International Airport, and Dubai’s key destinations, offering residents both convenience and a future-ready living environment.
Overlooking the impressive Dubai Canal, ALTITUDE is only minutes away from iconic landmarks like the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and DIFC, with Dubai International Airport a short drive away.

Casa Vista Residence stands as a contemporary architectural statement that crowns the skyline with a sleek silhouette. Dual‑aspect orientation floods each home with sunrise illumination and cool breezes, creating an airy ambience that blurs the boundary between interior and exterior. Thoughtful geometry and generous balconies elevate everyday living, offering residents a sense of rising above the urban fabric.

Views VII by Golden Woods presents a contemporary architectural identity defined by clean lines, balanced proportions, and a modern aesthetic crafted for elevated urban living. The development is designed to offer both visual appeal and functional flow, creating an atmosphere where elegance and practicality coexist. Its structure supports a refined residential experience suited to individuals and families seeking a sophisticated lifestyle within a thoughtfully planned community.

Golden Wood Views V presents a refined selection of one‑ and two‑bedroom apartments together with spacious two‑ and three‑bedroom duplexes. The architecture showcases expansive panoramic windows that bathe interiors in natural light while expressing a contemporary design language. Clean lines, harmonious proportions and thoughtfully sculpted façades contribute to an atmosphere of sophisticated visual ease.

The Meriva Collection by Ellington Properties is an exclusive beachfront residential development set within a low-density island setting, designed to deliver a refined coastal lifestyle with uninterrupted sea views. The project is composed of multiple architecturally distinct buildings that balance contemporary design with privacy, creating a serene living environment enhanced by direct beach access and a thoughtfully planned waterfront landscape.

Soto Grande is an architectural landmark in Ras Al Khaimah, located in the vibrant coastal community of Al Hamra. Developed by Ellington, the project combines modern design with timeless sophistication, offering a refined lifestyle surrounded by ocean horizons, lagoons, and lush golf fairways.

Portside Square by Ellington Properties is a distinctive waterfront development set within the historic Mina Rashid, where contemporary architecture is inspired by the rhythm of the sea. Comprising three sculptural towers — Portside Residences I, II, and III — the project is defined by fluid lines, soft contours, and shimmering façades that reflect natural light. The design creates a seamless connection between sea, sky, and structure, offering residences with open layouts, expansive glazing, and panoramic views that bring a sense of calm sophistication to everyday living.

Playa Del Sol by Ellington Properties is a contemporary coastal development rising on Al Marjan Island, designed to capture the essence of refined seaside living. The 14-storey building presents a striking architectural profile, combining clean modern lines with a light, elegant façade that reflects its waterfront setting. Offering a diverse collection of one- to four-bedroom apartments, the project is thoughtfully planned to maximize natural light, sea views, and functional layouts, creating a calm and sophisticated residential environment.

One River Point by Ellington Properties is a striking architectural landmark set along the Dubai Canal, with views extending towards the iconic Burj Khalifa. The tower is defined by its sculptural form and contemporary design language, where clean lines and refined geometry create a bold yet elegant presence. Thoughtfully integrated into its urban surroundings, the building reflects a seamless balance between innovation, functionality, and visual sophistication, offering a distinctive lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most desirable waterfront settings.

Everly Place is a modern residential project designed to offer a balanced lifestyle through a combination of contemporary architecture, comfortable environment and thoughtful infrastructure. The concept of the development focuses on creating a private, cozy space for living, while maintaining accessibility to key lifestyle destinations. The project is positioned as an attractive option for both personal residence and investment, combining functionality, aesthetics, and long-term value.

Mercer House by Ellington Properties is a striking residential development set in the dynamic district of Uptown Dubai, defined by its contemporary architecture and lifestyle-driven design. Comprising two elegant towers rising above a wellness-focused podium, the project offers a diverse collection of studios, one- to three-bedroom apartments, and exclusive four-bedroom penthouses. Clean lines, modern proportions, and a refined façade create a bold architectural presence, while the integration of lifestyle and wellness spaces at the podium level sets a new standard for urban living.

Eltiera Views introduces the next evolution of refined residential architecture within the tranquil landscape of Jumeirah Islands. With Towers 1 and 2 now launching, the project reveals a fluid, contemporary aesthetic that mirrors its natural surroundings — sculpted greens, serene lakes, and distant waterfronts. Soft silhouettes, layered façades, and expansive glass surfaces create a harmonious architectural rhythm, allowing the buildings to blend seamlessly into their environment. Designed as an expression of calm sophistication, Eltiera Views elevates everyday living into an art form.

Costa Mare is a striking waterfront development on Al Marjan Island, composed of four architecturally distinctive towers that harmonize with their natural surroundings. The design draws inspiration from both the sea and the nearby mountains, expressed through fluid forms, soft earthy tones, and expansive glazing that captures panoramic views. Each residence is thoughtfully planned to maximize light, space, and tranquility, creating a refined coastal environment that balances elegance with a sense of calm exclusivity.

1CTRL, developed by Object 1, is a lifestyle-led residential tower built around a clear concept of modes of living that connect wellness, creativity, family life and social spaces. Its contemporary architecture pairs clean white facades with glazed balconies and planted edges, while the interiors hold a selection of one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments designed for everyday comfort.

Merdan Residences is a residential tower by Evera Development, rising above a landscaped podium with light façades, balconies and a calm, contemporary architectural expression. The building brings together studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-bedroom apartments, with efficient layouts designed for everyday comfort and family living.

The podium level forms the social heart of the residence, with a swimming pool, a separate kids' pool, family cabanas and podium seating areas set within a green oasis.

Yas Riva Reserve by Aldar is a gated waterfront village of single-row villas set along a canal, offering a more private and tranquil residential setting. Warm timber architecture, light facades, panoramic glazing, clean geometric volumes and vertical sun screens give the homes a contemporary character. Each villa rises from a ground floor to a first floor, with inland residences offering four, five and six bedrooms and waterfront villas offering five and six bedrooms, all surrounded by private gardens and green community spaces.

Native Haus is a contemporary boutique low-rise development where every residence, interior detail and shared space has been thoughtfully designed to support the rhythm of everyday life, from focus and movement to stillness, connection and recovery. Designed by the acclaimed architecture practice Studio Symbiosis, the building brings together 162 residences across six storeys, complemented by a collection of exclusive retail units at ground level for everyday convenience.

Sei Saadiyat, brought to life by the developer Aldar, designed by Jacobs, presents a distinctive portfolio of one‑ and two‑bedroom apartments, signature three‑bedroom Kanso Residences and two‑bedroom Kanso Lofts. The design embraces a philosophy of stillness, weaving buildings around tranquil courtyards where shifting daylight sculpts the spaces. Upper‑floor homes are framed by sweeping vistas that capture the cultural district, the Arabian Gulf and the city skyline, offering an inspiring backdrop to everyday living.

Sera 1 at Rashid Yachts & Marina by Emaar Properties is a refined waterfront residential development designed to reflect a modern maritime lifestyle. The project consists of two architecturally connected buildings, offering a collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive 3-bedroom townhouses. Defined by soft sand tones and elegant coastal design, the architecture blends seamlessly with the marina setting, creating a serene and upscale living environment.

Acacia Park Heights is a residential development by Emaar Properties, offering one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, each with a private outdoor balcony. The building is designed with clean, contemporary lines executed in high-quality materials, complemented by ultra-modern detailing throughout. The project reflects Emaar Properties' design-led approach to residential living. Surrounded by landscaped spaces and an expansive park, it creates a serene and well-balanced living environment.

Al Ghadeer Parks by Aldar is a residential community of townhouses and villas designed around connection, open parks and shared spaces for every generation. Clean geometric volumes, light-toned facades, warm natural panels and large windows give the architecture a calm, contemporary character. The community is delivered in two phases, and each home rises from a ground floor to a first floor, offering two- and three-bedroom townhouses and four-bedroom villas, with selected villas featuring private pools.

SKY LEVEL 1 is a landmark residential development rising in District 11 of Jumeirah Village Circle, designed as a modern architectural statement inspired by the beauty of the cosmos. The tower features a striking structure composed of 2 basement levels, ground floor, 5 podium levels, office floors, and 35 residential floors, creating a dynamic mixed-use environment. Offering thoughtfully designed one-bedroom apartments, the project combines contemporary elegance with innovative design, positioning itself as a new benchmark for elevated urban living with a total of 420 units.

projects.n: Talay & Talay Beach at Marsa Al Saadiyat
projects.ov: Talay and Talay Beach at Marsa Al Saadiyat is the first residential address within a waterfront destination, made up of two gated communities of standalone villas designed around family life, greenery and a strong sense of belonging. Named after the birds that trace the shoreline, the community honours Emirati heritage through areesh-inspired boundary walls and screens reinterpreted by Emirati designer Abdalla Almulla. Each villa rises from a ground floor to a first floor, offering four-, five- and six-bedroom homes with private gardens.

The LX by Mulk is a boutique commercial tower developed by Mulk Properties, a multinational conglomerate headquartered in Sharjah's Hamriyah Free Zone. The building features two basement levels, a ground floor, six office floors, and a rooftop, offering a well-structured and efficient layout. Located in the fast-growing Arjan district, the project stands out with its modern architecture, clean lines, and integration of natural light and greenery, creating a refined and professional business environment.

Valia, a residential masterpiece by Emaar Properties, rises as a sleek, sculptural silhouette, effortlessly defining the contemporary high-rise landscape with its refined verticality, rhythmic vertical fins, and precise horizontal detailing. The tower's facade, a breathtaking expanse of full-height glazing, reflects the sky and light, while floor-to-ceiling windows in each residence draw in daylight and frame panoramic views of the surrounding waterfront, boulevard, and skyline. This architectural gem is crowned by a discreet illuminated feature, imparting a distinctive night-time signature that sets Valia apart.

Golf Trails boasts a sophisticated design aesthetic, featuring a contemporary exterior facade that harmoniously blends with the surrounding landscape of the Emaar South Golf Course, offering a serene and tranquil living environment. The architectural style of Golf Trails combines modern design with an earthy palette on the inside, creating a sense of calm and elegance that pervades every aspect of these residences.

The Canopies at Yas Point by Aldar is the first collection of homes within a waterfront destination, designed as a garden-led neighbourhood that moves with the sunlight. A park-centric masterplan places six residential buildings around a large central green space, encouraging a walkable, indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Five buildings rise from a ground floor to eight residential floors and a roof, and one rises to nine residential floors, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts including a maid's room.

Oceara Park View Residences Phase 1 stands as an exceptional boutique mid‑rise enclave comprising sixty‑three residences that blend one‑ to three‑bedroom apartments with three‑ to four‑bedroom townhouses for contemporary living. The design celebrates openness, employing layered terraces that spill outward, maximize daylight and generate natural shade, while expansive balconies frame uninterrupted park and coastal panoramas. Integrated greenery weaves through the façades, reinforcing a seamless dialogue between architecture and the surrounding landscape.

projects.n: Mövenpick Residences Dubai Motor City Phase 1
projects.ov: Mövenpick Residences Dubai Motor City Phase 1 is a branded residential project developed by CITYVIEW Developments in partnership with Accor, marking the first Mövenpick-branded residence in the area.The collection includes 307 residences across studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, designed with a wellness-led "Bio-ROI" philosophy that emphasises longevity, daily quality of life and sustained performance alongside conventional investment value.

Yas Acres – The Orchids is a premium residential community, designed to offer a balanced lifestyle that combines nature, modern architecture, and family-oriented living. The project features a collection of elegant villas and townhouses surrounded by lush greenery, landscaped parks, and open spaces, creating a serene environment while remaining connected to the vibrant attractions of Yas Island.

Mamsha Palm by Aldar is a rare collection of exclusive residences designed by the internationally acclaimed architect Koichi Takada. Biophilic design, inspired by the protective canopy of palm trees that cools its surroundings, runs through the building, providing dappled shade and shelter from the sun. The building rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to six residential floors, offering one-bedroom, two-bedroom with study and three-bedroom residences, together with four-bedroom duplex sky villas with a maid's room.

Sky Harmony is a contemporary residential development designed around a balanced and comfortable lifestyle, combining modern architecture with thoughtfully planned living spaces. Created in collaboration with Natuzzi Italia, the project reflects a design-led approach where refined aesthetics meet everyday functionality. The development features a collection of studios, one-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom residences, and a limited selection of penthouses, offering layouts tailored to a variety of residential needs.

Fahid Beach Residences by Aldar is a seafront residential community at the heart of an island destination, designed by the internationally acclaimed architect Koichi Takada. Contemporary coastal architecture with clean lines, panoramic facades, light materials and generous glazing frames endless sea views. The community comprises seven buildings, each rising above a ground floor and a podium level to ten residential floors, and offers one- to four-bedroom apartments, one- and two-bedroom townhouses and five-bedroom penthouses.

Al Ghadeer Gardens by Aldar is a family-oriented residential neighbourhood of townhouses and villas designed around open green spaces, shaded walkways and a strong sense of community. Restrained, minimalist architecture, pedestrian-first streets and tree-lined avenues give the neighbourhood a calm, welcoming character. Each home rises from a ground floor to a first floor, and the collection includes two- and three-bedroom townhouses and four-bedroom villas, with room for every stage of family life.

Golf Vale is a contemporary residential development located within the green landscapes of Emaar South, designed to offer a refined lifestyle centered around nature and golf. The project presents a collection of elegant residences overlooking expansive fairways and landscaped surroundings, where architecture and environment blend seamlessly. With panoramic views of the championship golf course and thoughtfully designed living spaces, Golf Vale creates a calm yet sophisticated residential atmosphere that combines modern design with the serenity of open green horizons.

The Wilds Residences by Aldar is a nature-led apartment collection designed to restore balance, nurture wellbeing and connect residents with the natural world. Six residential buildings rise from a ground floor to ten, twelve and fifteen residential floors, balancing privacy and openness through architecture that keeps nature always in view. The collection offers one- and two-bedroom apartments, three-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, and spacious two- and three-bedroom duplexes for families.

Fior 1 is a distinguished waterfront residential address that celebrates Dubai’s maritime heritage while embracing contemporary luxury. Positioned along pristine marina waters, the development presents a refined collection of modern apartments designed to capture sweeping views, abundant natural light, and a strong sense of openness. The architectural expression is bold yet elegant, creating a landmark that reflects sophistication, balance, and an elevated coastal lifestyle inspired by freedom and beauty.

Terra Woods is a contemporary residential community located within the vibrant Expo Living district, just moments from Expo City Dubai. Developed by Emaar Properties, Terra Woods offers a lifestyle that blends urban connectivity with nature-inspired living. This project represents a forward-thinking residential destination that combines modern living, strong investment potential, and a balanced lifestyle within one of Dubai’s fastest-growing and most visionary districts.

A1LA Residence by Object 1 is a refined boutique sanctuary where modern luxury meets a soft, celestial sense of calm, created for those who appreciate beauty that feels effortless and deeply personal. The project offers an exclusive collection of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments, as well as spacious 2 and 3 bedroom duplexes. Inspired by the meaning of "Ayla" — a gentle glow of light — A1LA Residence is a place where architecture, serenity, and contemporary elegance come together in perfect harmony.

Celesto 4 by Tarrad Development is an elegant residential tower rising twenty-one floors above a ground level, mezzanine and three podium levels. It offers a thoughtfully designed collection of studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, delivered fully furnished with integrated smart home systems. Dynamic retail spaces within the building, from luxury fashion and an artisan bakery to a premium pharmacy and a beauty salon, together with dedicated office floors, make everyday life wonderfully easy.

Peace Avenue is a contemporary residential development located in the strategically positioned Jebel Ali district, offering a refined urban lifestyle shaped by connectivity and future growth. Designed to align with Dubai’s westward expansion, the project combines elegant architecture with a calm residential atmosphere, creating a balanced environment for modern city living. Its proximity to major transport routes, metro access, and key economic hubs places residents within easy reach of Dubai’s most important destinations while remaining part of an emerging community.

I'Sola Bella presents a residential concept inspired by the Italian island of I'Sola Bella, offering an experience of tranquil luxury within a metropolitan environment. The development’s architecture blends graceful curves with clean lines, utilizing a neutral color scheme accented with calming blues and greens to cultivate a resort-like atmosphere. Podium level apartments include dedicated storage space.

Saddlewood Park, developed by MAK Developers, presents a low-rise residential project in Nad Al Sheba 1, near the Meydan Racecourse. The architectural design draws inspiration from equestrian aesthetics, blending classic forms with modern elements. The project features a distinctive golden gradient detail and a warm, calming color scheme, aiming for timeless sophistication.

Ashwood Residences is a refined residential landmark by Skyland Properties. Conceived as an expression of architectural elegance and timeless design, the project reflects the developer’s commitment to creating sophisticated living environments that balance modern luxury with warmth and comfort. With its striking façade, grand double-height lobby, and serene surroundings, Ashwood Residences offers a welcoming sanctuary within one of Dubai’s most family-oriented communities.

Eira Residence is a contemporary residential development by Neoterra, located in one of the emirate’s most strategically positioned and steadily evolving urban districts. Featuring a collection of studio and one-bedroom apartments, the development brings together clean architectural lines, well-planned interiors, and a curated selection of community amenities. Designed for young professionals, growing families, and seasoned investors alike, Eira Residence offers a compelling combination of comfort, connectivity, and long-term value.

Sunvale by PRYSM Development is a contemporary residential building in Al Furjan, designed to offer a calm and refined living experience within one of Dubai’s most connected neighbourhoods. Its architecture emphasizes light, openness, and a warm atmosphere, creating homes that feel both modern and welcoming. With views overlooking the community and skyline, the project appeals to residents seeking a harmonious balance between comfort and city convenience.

Enchante by Grid introduces a truly distinctive residential concept in Arjan, redefining urban living through a rare forest-inspired environment. Designed as the community’s first nature-integrated development, the project brings together modern architecture and lush greenery, with over 500 trees creating a serene, immersive setting. The residences are thoughtfully planned to offer a harmonious balance between comfort, design, and tranquility, making everyday life feel like a retreat within the city.

Bliss Tower is a refined expression of Japandi-inspired living, where Scandinavian functionality meets the calm harmony of Japanese design. The architecture is defined by clean lines, natural textures, and a balanced composition that emphasizes light, space, and simplicity. Thoughtfully designed volumes and soft, neutral palettes create a sense of quiet elegance, while every residence is shaped to feel both open and intimate. Here, design is not just visual — it is experiential, creating a serene environment rooted in clarity and comfort.

Elmora by Neoterra Developments embodies a vision of refined urban living where modern design meets thoughtful comfort. Situated in Jumeirah Garden City, near Sheikh Zayed Road, the project offers a tranquil lifestyle in the heart of Dubai’s vibrant pulse. With only 85 fully furnished residences, Elmora combines architectural elegance with the warmth of a private retreat. The building’s contemporary façade, soft landscaping, and curated lighting create a welcoming atmosphere framed by panoramic views of Burj Khalifa, Dubai Frame, and Museum of the Future.

Al Aamra 3 Tower by GJ Properties is a thoughtfully designed residential development offering spacious 2-bedroom apartments. With smart layouts, generous spaces, natural lighting, and contemporary architecture, the project creates an elegant and comfortable living environment designed around modern family life.

Colibri Views by Major Developers is a contemporary residential development designed around the principles of innovation, flexibility, and modern urban living. Featuring a collection of fully furnished studios, one-, and two-bedroom apartments, the project showcases a striking architectural design with fluid lines and thoughtfully planned interiors. The residences incorporate modular furniture, adaptable living spaces, intelligent storage solutions, and open-plan layouts, creating homes that seamlessly accommodate work, leisure, and everyday life while emphasizing comfort and functionality.

Al Hamra Waterfront is a collection of waterfront residences set directly on the sea, with direct beach access and open views across the water. The community is spread across four clusters, with five apartment buildings rising above a ground floor and a podium distributed among three clusters, and a fourth cluster dedicated to duplex townhouses. The project offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments alongside luxury townhouses, each residence with a private balcony and open waterfront views.

VELA, Dorchester Collection, Dubai is a striking waterfront development that elevates luxury living through a seamless blend of architecture, design, and hospitality. Developed by OMNIYAT and managed by Dorchester Collection, VELA offers a refined lifestyle where every detail is curated for comfort, elegance, and exclusivity.

Five Jumeirah Village Hotel is a masterpiece of luxurious hospitality, offering a sophisticated and modern experience that caters to the diverse needs of both business and leisure travelers. This exquisite hotel boasts an impressive array of amenities and facilities, including a spectacular range of culinary options, with seven distinctive dining venues, such as the vibrant Soul Street, which showcases a mouth-watering variety of global street food, and the chic Above 21, a rooftop bar that commands breathtaking panoramic views of the city skyline.

Vista by Prestige One is an exceptional residential tower offering a sophisticated lifestyle in which every detail has been meticulously crafted to elevate the living experience. Designed by the renowned architectural connoisseurs at LACASA, the building features exquisite, view-centric residences where floor-to-ceiling windows invite an abundance of natural light and the façade pays elegant homage to modern luxury.

Anantara Residences is a spectacular, exclusive residential property situated within the five-star Anantara The Palm Dubai Resort. Developed by Seven Tides, the project offers studios, spacious one and two-bedroom apartments, and luxurious penthouses available for freehold ownership. Designed with contemporary Asian flair and finished to the highest quality, the residences offer stunning, unobstructed panoramic views over the resort's lagoons, across the iconic Palm Jumeirah, the Arabian Gulf, and the Dubai skyline.

Splendor is a boutique residential development by Gemini Property Developers, located in Mohammed Bin Rashid City within the Sobha Hartland community. The project combines contemporary architecture with a well-planned urban environment, creating a refined residential setting surrounded by greenery and modern infrastructure. The architectural design is defined by expressive façades and curved balconies that create a dynamic and elegant visual identity. The building integrates seamlessly with its landscaped surroundings, offering panoramic views of the city skyline and green open spaces.

Beverly Crown is a masterpiece of intentional design, where stepped geometry and refined lines come together to form a truly distinctive silhouette, crafted by the renowned developer HMB. This exceptional development offers more than just residences - it presents a sense of elevation, clarity, and balance, where every tier is lifted with purpose, every residence exudes calm confidence, and every detail is meticulously crafted to create a life of refined sophistication. The development's architecture is a testament to the power of disciplined design, where proportion and elegance come together in perfect harmony.

DGM Vision is a residential apartment building by Vision Developments, planned around fully furnished homes with smart home technology. The building rises from a ground-floor reception lobby and podium parking levels to residential floors crowned by a roof level. The mix covers studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments. On the lowest residential floor, studios and one-bedroom apartments have private pools and large terraces, and the rooftop one-bedroom units also come with private pools. Two-bedroom apartments sit on the upper residential level, and floor-to-ceiling glazing with balconies or terraces runs across the building.

Lusin Residences by Ermax Development is a contemporary mixed-use development combining residential floors with retail spaces at street level. The building rises above a ground floor and a parking podium, and its architecture pairs light façade surfaces with contrasting vertical elements, projecting balconies and green planting. The residential collection ranges from studios to one-bedroom apartments, one-bedroom apartments with an additional room, two-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom penthouses.

Garden Living is a residential building by Dugasta, conceived as an invitation to slow down without stepping away from the city. The building rises from a ground level with retail shops through residential floors to a roof level. Its contemporary façade combines light and dark surfaces with panoramic glazing and projecting balconies planted with integrated greenery, which defines the garden character of the project. The residences comprise one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with layouts designed for comfortable and functional everyday living.

Haus 99 by Hausen Developments, rises as a boutique low‑rise tower whose contemporary silhouette. Conceived as a private collection of residences, it combines a low-rise contemporary silhouette with soft curved lines and full-height glass facades that draw natural light deep into the interiors and open dual-aspect views over the surrounding parkland.

Grosvenor House is a boutique residential building by Lotus Living, a British developer bringing its experience of the London residential market to Dubai. The project combines British-inspired design with modern functionality, focusing on attention to detail, efficient layouts and long-term value. The contemporary facade pairs light stone-toned frames with warm timber-style louvres and glazed balconies, while a crowned rooftop completes the silhouette.

Fala by Kasco is a waterfront residential tower designed around the water beside it. Its wave-inspired architecture brings movement to the façade through flowing lines and curved terraces, while generous glazing and open balconies draw natural light and water views into the homes. The building offers studios, one-bedroom apartments and two- and three-bedroom plus layouts, alongside retail spaces. Selected ground-floor residences open onto private terraces with their own pools.

Bloom Living - Marbella unfolds as a lakeside villa community that draws inspiration from Mediterranean Spanish architecture. The collection presents three‑, four‑, five‑, and six‑bedroom villas, each arranged to celebrate open indoor‑outdoor living and classic Spanish detailing tempered by contemporary spaciousness. A refined expression of lakeside living, the development anchors itself within Bloom Living’s ambitious master‑planned environment.

Marlin Icon by Cosmo Developments presents a curated collection of two‑to‑four bedroom apartments together with distinctive duplexes, totaling one hundred and forty thoughtfully arranged homes for modern families. The design embraces soft‑edged architecture and generous spatial proportions, delivering a sense of poise and motion that defines the tower’s silhouette. Refined contemporary interiors imbue each residence with a calm elegance that feels both inviting and timeless.

Mars Residences is a contemporary residential development located in the heart of Dubai Sports City, created around the idea of active, connected, and comfortable urban living. The project combines modern architecture with functional planning and a family-friendly environment, offering residents convenient access to the wider Dubai through the surrounding road network. Its location within Sports City places residents close to schools, retail, dining, sports venues, and a variety of leisure destinations, creating a well-connected setting for both everyday living and investment.

Reeman Residence 02 is a contemporary residential development. The project combines modern architecture, premium finishes, and thoughtfully planned layouts to create a refined yet comfortable living environment. Its location within Aldar’s Al Reeman Living development provides residents with convenient access to key destinations, while the surrounding parks, schools, retail, and community infrastructure contribute to a well-connected and practical lifestyle.

Elemental 78 is a boutique residential building whose concept takes its cue from platinum, the element that gives the project its name. Its rarity, purity and endurance are translated into clean architectural lines and a calm visual language. The building offers a considered collection of one- and two-bedroom apartments, complemented by a single three-bedroom residence. A grand arrival entrance, green pockets across the podium courtyards and a facade of aluminium cladding with wood-finish battens give the development a distinctive, nature-led character.

Etérea by Zoya Developments is a refined residential project offering fully furnished one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom residences, thoughtfully designed for modern living. Each home combines practical layouts, natural light, and a calm contemporary atmosphere to create a comfortable and elegant living experience.

Epoque is a contemporary residential development, created around a timeless approach to modern living. Inspired by the enduring qualities of classic design, the project combines refined architecture, thoughtful composition, and understated elegance. Set within an emerging lifestyle destination, Epoque offers a balanced environment surrounded by landscaped areas, waterfront settings, crystal lagoons, and an extensive boardwalk, creating a sense of space and tranquillity while remaining connected to the city.

Pearl Beach View by Advanced Properties is a mid-rise residential building inspired by its setting on Lu'luat Al Raha Island, facing a sandy shoreline. The project offers studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and penthouses, complemented by select retail spaces at ground level. A modern, minimalist architecture with clean lines and carefully placed openings allows the building to sit naturally within its coastal setting, while selected residences are oriented towards the sea for open water views.

projects.n: NH Collection Ras Al Khaimah Al Marjan Island Hotel & Apartments
projects.ov: NH Collection Ras Al Khaimah Al Marjan Island Hotel & Apartments by RRS International Development is a premium mixed-use project that combines the comfort of a luxury hotel with beautifully designed branded residences. The development offers Hotel Standard Rooms, Hotel Luxury Suites, 1-bedroom Smart Residences, and spacious 1-bedroom Luxury Residences, creating an excellent choice for both guests and homeowners.

projects.n: The Orchard Place Towers D & E
projects.ov: The Orchard Place Towers D & E are contemporary residential towers designed around the idea of comfortable, relaxed living surrounded by lush greenery. The architectural concept combines modern forms with open, fluid spaces and a strong connection to the landscaped environment. The residences are designed to maximise natural light and views, with spacious balconies extending the living experience outdoors. Selected one- and two-bedroom residences feature private swimming pools, while penthouses are complemented by expansive terraces and private pools, creating a refined expression of modern luxury and privacy.

The Orchard Place Tower C is a contemporary residential development designed around the idea of comfortable, relaxed living surrounded by greenery. The architectural concept combines modern forms with open, fluid spaces and a strong connection to the landscaped environment. The tower features a welcoming lobby and public spaces designed to create an immediate sense of belonging, while spacious balconies, floor-to-ceiling windows and abundant natural light bring a strong connection between the residences and their surroundings.

Yigo Luxe rises as a striking tower that unites contemporary living within the YIGO Life OS ecosystem. It offers studios, one‑bedroom, two‑bedroom, and two‑bedroom units with study and maid’s room, forming five distinct residence types tailored to varied lifestyles. The vertical composition spans twenty‑four residential floors atop four podium parking levels and a basement, while four landscaped sky gardens thread through the height, creating a distinctive vertical community where greenery meets architecture.

Verso introduces a curated collection of one‑, two‑ and four‑bedroom homes arranged across basements, podium levels and a fifteen‑storey tower, each unit boasting private balconies and terraces that frame the horizon. Thoughtful design integrates contemporary kitchen cabinets, sleek countertops, fully tiled bathrooms, built‑in wardrobes, double‑glazed windows and fibre‑optic connectivity, establishing a seamless blend of comfort and technology. The development also incorporates ground‑level retail venues that complete a balanced community framework.

projects.d: 77 Shades of Green Real Estate Development L.L.C
projects.ov: 77S Tower stands as a mixed‑use marvel that reimagines high‑rise living with a striking full‑height glass façade and an integrated smart AI system. The development introduces the region’s inaugural sky villas, each featuring private cantilevered glass pools and dedicated sky backyards, while the towering structure crowns its silhouette with the highest open‑air temperature‑controlled sky park and a half‑Olympic infinity pool. Residences range from elegantly appointed apartments with soaring ceilings to expansive penthouses boasting double‑height spaces and outdoor jacuzzis, all reflecting a bold architectural vision.

Juman 2 is an exclusive waterfront residential, offering a refined collection of contemporary residences designed around the beauty of coastal living. Set along the marina, the project combines modern architecture with regional influences, spacious layouts, and front-row views of the waterfront, marina, and Abu Dhabi skyline. The residences include executive suites, stylish lofts, and spacious four-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully designed to balance functionality, comfort, and contemporary elegance.

Tessera – Al Ghurair stands as an extraordinary residential masterpiece, conceived by the internationally celebrated Portuguese studio Aires Mateus, led by brothers Manuel and Francisco. The development introduces an architecture of subtraction, where mass is removed, voids are carved, and frontages are drawn back to forge a monolithic form shaped as much by absence as by presence, giving the building a strikingly floating silhouette. Landscape‑graded walkways beneath the structure open onto dedicated amenity zones, delivering a grounded yet elevated living experience.

Juman 3 is a residential development by ICT Real Estate Development, forming the latest phase of the Juman collection. The offering comprises water-facing townhomes, two-bedroom signature duplexes, one-bedroom lofts, one-to-three-bedroom apartments, and executive studios. Designed with generous interiors and a contemporary architectural style, the project is positioned as a spacious, refined residential offering with panoramic waterfront views. The architecture is modern and seamlessly integrated with the surrounding waterfront, creating a balanced environment where everyday life meets a relaxed marina atmosphere.

Juman 1 is a nine-floor residential tower developed by ICT Real Estate Development. The tower comprises a range of residence formats, including studios and one, two, three, and four-bedroom apartments. The architecture combines a contemporary design language with waterfront-oriented layouts and panoramic views, positioning the project as an elevated residential offering within its market segment.

Cresswell Homes is a contemporary residential development, designed as a peaceful retreat within a dynamic urban setting. The project features a limited collection of 70 apartments, including one- and two-bedroom units, thoughtfully planned to offer comfort, natural light, and functional living spaces. The architecture combines clean geometric lines with a modern aesthetic, creating a refined yet welcoming environment where nature-inspired elements blend with city living.

Plaza 2 is a residential development by Reportage Properties, built as a square-shaped, low-rise complex comprising a ground floor and five residential floors. The collection offers studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom and four-bedroom apartments together with a limited number of four-bedroom townhouses. Facades follow a modern Arabian architectural language, softened by an Arabesque-inspired pattern, with the design conceived around energy-efficient principles, positioning Plaza 2 as a contemporary, environmentally conscious residential address.

Lawncrest by Zimaya Properties is a contemporary residential development located in Dubai Production City, designed as a modern living space set against a lush green backdrop. The project features a ground floor, 2 podium plus 8 residential floors configuration, offering a total of 183 units, including studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments with select layouts featuring storage and maid’s rooms. Overlooking one of Dubai’s finest golf landscapes, it creates a serene and elevated lifestyle environment.

Purvanchal Sunbliss Residences is a thoughtfully designed residential development by Purvanchal Real Estate Developers, located in Al Furjan, Dubai, just steps away from the metro station. The project features a ground floor, one podium level, and ten residential floors, offering a limited collection of 99 family-focused homes. The development includes a range of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, some with maid’s rooms and storage spaces, all designed with spacious layouts, large windows, and a strong focus on natural light and everyday comfort.

Purvanchal Townhouses by Purvanchal Development presents a contemporary collection of elegant two-level homes in Al Furjan, designed for comfortable family living. Each residence features a ground floor and one upper level, offering well-balanced layouts with two bedrooms and a guest room. The architecture combines modern simplicity with subtle classical and oriental touches, expressed through soft sand-beige facades, arched openings, decorative details, and large windows that bring in abundant natural light.

The Gate Residencies is a mid-rise residential apartment building developed by Reportage Properties, rising across eight floors above ground level. Residence formats include studio, junior one-bedroom, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, three-bedroom and four-bedroom apartments together with duplex townhouse units. The project is positioned as a contemporary, sustainability-minded residential address combining exterior architecture with a modern look and interiors designed for everyday comfort.

Al Maryah Vista is a residential development presented as the first residential building of its kind within its waterfront community, the project offers an exquisite collection of premium homes together with a limited number of one-of-a-kind duplex penthouses framed by panoramic skyline and waterfront views. The architectural design follows a consistent, forward-looking approach, with attention to exterior finishing and balcony detailing carried across the building's contemporary silhouette.

projects.n: Ramada Residences by Wyndham in Dubai South
projects.ov: Ramada Residences by Wyndham in Dubai South is a premium serviced residential project by Lincoln Star Real Estate Development, created to combine refined design with the comfort and service of an international hospitality brand.
