The development offers fully serviced studios, 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments designed for an elegant, effortless lifestyle.

Enara by Omniyat is a single-tower commercial development rising across 21 levels. The tower is designed on a large-format column grid with a compact rear core, providing flexible open floor plates. Office formats within the building include Grand Offices and Ultra-Grand Offices, with select single-tenancy floors offering direct lift access and further scope to combine floors into duplex or triplex configurations. The building is positioned as an ultra-luxury business address for global business leaders.

The Symphony by Imtiaz is envisioned as an architectural composition shaped by movement, light, and sculptural geometry. Created in collaboration with the legacy of Zaha Hadid, the project carries her philosophy of fluid forms and emotional spatial design. The building rises as a living sculpture — its curves, shadows, and rhythms forming a quiet dialogue with the surrounding landscape. Rather than imposing scale, The Symphony expresses luxury through precision, artistry, and a refined balance between structure and human experience.

Sunset Bay Grand by Imtiaz is a contemporary residential development designed to combine coastal-inspired architecture with modern luxury living. The project features elegantly designed residences characterized by spacious layouts, high ceilings, abundant natural light, and seamless transitions between indoor and outdoor spaces. The architectural concept emphasizes openness, comfort, and refined aesthetics, creating homes that balance functionality with sophisticated design.

Creek Views 4 by Azizi Developments is a distinctive residential tower that combines the comfort of city living with a sense of privacy and relaxation. Elegant flowing lines and softly rounded upper levels with integrated lighting create a striking contrast with the glass facades and balconies below. The tower rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and four podium levels to fourteen residential floors and a roof, offering premium one-bedroom apartments, an exclusive three-bedroom penthouse and commercial units.

Jaddaf Beach Oasis by Azizi Developments is a residential development that combines the calm of a beachside setting with the convenience of city infrastructure. Two elegant towers complement each other in harmony, with a contemporary, refined design accentuated by flowing lines and curved balconies with glass railings. The development offers a carefully curated selection of studios, spacious one-bedroom apartments and luxurious penthouses, together with retail units at street level.

Azizi Amir by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with stylish architecture, modern facade geometry and premium finishes inside and out. The building rises from a ground floor and two podium levels to nine residential floors and a roof, creating a calm, low-rise setting within an established community. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments designed with an emphasis on comfort and functionality for couples, professionals and growing families.

Azizi Jewel by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with modern architecture, where glass facades lend the building elegance and landscaped green areas create a comfortable urban setting. Clean lines and a balanced blend of style and functionality give the building a timeless character. It rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to seven residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-bedroom apartments that combine the energy of city life with a calm atmosphere.

Azizi Sakandar by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with a modern design that opens up panoramic views of the city. Clean lines, balconies and generous glazing give the building a bright, elegant presence within an established community. It rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and two podium levels to eleven residential floors and a roof, offering modern studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with retail units at street level.

Azizi Florence by Azizi Developments is a large master-planned community designed as a harmonious blend of nature, architecture and family living. The community is arranged in six clusters, with Lucardo, Bellarno and Soffiano in a contemporary style and Versilia, Pienza and Siena radiating Mediterranean charm. It offers three- and four-bedroom townhouses and four-, five- and six-bedroom villas, each with a maid's room, together with apartments.

Azizi Mina by Azizi Developments is a distinctive beachfront residential building whose streamlined form, horizontal balconies and brilliant white finish recall a luxury cruise liner. The building rises from a ground floor and a first floor to nine residential levels, offering one- and two-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom penthouses, many with expansive balconies that open onto panoramic views of the sea, the island and the city skyline.

Azizi Plaza by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building that combines clean architecture with a practical approach to everyday community living. Panoramic windows and seamless balconies give the facade a light, modern character. The building rises from a ground floor to twelve residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments designed with efficient layouts for professionals, couples and small families seeking a ready home in an established neighbourhood.

Azizi Milan is a contemporary residential development by Azizi Developments, located in the City of Arabia within Dubailand. Inspired by the elegance of Italian design, the project reflects architectural elements reminiscent of Milan’s iconic Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, combining timeless aesthetics with modern urban living. The development offers a range of studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments, all designed with functional layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a focus on natural light, creating a refined and comfortable residential environment suited for both end-users and investors.

Riviera 61 by Azizi is an exquisite high-end residential development that sets the stage for an unparalleled living experience, offering beautifully designed studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments. This exceptional building is surrounded by a world of recreational opportunities, a sparkling crystal lagoon, and a lively boulevard, making it the ultimate address for those who seek the best of both worlds. The homes are a warm and inviting addition to the community, offering a blend of comfort and sophistication that complements every lifestyle.

Riviera 13 by Azizi Developments is a residential building within a waterfront community that combines a French Mediterranean design perspective with modern architecture. Soft facade tones, balconies and generous glazing give the building a light, elegant character, while the surrounding boulevard, lagoon and greenery create a relaxed resort setting. The building rises from a ground floor to seven residential floors, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments.

Burj Azizi by Azizi Developments is a landmark supertall tower set to become the second tallest building in the world, rising to one hundred and thirty-one floors. Conceived as an architectural marvel that brings together world cultures and sensory experiences, the tower combines hotel apartments on its lower residential levels, private apartments above and penthouses and royal penthouses at the top, all with floor-to-ceiling windows and sweeping views of the skyline and the Arabian Gulf.

Monaco Mansions by Azizi Developments is a collection of ultra-luxury waterfront villas within a large lagoon master community, arranged in eight clusters surrounded by Venetian-style lagoons, green parks and striking architecture. Designs range from royal classicism to contemporary minimalism, with facades oriented towards both the road and the water. The collection offers exclusive six- to eight-bedroom mansions, each spread over four levels connected by a private lift.

Azizi Grand is a modern residential development located in the dynamic Dubai Sports City, designed to redefine urban living through a blend of contemporary architecture and sustainable design principles. The project comprises 431 spacious apartments, including studios, one- and two-bedroom layouts, all thoughtfully planned with open configurations and expansive end-to-end balconies. The architecture emphasizes clean lines, natural light, and functional elegance, creating a harmonious living environment that reflects the active and vibrant character of the community.

Riviera Beachfront by Azizi is a collection of three residential towers along the waterfront of a Riviera-inspired community, forming an elegant architectural landmark beside the lagoon. Contemporary design with panoramic glazing and dynamic facade lines gives the towers a light, modern character, while each rises above three basement levels and a ground floor to twenty residential floors and a roof. The collection offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, together with retail units on the lower levels.

Azizi Wasel by Azizi Developments is a luxury waterfront high-rise with a fluid, organic exterior, where several tiers of balconies create a cascading effect. White curved forms are accentuated by subtle integrated lighting, giving the tower an elegant, sculptural look. The building rises above three basement levels and a ground floor to thirteen residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, three- and four-bedroom penthouses and retail units.

Riviera Rêve is a premium waterfront residential development inspired by the elegance of the French Riviera, offering a refined lifestyle centered around lagoon living. Architecturally, the project is defined by three striking towers designed to reflect the movement of water, incorporating solar panels and vertical greenery to enhance sustainability and air quality. The development features spacious, well-crafted apartments with expansive layouts and panoramic lagoon views, creating a seamless blend of modern design, natural elements, and urban sophistication.

Azizi Ruby by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with elegant glass balconies and a striking golden-toned facade that blends harmoniously with the surrounding greenery. Clean lines and a refined palette give the building a warm, modern presence within a popular family community. It rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and four podium levels to thirteen residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with retail units.

Riviera 60 by Azizi Developments is a residential building in a Mediterranean architectural style, distinguished by stained-glass details and elegant facades. Balconies, generous glazing and a warm palette give the building a welcoming, refined character within a waterfront community. It rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to eight residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with commercial units at street level.

Riviera 65 is a contemporary residential development located in Meydan’s vibrant community in Dubai. The complex comprises four residential buildings with private road access and a lively boulevard offering a variety of recreational and lifestyle activities. The development provides a selection of studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, combining modern urban living with a range of amenities and services within close reach.

Azizi Emerald by Azizi Developments is a contemporary commercial building where business ambition meets refined design. A distinctive rounded architectural style with flowing golden balconies frames large glass facades, while an elegant upper volume rests on a solid, clean-lined base. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and five podium levels to eleven office floors and a roof, offering innovative office spaces together with retail units at street level.

Azizi Noura by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with a refined tiered design, where a slender vertical tower rises above a more substantial base. The facade combines light modern panels with elegant curved accents and generous balconies with glass railings, creating a sense of depth and sophistication. The building rises from a ground floor and three podium levels to eleven residential floors, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with commercial units.

Creek Views 3 by Azizi Developments is a residential tower with an impressive stepped facade, where numerous balconies create a layered, contemporary appearance. A clean white exterior is accentuated by horizontal lines and generous glazing that give the building an elegant, modern look. The tower rises from a ground floor and a three-level podium to nineteen residential floors, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units at street level.

Azizi Neila by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building designed for a peaceful yet well-connected urban lifestyle. A modern architectural style with clean lines and light tones gives the building an elegant, welcoming appearance within a calm, established neighbourhood. It rises from a ground floor and two podium levels to nine residential floors, offering studios and one-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units at street level.

Riviera 58 by Azizi Developments is a residential building that blends the charm of Mediterranean design with contemporary elements to create an ideal setting for everyday living. The exterior is defined by crisp geometric lines and a combination of high-quality materials, giving the building a refined, modern presence. It rises from a ground floor to eight residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts, together with retail units at street level.

Azizi Wares by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with a refined exterior defined by a grid facade with integrated glass balconies and greenery. Warm metallic accents and clean vertical lines create an elegant, harmonious appearance within the urban landscape. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and three podium levels to seven residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with retail units on the lower levels.

Azizi Arian by Azizi Developments is a modern high-rise residential tower with a striking wave-like facade, where staggered balconies create a dynamic rippling effect that reflects the energy of the surrounding business hub. Smooth white curves, glass balustrades and warm louvres are softened by lush greenery cascading from above. The tower rises above three basement levels, a ground floor, a mezzanine and five podium levels to seventeen residential floors and a roof.

Riviera 55 by Azizi is a contemporary residential building within a Riviera-inspired waterfront community, combining geometric facade lines with an elegant and harmonious character. The building rises from a ground floor to eight residential floors, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units at street level. Every home has a balcony, while panoramic windows open views of the skyline, the crystal lagoon and the lush greenery of the community.

Azizi Lina by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with elegant facades and floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows that create a sense of harmony with the lively urban surroundings. Clean lines and efficient planning give the building a modern, practical character. It rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and three podium levels to nine residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units.

Azizi David by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential tower set on the bank of the creek, blending the waterfront heritage of the old city with modern sophistication. A slender tower rises above a wide, light-toned podium, giving the building a balanced silhouette, while an elegant wave-like metal screen defines the base and the tower above shows clean lines and spacious balconies with glass railings. The building rises from a ground floor and a four-level podium to fifteen residential floors and a roof.

Azizi Venice by Azizi Developments is a large-scale waterfront master community that blends Venetian elegance with contemporary design around a crystal lagoon. A collection of mid-rise residential buildings, waterfront villas and mansions is finished with high-quality European materials, sensual design lines and refined detailing. The community offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, villas and premium retail units, with panoramic windows opening onto the lagoon and the lively boulevard.

Azizi Leily by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential tower that combines a streamlined volume with a wide, light-toned podium, creating a balanced modern aesthetic beside the creek. An elegant wave-like metal screen adds texture at the base, while the clean geometry of the tower is complemented by spacious balconies with glass railings. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and four podium levels to fifteen residential floors and a rooftop with leisure areas.

Azizi Abraham by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential tower with striking facades and a thoughtful design that combines aesthetics with functionality. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor, a mezzanine and three podium levels to sixteen residential floors and a roof. The collection offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, together with two- and three-bedroom duplexes and premium retail units at street level.

Azizi Gabriel by Azizi Developments is an elegant residential building with a stepped contemporary facade, where a dark exterior is complemented by numerous balconies with glass railings and striking linear lighting. Lush landscaping frames the structure and emphasises its refined, modern presence. The building rises above four basement levels, lower and upper ground floors and three podium levels to eleven residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units.

Aspirz is an innovative mixed-use development by Danube Properties. The project introduces a unique concept that combines luxury residential living with flexible commercial functionality, offering fully furnished convertible hotel apartments from the 17th to the 40th floor. The complex features studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, as well as office space, meeting the needs of diverse residents and businesses. This forward-thinking approach reflects the growing demand for adaptable spaces that support both productivity and comfort within a single property.

Bab Al Qasr Beach Resort Residence 77 is a beachfront residential development by Burtville Developments, presented as a cluster of high-rise towers set on a landscaped beachfront podium. The collection includes apartment and duplex residence formats, with layouts arranged across both single-level and split-level plans. The project is positioned as a resort-style residential address combining tower living with direct beachfront frontage.
Bab Al Qasr Beach Resort Residence 77 is a distinctive beachfront development by Burtville Developments, designed as a collection of elegant high-rise towers rising from a landscaped podium.

Bab Al Qasr Garden Residences 65, developed under the esteemed Bab Al Qasr brand, is a masterpiece of resort-inspired design, cleverly blending elegant architecture, lush green landscapes, and exceptional hospitality standards to create a unique residential oasis. This low-density community boasts an impressive array of residences, including simplex, duplex, and triplex sky villas with private elevators in selected units, offering a sophisticated living experience that seamlessly combines nature, privacy, and luxury.

Sparklz by Danube Properties is a contemporary residential development located in the vibrant Al Furjan community of Dubai. The 15-storey project offers a selection of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments designed to meet the needs of modern urban lifestyles. Combining sleek architecture with smart home technology and sustainable design principles, Sparklz creates a comfortable and future-oriented living environment.

Timez by Danube Properties is a landmark residential development that combines contemporary architecture with timeless elegance. Characterized by its sleek design and shimmering glass façades, the project creates a striking presence on the skyline while offering a sophisticated urban lifestyle. The development features a collection of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, including innovative convertible apartments that can adapt to changing lifestyle needs. By blending smart functionality with refined aesthetics, Timez delivers a modern living experience focused on flexibility, comfort, and long-term value.

Oasiz 2 by Danube Properties is a contemporary residential tower located in Dubai Silicon Oasis, offering a modern lifestyle within a dynamic and well-connected district. Rising 31 storeys, the project stands out with its sleek architectural design and thoughtfully planned living spaces, creating a balance between urban convenience and a comfortable atmosphere for everyday life.

Oasiz by Danube Properties is a contemporary residential development in Dubai, offering a balanced blend of affordable luxury and modern design. The project is created for those seeking a stylish yet comfortable lifestyle, combining elegant architecture with thoughtfully designed living spaces that promote both relaxation and everyday functionality.

Bayz 102 is a premium residential development by Danube Properties, located in the prestigious Business Bay district. The project offers an extensive selection of residences, including studios, 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, and exclusive penthouses, all designed to combine contemporary luxury with exceptional functionality. Positioned in one of Dubai’s most dynamic urban destinations, Bayz 102 provides residents with breathtaking views of Burj Khalifa and seamless access to the city's key business, leisure, and entertainment hubs.

Diamondz is a luxury residential development by Danube Properties, inspired by the brilliance, rarity, and elegance of a diamond. The project offers a wide selection of residences ranging from contemporary studios to spacious four-bedroom apartments, creating options for different lifestyles and investment goals. Designed with a strong emphasis on sophistication and exclusivity, Diamondz combines modern architecture with premium residential features, establishing itself as a distinctive address within Dubai’s luxury real estate landscape.

Bayz 101 is a landmark residential tower by Danube Properties, strategically positioned in the prestigious Business Bay district. Rising prominently above the surrounding skyline, the development offers panoramic views of some of Dubai’s most recognizable landmarks, including Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Canal, Sheikh Zayed Road, Jumeirah, and the coastline. Designed to provide a sophisticated urban lifestyle, the tower combines contemporary architecture with a prime central location, placing residents within easy reach of the city's major business, leisure, and entertainment destinations.

Bond Enclave by Pearlshire Developments is a striking residential project in Arjan, conceived as a sculptural expression of contemporary luxury. Defined by flowing façades, aerodynamic curves, and a bold architectural silhouette, the development brings a sense of movement and elegance to its urban setting. Expansive glazing and wraparound terraces enhance the visual connection between the residences and their surroundings, creating a living environment that feels both dynamic and serene, with views stretching across greenery and the city skyline.

Bond Living by Pearlshire Developments is a refined residential project thoughtfully designed for modern, everyday living, offering a boutique collection of studio, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments. The development blends elegant architecture with smart layouts, generous natural light, and calming interiors that feel both intuitive and welcoming. With its limited number of residences, Bond Living creates a private, well-balanced environment that reflects Pearlshire’s hospitality-driven approach to home design.

Sportz by Danube is a modern residential development located in Dubai Sports City, offering a dynamic lifestyle within a vibrant, sports-focused environment. The project combines contemporary living with a strong investment appeal, featuring a pre-launch offer with a guaranteed net ROI of 6% per annum for three years, making it an attractive opportunity for investors seeking stable returns in Dubai’s real estate market.

Knightsbridge Phase 2, by LEOS Developments, is a masterpiece of contemporary design, blending the architectural heritage of Knightsbridge, Mayfair, and Hyde Park in London with a unique climate-adaptive wellness approach. This low-density community features two exquisite villa formats, the Chatsworth five-bedroom villa and the Blenheim six-bedroom signature villa, each showcasing a two-storey layout with elevated ceiling heights and a private in-plot pool.

La Vera Creek is a refined residential development by Ahmadyar Developments, a luxury real estate company rooted in the legacy of Ahmad Yar Group. This elegantly designed residence offers studios, one, two, and three-bedroom homes where warm materials, open layouts, and abundant natural light create a balanced and sophisticated living experience. Every element is carefully considered to craft a space that feels both elevated and effortless.

Breeze by Trace is a residential tower on Al Reem Island, conceived around the idea of effortless, uncomplicated living. The building rises from a sculpted podium with flowing, wave-patterned façades and arched glazed entrances, while the tower above is wrapped in layered balconies with warm accent lighting. The residential collection spans one, two, three and four-bedroom apartments, with retail units at ground level. Each layout is planned for practicality and natural light, giving residents generous, easy-to-use living space.

Zeta by Acube Developments is a contemporary residential development located in the rapidly growing community of Dubai. Comprising 147 thoughtfully designed residences across 13 residential floors, the project offers a collection of fully furnished studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, all featuring private balconies and smart home readiness. Selected residences are further enhanced with private jacuzzis, creating an elevated living experience that seamlessly combines comfort, functionality, and modern design.

Zenith D1 is a contemporary residential development by Zenith Group, located in Dubai South (DWC), designed as a mid-rise building with a focus on efficient modern living. The project offers a selection of studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully planned to maximize space and functionality. The development emphasizes a clean architectural approach combined with high-end residential appeal.

Wyndham Residences Al Marjan Island by Divine One Group is a refined branded residential project where world-class hospitality seamlessly blends with everyday living, creating a calm and welcoming atmosphere defined by comfort and connection. The development offers a thoughtfully curated collection of studio and 1-bedroom apartments, each designed to feel intuitive, elegant, and effortlessly livable. With the trusted legacy of Wyndham behind it, the project delivers a lifestyle that feels both elevated and reassuring, where every detail reflects care, warmth, and timeless appeal.

Waterfront by Missoni is an exclusive waterfront residential developmen, created through a collaboration between Emirates Developments and the iconic Italian fashion house Missoni. The project brings Missoni’s distinctive design language into architecture and interiors, translating its signature approach to colour, material, texture, and pattern into a sophisticated residential setting. Positioned between the canal and the sea, the development offers a strong connection to the waterfront, with direct beach access and views extending across the surrounding island, water, and cityscape.

Vivo South is a contemporary residential development that brings modern urban living to life with a refined and elegant concept. It offers a selection of thoughtfully designed studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, catering to a wide range of lifestyle needs and preferences. With its Urban Chic architectural style and a strong focus on functionality, the project creates a perfect balance between comfort, design, and everyday practicality.

Velora Residence is a boutique residential building by Atara Development, shaped around a design concept the developer calls The Curated Pause, built on the elements of water, air, light and wood. The architecture follows a contemporary rhythm and refined simplicity, with clean lines, light-filled interiors and a strong connection between indoor and outdoor space. The building rises above a ground level and podium to residential floors crowned by a rooftop, offering one- and two-bedroom apartments alongside four-bedroom penthouses. Generous balconies extend the living areas of the residences.

The Vault by Imtiaz is a boutique commercial building that combines premium office spaces with ground-floor retail units in a compact, highly considered setting. A fully glazed façade, a distinctive bronze-toned form and a refined palette of materials give the building a strong visual presence and a calm, exclusive character. The office floors are planned around flexible, modular configurations, allowing companies of different sizes to shape their workspace around the way they operate.

The Level is a waterfront residential tower by BI Group, set directly on the community's crystal lagoon. The building rises above a ground floor with a lobby and retail units and podium parking levels, with a dedicated amenity level and residential floors above. The residences comprise one- and two-bedroom apartments with efficient layouts, natural light and private balconies connecting the homes to their lagoon-side surroundings.

The Biltmore Residences Sufouh by GJ Properties is a masterpiece of modern architecture, boasting a bold, sculptural design that showcases flowing forms and expansive glass façades, emphasizing light, openness, and breathtaking panoramic city views. This striking high-rise development comprises a refined collection of one- and two-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive four-bedroom penthouses with maid’s rooms, all nestled within a sophisticated urban setting. The tower's design is a testament to the developer's commitment to creating a unique and captivating living experience.

Soréi by Zoya is a residential project whose concept combines contemporary architecture, thoughtfully designed living spaces and amenities for leisure, wellness and everyday living. The building is defined by distinctive flowing lines, rounded corners and cascading balconies with integrated greenery. Its façade pairs light-toned surfaces with panoramic glazing and wood-effect decorative elements, while open terraces with landscaped greenery create a layered architectural appearance and connect the building with its surrounding landscape. The residences comprise studios and two-bedroom apartments.

Tavora Grand by JHK Developments emerges as an expansive, elevated residential experience, a development that is grand by name and grand by nature, designed for those who value space, balance, and understated quality. This is a place where comfort meets elegance, and community meets privacy, creating a harmonious balance where residents can live, relax, and thrive.

Soma Residences is a low-rise residential development by Origami. The architecture is defined by a sculptural silhouette in sun-bleached stone, sand-toned surfaces and weathered timber, with generous balconies across every residence. Residence formats include one-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom apartments and duplex residences. The project is enrolled to pursue WELL Gold Certification, reflecting a wellbeing-led design approach.

Solaya is a masterful beachfront creation where innovative architecture beautifully complements the eternal allure of Dubai's shoreline, showcasing a sophisticated design aesthetic that embodies the essence of refined living. The development's nine boutique buildings are meticulously arranged to maximize breathtaking sea and skyline views, creating a stunning visual dialogue between the natural beauty of the surroundings and the elegance of the design, with clean lines, expansive glazing, and fluid indoor-outdoor transitions defining the architectural language.

Reef 995 is an exceptional luxury residential project that redefines modern living through innovation, elegance, and thoughtful design. The development offers a refined collection of residences ranging from stylish studios to spacious family homes, all created to suit a variety of lifestyles. Every home is designed to deliver a seamless balance between comfort, sophistication, and contemporary living, making the project stand out as a truly distinctive residential offering.

Radiant Legacy is a commercial tower with 36 floors of office space, designed as a dedicated address for business. The project offers 158 office suites in small, medium and large formats, suitable for everything from independent practices to established and growing companies. Each suite is planned to make the most of natural light and views, while the tower's flowing, wave-shaped facade gives the building a distinctive presence on the skyline.

Platinum Heights is a contemporary residential tower by Team Arcon, rising 32 floors above the skyline of Ajman. The development features a distinctive architectural design with elegant vertical fins, panoramic glass façades, and landscaped terraces, creating a modern and sophisticated appearance. The project offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as 4-bedroom duplexes and triplexes, thoughtfully designed to provide comfort, space, and stunning city and coastline views.

Palm Springs is a residential community by Nakheel that brings together contemporary villas and townhouses within a nature-led masterplan of green corridors, waterways and landscaped gardens. The Rancho villas offer four- and five-bedroom layouts with expansive living areas and en-suite bedrooms, while the Aliso townhouses provide three- and four-bedroom homes with a more intimate scale and private gardens. Distinctive architecture, elegant proportions and walkable streets give the neighbourhood a relaxed, resort-like character.

projects.n: Palace Residences Hillside Towers A & B
projects.ov: Palace Residences Hillside Towers A & B is a new benchmark in refined living, where timeless Arabesque sophistication meets the serenity of nature. Surrounded by lush green landscapes and connected to Dubai’s key destinations, the development offers a sense of balance — close to the city yet worlds apart in tranquility. Its contemporary architecture reflects understated grandeur, with soft curves, clean lines, and warm earthy tones inspired by the natural beauty of the hills and horizon.

New Project by Tarrad is an elegant mixed-use residential tower that blends contemporary architecture with a warm, welcoming sense of home. Its refined facade of soft cream stone, bronze-toned vertical fins and gently curved edges gives the building a graceful and instantly recognisable silhouette. Residents can choose from stylish studios, one-bedroom apartments in two thoughtful layouts and spacious two-bedroom homes, while ground-level retail units bring everyday convenience right to the doorstep.

projects.n: New Project by Kusto Homes X AYS Developers
projects.ov: New Project by AYS Developers rises as a ten‑storey tower that balances sleek contemporary design with community‑focused planning. The development presents a curated mix of one‑, two-bedroom apartments and studios, each engineered for individuals, professionals and first‑time buyers who value practical layouts and modern finishes. Thoughtful spatial planning ensures that every residence feels both comfortable and convenient, catering to owners and investors alike.

Maseel Phase 1 is a beachfront master community conceived around the idea of architecture that breathes with the sea. The planning positions residential buildings, townhouses and villas so that sea views open up from every component, including the rear sides of the residential buildings. The residential offer spans apartments, townhouses with garden views, garden villas, beach villas with direct beach access and water-breaker villas, complemented by retail, dining and everyday services within the community.

Magnolia embodies a refined balance of calm sophistication and contemporary vision, creating an atmosphere where elegance feels effortless. Its architectural silhouette is defined by clean lines, warm tones, and a serene aesthetic that evokes a sense of harmony from the very first impression. Crafted with a focus on design excellence, the project reflects thoughtful spatial planning and a cohesive visual identity.

Lyra, brought to life by Majid Al Futtaim, stands as a nature‑inspired residential tower that crowns the edge of a meticulously landscaped forest. The structure lifts above a ground level and offers a mix of one‑ and two‑bedroom homes, including garden‑type apartments on the lower tier that open onto private outdoor spaces. Its architectural expression embraces the surrounding greenery, framing views of the Ghaf Woods canopy for every resident.

Lunara Tower by Tarrad Development emerges as an exceptional residential address, a beautifully proportioned building of seven residential floors rising above a ground level and two basement levels, offering a curated collection of one and two-bedroom homes. Comprising one hundred and nineteen residences, this thoughtfully designed development achieves remarkable efficiency, with sellable area representing a remarkable proportion of the allowable gross floor area. Every residence has been carefully planned to maximise space, light, and comfort, creating a refined sanctuary where contemporary design meets everyday practicality.

Lumina by Vision is an elegant residential development, offering a perfect combination of modern design, comfort, and style. The project features a collection of studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to provide functional living spaces and a comfortable lifestyle.

Lorévia Collection introduces a boutique waterfront enclave composed of studios and generously proportioned one‑ and two‑bedroom homes. Delivered in a semi‑furnished state, each residence balances ready‑to‑live convenience with room for personal expression. The development is limited to one hundred and seventy‑eight units, fostering an intimate atmosphere that feels both exclusive and welcoming.

Lincoln Star Residence 5 is a low-rise apartment residence conceived around architecture, nature and refined living. Its light-coloured façades, distinctive horizontal lines and spacious balconies with glass railings are complemented by cascading landscaped terraces. Biophilic design principles shape the landscape, with shaded garden corridors, flowering terraces and reflective water features. Residences are oriented to capture daylight from morning to evening through floor-to-ceiling glazing, deep-set terraces and cross-ventilated layouts.

JW Marriott Residences Yas Island is a branded beachfront community developed by Taraf, set directly on the sand with a championship golf course running alongside. It marks the first residential address of the JW Marriott brand in the area, with residential operations and design standards delivered by Marriott International. The architecture draws on the landscape, light and heritage of the region, and the collection spans one, two and three bedroom apartments, four bedroom duplex residences and a single exclusive penthouse in each tower.

Jura Terraces is a residential tower developed by Majid Developments, with an architectural form inspired by the flowing contours of the Jura Mountains. The building rises across a ground floor and 13 upper levels topped by a roof level, characterised by curved balconies and layered terraces that create a sculptural, nature-informed silhouette. The development comprises 231 residences across studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment formats, with units offering community, skyline, amenities, or park views. The project is positioned as a family-oriented address combining contemporary architecture with lasting design value.

projects.n: John Richmond Residences at Mira Coral Bay
projects.ov: John Richmond Residences at Mira Coral Bay unveils itself as the world's first multi-branded waterfront community, an extraordinary destination where branded residences, five-star hospitality, and private beaches converge to create an unparalleled living experience. This visionary development, developed in partnership with Marjan, Ras Al Khaimah's master developer, offers a stunning collection of fully furnished homes that translate the bold aesthetic of British fashion legend John Richmond into a exquisite residential offering.

Hayat 8 is a gated villa cluster by Dubai South Properties within the wider Hayat master community, a wellness-oriented destination where residences sit among landscaped green spaces. The cluster is a limited collection of standalone villas offering four-, five- and six-bedroom layouts, each arranged over ground, first and second levels and completed with a roof terrace. The architecture is rooted in minimalism and guided by nature, using natural materials, soft hues and intentional layouts, while each villa is positioned to maximise privacy within a walkable neighbourhood with green views.

Green Source by Advanced Properties is a premium residential complex with contemporary architecture. The project has curved balcony edges, white horizontal bands and contrasting warm-toned upper sections. Projecting balconies and recessed façade sections create depth across the exterior, giving the building a layered appearance.

Galleria Residences by Evera Development is a visionary residential project, in one of the city's most promising lifestyle and investment destinations. This thoughtfully designed development offers a selection of studios and one and two-bedroom apartments across a modern structure featuring ground plus residential floors with a rooftop amenity deck. Every residence has been crafted to provide a canvas for living, where comfort, style, and functionality come together in perfect harmony.

Future Avenue is a contemporary residential development shaped around a quieter interpretation of modern luxury, with a strong focus on comfort, connection and family life. The concept brings together thoughtfully designed architecture, open spaces and a warm, welcoming atmosphere, creating a home environment where everyday living feels calm and effortless. Generous glazing, expansive outdoor spaces and carefully integrated greenery create a seamless relationship between the residences and the surrounding environment, while the overall design combines contemporary elegance with a sense of warmth and belonging.

Roudah is a nature-inspired residential building nestled within the heart of Expo Valley Views, where architecture gently blends with the surrounding landscape. Designed to follow the natural contours of the valley, Roudah rises organically from the terrain, opening toward light, greenery, and expansive views, and offers a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences arranged across multiple floors. A sense of calm, balance, and connection to nature defines the character of this residence, reflected in its soft architectural lines, earthy tones, and tranquil outdoor settings.

Elyra Residences by Enaam is a boutique residential development featuring a thoughtfully designed collection of studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, as well as 2-bedroom apartments with a study. The project combines modern architecture with bright, comfortable living spaces, creating an inviting home environment designed for everyday comfort and contemporary lifestyles.

Elyra by Galaxy emerges as an exceptional wellness‑focused residential sanctuary, crafted to blend modern living with holistic wellbeing. The development presents a curated mix of studios, one‑bedroom, smart two‑bedroom, two‑bedroom and three‑bedroom homes, while selected residences enjoy the added indulgence of private pools and terraces. Its architectural language emphasizes open, airy layouts that frame natural light and foster a sense of calm.

ELAN Tower is a striking residential tower by Alfulaiti Development, marking the developer's debut project in Dubai and embodying its philosophy of timeless design and lasting value. The building brings together a refined collection of thoughtfully designed studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, each created to elevate everyday living. Every element of the project reflects a dedication to craftsmanship and quality, promising residents a home that is both inspiring and enduring.

Coralis Residences by Palladium is a masterfully crafted architectural marvel, drawing inspiration from the intricate forms of living coral to create a uniquely elegant identity that sets it apart from the ordinary. The building's graceful curves, organic geometry, and calming visual rhythm evoke a sense of refined serenity, making it feel like a living sculpture that envelops its residents in luxurious comfort.

Christian A. Rockefeller Business Tower is a landmark Grade A commercial tower, developed by LMD and carrying the Christian A. Rockefeller name. Conceived as an architectural icon designed to redefine the commercial skyline, the tower offers a prestigious collection of offices ranging from Prime and Elite suites to Executive half-floor and Presidential full-floor headquarters. Office floors are arranged by height, with fewer offices per floor on the upper levels for greater calm and city and sea views.

Avior by Acube Developments is envisioned as an iconic ultra-luxury residential masterpiece, inspired by the brilliance of the celestial star it is named after and designed to rise as one of the world’s tallest residential towers. The project offers an exceptional collection of 1 to 6 bedroom apartments, including duplex options, alongside The Elite Residences, The Imperial Residences, The Lumière Residences, Crown Duplexes, Signature Sky Villas, and the one-of-a-kind Presidential Palace penthouses. Avior promises a rare lifestyle that blends architectural grandeur with refined modern living.

Aris By Grid presents a refined residential silhouette that merges London’s timeless elegance with Dubai’s forward‑looking spirit. The building unfolds across a grounded podium, six residential tiers and a crowning rooftop, all articulated in contrasting dual tones and proportionate geometry that command a lasting first impression. A tropical‑inspired podium, lush with abundant planters, extends the London motif throughout the development, offering residents a distinctive sense of place.

Arche Residences is a contemporary low-rise residential development by Evera, defined by a distinctive architectural language that combines clean modern geometry with softer, curved forms. The façade is articulated by crisp white frames, sculptural projecting volumes and rounded balconies, creating a dynamic rhythm across the building while maintaining a refined and cohesive appearance.

Amali Residences stands as a waterfront masterpiece composed of two sleek towers linked by fully appointed podiums, creating an urban sanctuary that feels like a resort. The development offers a curated portfolio of one‑, two‑, three‑, four‑ and five‑bedroom homes, alongside rare duplexes and limited‑edition penthouses distinguished by double‑height ceilings, private pools and sweeping vistas. Architectural intent is expressed through a sculptural silhouette that frames the glittering skyline while embracing the riverfront ambience.

Al Haseen Residences 6 by Dugasta embodies a perfect fusion of modern design and timeless comfort, presenting a lifestyle that is both refined and welcoming. Offering studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, every home has been thoughtfully planned with spacious layouts that maximize natural light and functionality. The development represents an elegant expression of contemporary architecture, where sophistication and practicality blend seamlessly to elevate everyday living.

1970 Office Tower emerges as a bold and refined addition to Dubai's evolving skyline, conceived as a composition of distinct stacked volumes articulated with precision and clarity to create a layered architectural narrative. This magnificent tower celebrates segmentation through vertically stacked zones that create a strong visual rhythm, with recessed landscaped terraces and lighter intermediate floors that visually and functionally demarcate different parts of the building.

Maserati Island is a branded private island resort community conceived as a curated collection of waterfront homes, where every journey begins with a sea crossing to a dedicated arrival jetty. Low-rise residential buildings with sweeping curved terraces and layered, sculpted balconies wrap around sandy beaches, lagoons and boat moorings, so that most homes look directly onto open water and the city skyline.

Chapter 02 by Newbury Developments is a masterpiece of modern urban living, showcasing a refined vision that builds upon the success of its predecessor, with a curated collection of studios and one and two-bedroom apartments that blend international aesthetics with regional insight. The building's design features clean lines, spacious balconies, and refined detailing, creating a timeless residential experience where every element is curated with intention. This contemporary residential project boasts a sophisticated design aesthetic, with each residence crafted to provide a unique living experience.

Emaar's Mangrove project is the epitome of luxury and modern lifestyle in the heart of Dubai. Situated in the prestigious Dubai Creek Harbour, it offers a unique combination of contemporary design, upscale amenities and unrivaled levels of comfort.

Lum1nar is a contemporary residential development by Object1, thoughtfully designed to accommodate different rhythms of modern life. The project offers a balanced living environment where relaxation, activity, and social interaction coexist seamlessly. Residents benefit from a carefully curated selection of lifestyle amenities, including swimming pools for adults and children, a gym, sauna, clubhouse, barbecue areas, and shared social spaces, creating a complete and comfortable residential experience within a well-integrated community.

Perfectly located in a modern district, VALO emerges as a trailblazing urban jewel, seamlessly blending the serene atmosphere of the waterfront. VALO embodies contemporary sophistication, providing an exclusive blend of luxury, convenience, and distinctive urban charm.

Welcome to Sky Vista, where luxury living takes center stage in Dubai's Jumeirah Village Circle. These meticulously designed residences redefine opulence, offering fully furnished 2-bedroom and 3-bedroom homes. Immerse yourself in luxury, where every detail contributes to an unmatched living experience.

The F1FTH Tower, a contemporary residential development, showcases thoughtful architectural planning that positions the tower as a standout silhouette within its district. It presents a curated mix of studios, one‑bedroom and two‑bedroom apartments, each arranged to maximise comfort, functionality and a refined ambience for both solitary dwellers and growing families.

ÉLEVÉ is a contemporary luxury residential development distinguished by its modern architectural design and emphasis on elevated urban living. The project features a striking high-rise form inspired by movement and dynamism, complemented by thoughtfully designed residences and carefully curated communal spaces. Attention to detail is evident throughout the development, from the refined arrival experience to the sophisticated residential interiors. The overall concept combines contemporary aesthetics, functional layouts, and a cohesive design language to create a modern and comfortable living environment.

Step into Address Residences Zabeel and embrace a life that is exceptional in every way. In the bustling heart of Dubai's financial district, these four towers stand as landmarks of a refined existence. Here, luxury is the essence of every space, every view and every moment. This is where the city's energy fuses with the calm of upscale living, creating an experience that's as exhilarating as it is serene in the true signature Address style. At Address Residences Zabeel, evenings are gilded with urban brilliance and mornings are bathed in sunrise glory.

W1NNER Tower is a contemporary residential development by Object1, located in the dynamic community of Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT). Designed to deliver a balanced urban lifestyle, the project combines modern architecture with a calm residential atmosphere. Its strategic location ensures convenient access to key destinations across Dubai while offering residents a sense of privacy away from the city’s busiest districts.

Sama Yas by Aldar is a luxury residential community set within a lush park full of flowers, birds and trees, designed to elevate comfort, style and elegance. Its low-rise buildings rise from a ground floor to seven residential floors, with architecture led by Julian Cross of Woods Bagot and interiors shaped by Mustard and Linen. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, duplexes and garden apartments, with a signature restaurant and kitchen curated by acclaimed chef Izu Ani.

Visualize the dawn breaking over Dubai’s iconic skyline, with the raw essence of urban aesthetics merging seamlessly with the embrace of nature. Aeon epitomizes a bold statement, gracefully intertwining with the waterfront’s soothing ambience and the vibrant beat of Dubai’s heart.

Franck Muller Aeternitas Tower at Dubai Marina is a landmark residential development that redefines the skyline through its bold architectural identity and record-breaking presence. Developed by London Gate in collaboration with Franck Muller, the tower stands as the world’s tallest branded residential clock tower. Its striking angular design and signature clock façade with varying numeral sizes create a distinctive visual statement, positioning it as an iconic addition to Dubai’s architectural landscape.

Address Residences Al Marjan Island is a resort-style development by Address Hotels + Resorts in the heart of Al Marjan Island's luxurious lifestyle, located directly by the Arabian Sea and offering guests direct access to stunning beachfront and proximity to the urban hub of the island.

You and Co IMPZ is a revolutionary coliving concept that redefines the boundaries of residential living in Dubai, offering a unique blend of private apartment units and communal facilities that foster a sense of community and creativity. The project features an array of spacious rooms, including Twin Rooms with two Single beds and private bathroom, Double Rooms with a Queen size bed, and Single Rooms with a small double bed and private terrace, all meticulously designed to provide the ultimate comfort and flexibility for residents.

The Central Downtown by AQUA Properties is a distinctive mixed-use development of four residential towers of varying heights joined by a shared podium. Each tower rises above a ground floor and two parking levels, with streamlined contemporary facades in light, high-quality materials that sit comfortably within the landscape. The collection offers elegant studios and spacious one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, set above a shopping mall that brings retail, dining and daily services within easy reach of every home.

Parkwood Residences is a beautifully designed community-style development created for warm, family-focused living. The project offers a wonderful variety of homes to suit every lifestyle, ranging from smart studios and one-bedroom apartments to spacious two- and three-bedroom residences, as well as impressive three-bedroom duplexes. With its low-rise, boutique feel and thoughtful design, Parkwood Residences delivers a truly welcoming and modern place to call home.

Rosso Bay Residences by Aldar is a branded beachfront community within a five-star resort destination, designed for relaxed coastal living. Three residential buildings, each made up of two connected structures, rise from a ground floor to between twenty-one and twenty-three residential floors. Interiors are styled in warm beige, light grey and wood tones with vibrant red accents. The collection offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom penthouses, available furnished and unfurnished.

Nikki Beach Residences by Aldar is the first branded residential project in the emirate, created in partnership with the globally celebrated Nikki Beach lifestyle brand. The community comprises three residential towers rising from a ground floor to between eighteen and twenty residential floors, with design and interiors in beige, wood, grey and metallic tones. The collection offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, five-bedroom sky terraces and five-bedroom sky villas, available furnished and unfurnished.

Haven Living is a refined residential development designed to create a true sense of comfort, balance, and belonging within a vibrant urban setting. The architecture reflects modern elegance with clean lines, sleek proportions, and a strong emphasis on natural light. Floor-to-ceiling windows define the façade, allowing sunlight to flow through every space while offering open views of the surroundings. Thoughtfully planned apartments feature spacious layouts and a seamless indoor-outdoor connection, creating homes that feel bright, airy, and effortlessly sophisticated.

A harmonious blend of well-being and opportunity; where verdant surroundings meet urban living, and a strong sense of community complements the allure of personal space. Discover inspiring new collection of thoughtfully designed 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments, elegant 3-bedroom duplexes, and charming 3-bedroom townhouses, all thoughtfully placed amidst breathtaking landscaping.

Immerse yourself in a world of tranquillity and sophistication within the vibrant community of an exclusive development. Experience the perfect balance of modern elegance and natural beauty as you find your dream home in an oasis of comfort and luxury. Embark on a journey of architectural marvel with three meticulously crafted midrise buildings designed in architectural splendour, captivating the senses with their timeless beauty

Come home to Greenside Residence and bask in the tranquillity of the Dubai Hills Estate’s greenery and open spaces. Add a touch of suburban bliss to your experience of modern urban luxury by taking in the scenic views of the Dubai Hills Golf Course and the surrounding low-rise communities. The sense of arrival at Greenside Residence is unlike any other neighbourhood development. This expansive golf course side haven welcomes all guests to indulge in its facilities, comprising a luxurious lobby with classic contemporary interiors, a stylish residents lounge, and a state-of-the-art elevated podium.

Sky Suites is a contemporary residential development designed to bring urban luxury and everyday comfort into one refined living experience. Conceived as a stylish city address, the project combines elegant architecture, a welcoming lobby atmosphere, and a strong sense of lifestyle-driven design. With its sophisticated presence and carefully curated spaces, Sky Suites creates an environment where modern city living feels elevated, vibrant, and effortlessly comfortable.

Introducing Harbour Gate Apartments, an exquisite twin-stepped tower development crafted by Emaar Properties. Nestled in the scenic Dubai Creek Harbour, this luxurious residential complex offers a range of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. With their elegant design, these units provide unobstructed views of the lush parkland and shimmering waters of the Creek, creating a captivating sight.

The Community JVT is a modern residential development introducing an innovative co-living concept designed for millennials, young professionals, and entrepreneurs seeking a more connected and flexible lifestyle. Built around the idea of ​​shared experiences and social interaction, the project creates an environment where residents can enjoy both privacy and a strong sense of belonging within a vibrant, like-minded community.

Ethereal waves adorn stylishly crafted façades reflecting the Arabian Gulf ’s rippling waters. A luxury vocabulary inspired by the splendour and glamour of Dubai, translated in the smallest details, inside and out. Exquisite facilities inspired by Address Hotels + Resorts mastery of fine living, tailored to your needs. Bayview by Address Resorts at Emaar Beachfront carries the future in its details and promises a life that will fulfil your dreams of luxurious living by the sea in your luxurious,  
fully- furnished Address Hotels + Resortsbranded home.

Millennium Talia Residences is a branded residential development operated by Millennium Hotels & Resorts, offering a collection of fully furnished hotel apartments designed for contemporary living. The project combines residential comfort with hospitality-oriented services, creating a living environment focused on convenience, functionality, and modern design. The apartments feature thoughtfully planned layouts, spacious living areas, large framed windows, and integrated smart home technologies. Interiors are designed to provide a balance of comfort and practicality while reflecting a contemporary aesthetic.

Creek Waters 2 rises as a sleek residential tower on Creek Island, presenting a varied collection that spans refined apartments, generous townhouses and a sophisticated penthouse, all anchored by a striking amenities podium. The design emphasizes contemporary urban living, with each unit crafted to meet the expectations of discerning occupants while offering sweeping views of the surrounding skyline. Notable features include expansive rooftop terraces for the townhouses and a high‑end duplex on the uppermost levels that incorporates a dedicated study space.

Marina Shores is a premium waterfront development located in Dubai Marina, offering refined living within one of the city’s most prestigious coastal communities. Rising 52 floors, the tower features elegant residences with unobstructed views of the sea and marina, as well as direct access to the vibrant Promenade, creating a seamless connection between tranquil living and urban energy.

Seapoint by Emaar is an extraordinary collection of landmark towers, showcasing state-of-the-art design and unparalleled luxury. This remarkable development includes a selection of exquisite apartments and penthouses that redefine modern living.

BLVD Heights epitomises what it means to live, work and thrive within the bustling centre of Dubai. Modelled on skyscrapers typical of New York and Chicago, this 45 and 50-storey, state-of-the-art, twin tower complex is strategically located within the epicentre of Downtown Dubai.

BLVD Crescent’s sleek modern appearance slowly emerges into view as you approach around the bend from either entrance onto Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Boulevard. Designed by Dubai based practice BSB, the shimmering twin-tower of 43 and 21 is luxury personified yet in a serene, family-friendly atmosphere. Burj Khalifa, Dubai Opera and the Arabian Gulf are just some of the Arabian Gulf are just some of the key landmark views that are afforded to the residents of BLVD Crescent.

Vida Residences Dubai Marina is an extraordinary residential development that embraces the essence of luxury living with breathtaking views of Dubai Marina, pristine beaches, and captivating nautical-inspired architecture. Situated in the heart of Dubai's vibrant Marina district, this exclusive address promises residents a relaxing and healthy lifestyle like no other.

Lime Garden is ideally situated in the heart of a thriving and well-balanced community, with every amenity within reach. The elegantly crafted residential tower embodies comfort, convenience, and connectivity amidst the tranquilly of nature and mere minutes from the hubbub of the city’s landmarks.

Urbana III is a new phase of residential development in the opulent community of Emaar South. Composed of stylish townhomes located within a sparkling and magnificent oasis, one can truly live and experience the beauty of nature all around. With the perfect balance of innovation and suburban feel, the location and residential offerings of Urbana III are sure to suit every lifestyle.

Mar Casa is a majestic residential landmark, embodying the fluidity of ocean waves in its exceptional design. This stunning development features a collection of meticulously crafted apartments, each designed to enhance panoramic ocean views with airy and well-balanced living spaces that delight the senses. Mar Casa is not just a residence, but a testament to emotional luxury living in the birthplace of Dubai.

Apartments at Cedar range in size from one to three bedrooms and are located in a stylish residential community comprised of three buildings that rise around a bustling central plaza. Each apartment has a private balcony or terrace that lets in plenty of natural light and contributes to the relaxing atmosphere reflected by the views of the lush park outside.

The Community Motor City by AQUA Properties is a contemporary residential development designed around the concept of co-living, combining modern architecture with functional, community-oriented spaces. The project features thoughtfully planned residences with efficient layouts that maximize usability and comfort, catering to a new generation of urban living. With its clean architectural lines and practical design approach, the development offers a range of units created to support both individual privacy and shared living experiences in a dynamic environment.

Discover urban living, deeply rooted in modernity yet effortlessly connected to nature in the green heart of Dubai. Park Horizon is the ideal setting for a contemporary lifestyle, surrounded by world-class amenities, verdant landscapes and a host of leisure, retail and entertainment experiences, all complemented by captivating views of Dubai’s iconic skyline on the horizon. Park Horizon offers residents world-class amenities and state-of-the-art facilities at every turn, all conveniently located at the centre of a meticulously master-planned community.

Ocean House by Ellington Properties is a refined residential development set on the iconic Palm Jumeirah, where architecture takes inspiration from the fluidity of the ocean. Comprising a basement, ground level, and nine residential floors, the building is defined by its soft curves and organic lines that echo the movement of water. The project offers an exclusive collection of just 88 residences, including elegantly designed 2 to 4-bedroom apartments and duplexes, each thoughtfully planned to maximize space, light, and functionality while maintaining a sense of understated luxury.

HQ by Rove is a new-generation commercial destination in Dubai, introducing the city’s first hospitality-branded office building by Rove Hotels. Located in the vibrant Marasi Bay area, the project is designed around the idea that the modern workplace should be more flexible, inspiring, and connected to the way businesses operate today. With 23 office floors, panoramic city views, direct access to the Dubai Canal, and excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Business Bay, Dubai Design District, and Sheikh Zayed Road, HQ by Rove creates a premium business address in one of Dubai’s most dynamic locations.

Rove Home Marina, presented by Irth Development, embodies a contemporary residential concept that thrives on clean lines, expansive glazing, and a design that captures abundant light and panoramic city views. The architecture emphasizes a lifestyle‑driven silhouette that maximizes connection to the surrounding urban fabric while delivering a sense of spaciousness. Units range from sleek studios to expansive family apartments, each positioned to showcase the waterfront character.

Rove Home Marasi Drive, developed by Rove, showcases a bold contemporary identity highlighted by a sleek glass façade accented with refined metal trim, embodying the brand’s urban spirit. A distinctive external stairway bridges the podium directly to the surrounding park and waterfront promenade, forging an uninterrupted flow between private residence and cityscape. The offering includes fully furnished studios as well as one‑ and two‑bedroom apartments thoughtfully arranged to maximise light, efficiency and functional living.

HOLM One is envisioned as a serene architectural landmark within Jumeirah Garden City, shaped by symmetry, light, and an understated sense of elegance. The development rises with quiet confidence, reflecting a balance between proportion and calm, where every contour is crafted with intention. Its façade features rhythmic lines, expansive glazing, and warm tones that soften the structure, creating an atmosphere where architecture lives in harmony with its surroundings.

Holm Central stands as a paragon of residential development, where the art of hospitality is intricately woven into the fabric of everyday life, giving rise to a truly extraordinary home environment. This remarkable twin-tower development boasts an array of generously proportioned apartment layouts, encompassing studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom residences with maid's rooms, all meticulously designed to provide residents with a well-connected living space and exceptional long-term value.

Linea by Holm is a masterfully crafted residential project that embodies the essence of refined simplicity and modern city living, where every detail is thoughtfully designed to prioritize comfort, privacy, and long-term value. Developed by a visionary team, Linea by Holm offers an exquisite collection of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, each boasting efficient layouts that exude a sense of calm and balance. The project's architectural design is a testament to the power of understated elegance, creating a timeless living experience that will endure for years to come.

Whitestone Residences by Axiom Prime Real Estate is a boutique residential tower that combines elegant architecture with contemporary design. A facade with golden louvres on the balconies creates a warm, distinctive character, while terraces offer panoramic views of the city and a sunken garden brings greenery into the urban setting. The building rises above a ground floor and two parking levels to eight residential floors and a roof, offering studios, junior and executive one-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom homes.

projects.n: Manchester City Yas Residences by Ohana
projects.ov: Manchester City Residences by Ohana Development is a landmark football-branded waterfront community on Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, created in partnership with one of the most influential football clubs in the world - Manchester City. This is not a decorative branding exercise. The club’s philosophy, culture and lifestyle are embedded into the DNA of the project, shaping the environment, amenities, and everyday experience of residents.

Jacob and Co Beachfront Living embodies a lifestyle where sophistication and serenity exist in perfect harmony. Nestled between the sea and the natural reserve, the residences offer an atmosphere of calm and well-being, where every day unfolds in rhythm with nature. Expansive sea views and direct beach access define a new level of coastal living — an invitation to slow down and savor the effortless elegance of life by the water.

Treppan Vision by Fakhruddin Properties is a breathtaking mixed-use tower that redefines the boundaries of contemporary urban living, setting a new benchmark for sophistication and innovation. This extraordinary development seamlessly integrates smart studios and spacious one and two-bedroom residences with premium office spaces and high-footfall retail units, all anchored on the developer's pioneering Treppan platform.

projects.n: Manchester City Yas Residences by Ohana Phase 2
projects.ov: Manchester City Yas Residences by Ohana Phase 2 is a branded waterfront community on the banks of Yas Canal, inspired by the culture of elite sport, the discipline behind excellence and a lifestyle shaped around balance and longevity. The masterplan brings together townhouses, duplexes and villas set among landscaped streets, canal-side promenades and generous green spaces. Contemporary architecture with clean lines, wide glazing and private gardens gives every home a calm, sheltered character within an active neighbourhood.

Concept 7 is a contemporary residential development located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, designed as a modern lifestyle concept where comfort, flexibility, and everyday living come together. The architecture reflects a clean, functional approach with well-planned spaces and a focus on practicality, offering a selection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. Thoughtful layouts, private balconies, and light-filled interiors create a sense of openness, while the overall design emphasizes a relaxed, urban atmosphere suited for dynamic city living.

The Edge is a bold residential statement by Select Group, a multidisciplinary developer with over two decades of industry-leading experience. This striking dual-tower development introduces an eclectic urban vibe defined by modern architecture and signature interior design with bold, contrasting colour palettes. Featuring one and two-bedroom residences with views of the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Canal, and Business Bay, The Edge offers a truly cosmopolitan living experience at the heart of the city.

DG1 Living is a contemporary residential development designed by the award-winning US architecture firm Gensler. The project is conceived as a modern architectural statement with a strong focus on clean lines, wide frontage, and maximised openness throughout the residences. The overall design approach emphasises spacious layouts, natural light, and a refined aesthetic, positioning the development as a premium collection of exclusive homes with a contemporary urban character.

projects.n: The Heart of Europe - Côte d’Azur Monaco
projects.ov: Côte d'Azur Monaco is a hotel like no other, reflecting the French Riviera's passionate spirit and easy glamour. This magnetic destination offers an unmatched vibe and a feeling like never before. From majestic balconies and rainy streets to panoramic sea views, the hotel oozes a raw energy that pulls you in from the moment you step on the shore. Expect racing hearts and unforgettable memories at a location that will take your breath away.

Samana Waves Phase II is a complex of ultra-high-end residential apartments by the award-winning Samana Developers. Designed for those who prefer leisure, lavishness, and a bit of extravagance in life, this luxurious development offers state-of-the-art apartments with spacious interiors and breathtaking views. Featuring select private pools inside apartments, a leisure deck with a gigantic pool, iconic cascading water features, indoor and outdoor gyms, sauna and steam room, and a dedicated kids' play area, Samana Waves Phase II offers all amenities one could wish for a truly luxurious lifestyle.

Muraba Residences is an exclusive boutique residential development on the Eastern Crescent of Palm Jumeirah, offering just 46 apartments and four exceptional penthouses. Fully designed by the 2017 Pritzker Prize-winning Spanish architecture studio RCR Arquitectes, it is the only residential building in Dubai created entirely by Pritzker laureates. The project embodies a philosophy of timeless architecture, where natural light, open spaces, and uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline define every residence.

Marquis Galleria is a beautiful nine-storey residential building conceptualised as a gallery of amenities wrapped in an oasis of luxury, where contemporary architecture meets elegant aesthetics. The collection includes one, two and three-bedroom apartments, each one a testament to refined living with ample living and dining spaces, spacious bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, an additional half bath and long balconies. The three-bedroom home is the crowning glory, complete with its own private balcony garden and plunge pool that turns everyday life into something truly special.

LIV LUX is a prestigious 47-storey residential tower by LIV Developers offering a collection of one- to four-bedroom apartments, duplex residences, penthouses, and signature homes. The project is designed to deliver an elevated standard of luxury living, combining contemporary architecture with sophisticated interiors and expansive living spaces. Every residence has been thoughtfully planned to maximize comfort, functionality, and elegance, featuring premium materials, refined detailing, and carefully curated design elements that create an exclusive residential experience.

Sobha Seahaven by Sobha Group, a brand new residential development offering a choice of luxury design 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments located at Dubai Harbour. These amazing design three towers collection are laced with lower level of surprising lifestyle amenities, where the highest of them comes with 67-storey, rising high in the sky with awe-inspiring views of Dubai.

ORLA by OMNIYAT is an ultra-luxury beachfront development that redefines bespoke living through a seamless blend of architecture, nature, and refined design. Conceived as a private sanctuary, the project offers an exclusive collection of just 86 residences, 3 sky palaces, and 2 mansions, each crafted to deliver a highly personalized living experience. The architecture emphasizes harmony with natural elements, incorporating flowing water features and lush greenery to create a sense of balance, tranquility, and connection with the surroundings.

DaVinci is an ultra-luxury branded residential development inspired by the vision and design philosophy of Horacio Pagani. Created as an exclusive collection of just 83 residences, the project brings the craftsmanship, innovation, and attention to detail associated with Pagani automobiles into the world of luxury real estate.
