The architecture and interiors are designed to reflect the elegance, precision, and artistic character of the Pagani brand, creating a truly distinctive living experience.

Elitz by Danube Properties is a landmark twin-tower development located in Jumeirah Village Circle, designed to stand out with its distinctive glass façade and contemporary architectural identity. Positioned in a prime area with direct access to major highways such as Al Khail Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and Sheikh Zayed Road, the project offers excellent connectivity across Dubai.

The Opus by Omniyat is an iconic mixed-use development that redefines architectural excellence through the visionary design of Zaha Hadid. Recognized as one of Dubai’s most distinctive landmarks, the project features a futuristic structure composed of two glass towers connected by a dramatic void and bridge, creating a bold and fluid architectural form. It represents a seamless fusion of innovation, art, and luxury, offering a truly unique living and lifestyle experience.

Urban Oasis by Missoni is a direct transfer of Miami's vibrant energy to Dubai, designed with the iconic colors and vibes of the Missoni mood. This thirty-eight-floor waterfront masterpiece is situated at the heart of Dubai, directly on the Dubai Canal, just moments from Dubai's most premium lifestyle locations. Featuring exclusive penthouses accessed by private elevators and luxury apartments with unparalleled views of Dubai's most dynamic areas, every detail in a Missoni Home is a detail well crafted, from the grand Missoni-designed entrance to the flawless superior styles characterizing the ambience.

Palm Beach Tower 3 is a masterpiece of contemporary urban architecture, boasting a bold and refined design language that blends effortlessly with the surrounding coastal landscape. As part of the striking Palm Beach Towers development, crafted by the visionary WS Atkins & Partners, this elegant high-rise tower is defined by its sleek, modern form and sophisticated details, integrating residential spaces with vibrant retail and dining areas. The tower's architecture is a perfect blend of modernity and coastal charm, creating a unique and captivating presence that is simply breathtaking.

Jumeirah Living Business Bay is a premium branded residential development offering a selection of two, three, and four-bedroom residences, as well as five-bedroom simplex and duplex penthouses. The development also features one exclusive full-floor master penthouse located on the top floor, providing an elevated level of privacy and exclusivity. Each residence is designed to a high standard of quality, reflecting the sophisticated character of branded living.

Tranquil Wellness Tower, envisioned by the boutique developer Wellcube, redefines urban living through a fusion of cutting‑edge wellness science and holistic design. The tower embraces the ten pillars of the WELL Building Standard — air, water, nourishment, light, fitness, comfort, and mind — ensuring that every residence operates as a health‑focused sanctuary. Diverse unit configurations, each echoing one of the five natural elements, offer limitless possibilities for personalized thematic expression.

Samana Downtown One stands as a bold architectural statement that bridges the present cityscape with its future horizon. The building’s striking silhouette, articulated details and strong lines convey a confident, contemporary character that distinguishes it from every angle. Balanced proportions and a refined structural rhythm give each residence a sense of purposeful elegance.

Palm Jebel Ali Villas by Nakheel is an exclusive beachfront residential community where each frond is designed as a private neighbourhood surrounded by lush greenery and pristine beaches. The villas offer a refined coastal lifestyle, with elegant streets, carefully landscaped surroundings, and a strong focus on privacy and tranquillity. Thoughtfully planned open spaces and generous greenery create a peaceful setting where residents can enjoy the beauty of the beachfront environment.

Vincitore Wellness Estate is a truly groundbreaking development, proudly known as the world's largest designer wellness residential tower. Offering a stunning range of exclusive residential options, from magnificent studios to spacious apartments and opulent villas with private pools, the development caters perfectly to modern lifestyles. As the crown jewel of designer wellness living, this project establishes a new global benchmark for prestigious and profitable real estate investment.

Azra Residence is a contemporary residential development designed to offer a refined and comfortable urban lifestyle. The project features clean architectural lines and a modern façade that blends harmoniously with its surroundings, creating a calm and elegant presence. Thoughtfully planned to balance privacy and connectivity, Azra Residence is positioned to provide residents with convenient access to everyday destinations while maintaining a peaceful residential atmosphere.

Barari Palace stands as a modern landmark shaped by elegance, calm, and purposeful design, rising at the edge of Al Barari’s iconic greenery. Its architecture blends quiet sophistication with timeless simplicity — warm tones, soft textures, and fluid geometries come together to create a serene retreat moments from the city yet worlds away from its noise. The residential offering includes studios, 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive Sky Villas, all crafted with airy volumes, expansive windows, and layouts centered on clarity, comfort, and refined contemporary living.

368 Park Ln by Tabeer Developments redefines modern urban living with an architectural vision that blends sophistication, warmth, and a strong sense of community. Its contemporary façade, open balconies, and elegant design elements create a distinctive residential landmark where modern aesthetics meet everyday comfort. From the grand lobby to landscaped surroundings, every aspect of the development reflects attention to detail, offering residents an elevated lifestyle experience in one of Dubai's most vibrant neighborhoods.

Wellington Grand Villas is an exclusive collection of luxury residences designed to offer a refined and sophisticated lifestyle. These villas seamlessly blend contemporary architecture with timeless elegance, creating a harmonious living experience. Expansive layouts, high ceilings, and floor-to-ceiling windows allow natural light to flow effortlessly, enhancing the sense of space and tranquility within each home.

The Astera by Aston Martin is an iconic residential tower developed by DarGlobal in collaboration with the legendary British automotive brand Aston Martin. This exclusive development represents the seamless fusion of bespoke style, cutting-edge material science, and unparalleled craftsmanship. Each residence is masterfully designed to emulate the dynamic flow of a power wave, ensuring breathtaking views from every angle, while reflecting over a century of British ingenuity and the spirit of authentic island living.

Asayel Avenue is a contemporary residential development thoughtfully positioned within Dubai South, offering a calm and well-balanced urban lifestyle. The architecture reflects modern simplicity with clean lines, warm tones, and an emphasis on openness, creating a welcoming environment that feels both practical and refined. Designed to integrate seamlessly into its surroundings, the project delivers a sense of community living enhanced by accessibility and everyday convenience.

Al Vista is a contemporary mixed-use development comprising a residential tower and an office tower integrated within a unified architectural concept. The residential component offers a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed around modern urban living principles, with bright interiors, functional layouts, generous balconies, and an emphasis on natural light. Clean architectural lines, carefully planned living spaces, and a balanced approach to design create residences that prioritize comfort, practicality, and everyday convenience.

Villa Del Garda by Mr. Eight Development stands as a first-row serviced boutique residence offering a breathtaking panorama of the Marina and the Arabian Gulf, creating a serene coastal experience from every angle. The project presents a refined collection of 1, 2, 3, and 5 bedroom apartments, along with spacious 2 and 4 bedroom duplexes that elevate modern beachfront living. With direct sea views and the prestige of branded residences, it delivers an atmosphere of effortless luxury from the moment you arrive.

360 Riverside Crescent is a masterpiece of luxury, set amidst a breathtaking development spanning eight million square feet, where serene waterfronts, tranquil lagoons, and lush landscaping converge to create a world of natural splendor. This prestigious tower boasts an exquisite range of one, one-point-five, and two-bedroom apartments, each meticulously crafted to foster a sense of serene well-being, where every detail has been carefully considered to provide a haven of everlasting luxury.

Sobha Central Mall by Sobha Realty rises as an iconic commercial destination, a sleek vertical silhouette capped by a reflective glass façade that commands immediate attention and conveys prestige throughout the Sobha Central community. This exceptional development comprises a ground floor and a first podium level, delivering a thoughtfully curated mix of retail outlets and office spaces designed to meet the most contemporary commercial demands. Every aspect of its architectural composition reflects modern sophistication, creating a distinguished address where businesses can flourish and visitors can enjoy a truly refined environment.

Sobha Estates is an exclusive gated community of villas located within the prestigious Sobha Hartland II, an eight-million-square-foot master development envisioned as an urban community in the heart of a forest sanctuary. Featuring exclusively designed mansions and five and six-bedroom villas, this premium sanctuary is built around weaving natural spaces into everyday living. With over one million square feet of dedicated green area consisting of masterfully landscaped open spaces, tree-lined walkways, and linear parks, Sobha Estates is a residential community that merges nature with your home.

Diva at the Bay is a beautifully imagined mid-rise residential address that blends serene, private contemporary living with the vibrant energy of urban life. Set across two connected buildings, Diva A and Diva B, each with its own lobby, lifts and lifestyle facilities, the development offers a wonderful sense of exclusivity and community all at once. Residents can choose from a delightful selection of studios, 1 bedroom junior, 2 bedroom, 2 bedroom duplex and 3 bedroom apartments, most of which enjoy breathtaking views over the crystal-clear Arabian sea.

The Woods at Sobha Sanctuary is an exclusive residential enclave set within one of the most coveted plots of the larger Sobha Sanctuary masterplan. Featuring one and two-bedroom residences, this private woodland community is framed by expansive parks at both front and rear, with uninterrupted green vistas and seamless connections to nature. Every window meets the woods, creating homes shaped by water views, natural light, and a deeper connection to the outdoors.

Sobha Solis is a vibrant community that embodies the perfect blend of dynamic energy and serene tranquility, where every moment is an opportunity to ignite your passions and fuel your spirit. This exquisite development spans across four unique towers, each offering a distinct personality while sharing a common podium that is exclusively reserved for residents. The residences at Sobha Solis boast spacious layouts, complemented by expansive windows and balconies that invite an abundance of natural light and breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape.

Let the journey begins at Sobha One, a new development by Sobha Group that features 1 to 4-bedroom waterfront apartments located at Sobha Hartland, Dubai. Discover a life that is both rich enough to appeal to the brilliance of modernity and close enough to nature to be considered interesting and elegant.

330 Riverside Crescent is a resplendent waterfront landmark, its tapered crescent design mesmerizing as it catches the reflected hues of the surrounding cluster and dazzles in the reflections of crystal-clear water. This paramount address boasts fifty-seven stories of exceptional craftsmanship, offering a grand new level of luxury that redefines the standards of sophistication. The tower features specially designed one and two-bedroom residences that exhibit all-encompassing views, poised to unveil a soul-stirring experience as residents surrender to the enchanting call of the water.

Sobha Elwood emerges as an extraordinary residential masterpiece that celebrates nature as the greatest inspiration and solace, creating a vibrant tapestry of life on the canvas of nature within a breathtaking community spanning expansive open spaces and lush parks. This visionary development redefines luxury living by seamlessly blending modern design with the four fundamental elements of nature—greens, water, air, and land—to create a sanctuary where every breath is filled with the purest air and every step leads deeper into nature's embrace.

projects.n: Sobha Siniya Island Villas Phases 1 and 2
projects.ov: Sobha Siniya Island Villas Phases 1 and 2 is a masterpiece of luxury and natural harmony, showcasing exquisite villas nestled amidst breathtaking landscapes. The island's unique blend of serenity and vibrancy creates a captivating atmosphere, where the tranquility of untouched natural beauty converges with the dynamic pulse of UAE's cosmopolitan life. This enchanting project features an eighteen-hole golf course, a thriving maritime haven, and a lively boardwalk lined with inviting cafes and restaurants, further enhancing the island's charismatic ambiance.

Yachtside Marina Residences is a masterpiece of luxury waterfront living, nestled on the exquisite Sobha Siniya Island, where pristine white beaches, lush mangroves, and breathtaking panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf converge to create a truly unique and captivating atmosphere. The project's architecture is a symphony of clean, contemporary lines and organic textures, resulting in a seamless blend of modern sophistication and coastal serenity that redefines the essence of island living.

Pristine Beach Residences represents the essence of contemporary waterfront luxury, where architecture and design come together in perfect harmony. Every detail is crafted to enhance an exclusive lifestyle and provide residents with a sense of ultimate comfort.

Pearlside Marina Residences is a masterpiece of contemporary architecture, where the serene atmosphere of life by the water converges with the finest elements of luxury living, creating a truly unique dimension of sophistication and elegance. Each residence is meticulously designed to be filled with an abundance of natural light, tranquility, and the soothing ambiance of a waterfront lifestyle, perfect for those who crave a peaceful and refined living experience.

Florine Beach Residences, situated on the pristine Sobha Siniya Island, is a masterpiece of coastal luxury and refined living. The development offers an impressive variety of residences, including 1- and 2-bedroom apartments and 2- and 3-bedroom duplexes, designed to cater to diverse lifestyles. Every unit promises breathtaking views of the sparkling beach or the lush, expansive golf course, blending natural beauty with architectural elegance. These thoughtfully designed homes are the epitome of seaside serenity, perfect for those seeking an unmatched blend of relaxation and sophistication.

Canalside Marina Residences by Sobha Realty offers an extraordinary coastal lifestyle on the pristine Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. Set along a tranquil canal that flows directly to the Arabian Sea, the development blends modern living with a strong connection to nature. Residents enjoy direct access to a vibrant promenade, lush green parks, and sweeping marina views. This is not just island living — it’s a serene escape shaped by elegance, light, and flow.

Bayfront Marina Residences is a luxury waterfront development located on Sobha Siniya Island, offering a rare fusion of elegance and natural beauty. Surrounded by pristine white beaches, lush mangroves, and panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, the project is designed to capture the essence of island living. The architecture reflects clean, contemporary lines softened by organic textures, seamlessly blending modern sophistication with coastal serenity.

The Grove at Sobha Sanctuary is a low-rise villa neighborhood set within the master-planned Sobha Sanctuary community, designed around nature, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. The project features spacious 4–6 bedroom estate villas arranged within a blue-green landscape network, where water, greenery, and walkable environments shape everyday living. The architecture emphasizes refined proportions, privacy, and seamless integration with landscaped surroundings, creating a calm residential enclave that balances scale, exclusivity, and connection to the wider Sobha Sanctuary master plan.

The Brooks at Sobha Sanctuary is a refined residential enclave where nature, wellness, and community come together in perfect balance. Set within the heart of Sobha Sanctuary, the project is designed around the idea of everyday ease — a place where calm landscapes, flowing water elements, and human connection shape a quieter, more intentional way of living. Thoughtfully planned green corridors, shaded walkways, and serene water features create an atmosphere of retreat while remaining part of a vibrant master-planned environment.

The Horizon at Sobha Central stands as a paragon of modern urban living, its sleek design and panoramic skyline views encapsulating elegance and ambition in perfect harmony. This architectural marvel rises gracefully, offering more than just a place to live – it invites residents into a dynamic lifestyle where the city's energy becomes an integral part of everyday life. With layouts that maximize natural light and space, the residences within The Horizon are a masterclass in refined design, complemented by tasteful finishes that blend form and function, creating an atmosphere of understated luxury.

The Tranquil at Sobha Central is a masterpiece of modern urban living, rising majestically along Dubai's iconic Sheikh Zayed Road, where sleek design and panoramic skyline views converge to create an atmosphere of elegance and ambition. This architectural marvel features residences that are a masterclass in refined design, with layouts that maximize natural light and space, complemented by tasteful finishes that blend form and function.

The Eden at Sobha Central is a masterpiece of modern urban living, distinguished by its sleek design and panoramic skyline views that embody elegance and sophistication. This architectural marvel is strategically positioned at the crossroads of business, leisure, and culture, offering residents a dynamic lifestyle that seamlessly integrates the city's energy into everyday life.

projects.n: Bristol Hotel & Residences at Ramhan Island
projects.ov: The Bristol Hotel & Residences by Eagle Hills marks the remarkable reimagining of a legendary name for a new era, bringing together timeless elegance, contemporary living, and the beauty of island life in one exceptional address. This extraordinary development offers just one hundred and twenty-five residences, creating an intimate waterfront sanctuary where privacy meets the privileges of hotel living, with direct marina access, curated amenities, and attentive service blending the comfort of home with the ease of a fully serviced island retreat.

Knightsbridge is an exclusive residential community offering a collection of four-bedroom townhouses and five- and six-bedroom villas designed to combine contemporary architecture with refined luxury living. The residences feature expansive layouts, elegant architectural detailing, and spacious living areas created to accommodate both family life and entertaining. The project places a strong emphasis on quality, comfort, and sustainability, integrating modern design principles with advanced residential technologies to create sophisticated homes that are both functional and future-oriented.

Hadley Heights 2, a masterpiece by Leos Developments, presents a stunning collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, meticulously designed to blend modern architecture with the comforts of everyday living. The spacious layouts, large windows, and thoughtfully designed interiors work in harmony to maximize natural light, creating an inviting residential atmosphere that exudes warmth and sophistication.

Weybridge Gardens 4 is a contemporary residential development by LEOS Developments offering a diverse collection of studios, one-, two-, three-, and four-bedroom apartments. The project is designed to combine modern architecture with practical and elegant living spaces, creating residences that cater to a wide range of lifestyles. Thoughtfully planned layouts, contemporary design elements, and a focus on comfort and functionality define the development, while its architectural character reflects LEOS' commitment to quality, innovation, and modern residential living.

Weybridge Gardens 5 is a contemporary residential development that combines modern architectural expression with a calm, residential atmosphere. The building is defined by its soft curves, clean lines, and natural tones, creating a balanced and elegant façade that integrates seamlessly with its surroundings. A selection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments is designed with open layouts and large windows, allowing natural light to enhance the sense of space while offering comfortable and functional living environments.

Fashionz is a branded luxury residential development by Danube Properties, located in Jumeirah Village Triangle and positioned among the tallest towers in the community. Inspired by the world of haute couture and developed in collaboration with FashionTV, the project celebrates individuality, style, and contemporary luxury. The architecture and interiors reflect a fashion-forward design philosophy, creating a distinctive residential environment where elegance, comfort, and modern living come together in a unique branded lifestyle concept.

Amber by ENSO is a contemporary residential development that brings together modern architecture and functional design in a refined urban setting. The building is defined by clean lines, balanced proportions, and the use of high-quality materials, creating a sophisticated yet approachable aesthetic. Thoughtfully designed residences offer efficient layouts, generous natural light, and a seamless flow between living spaces, delivering a comfortable and elegant environment suited to both end-users and investors.

Hygge Hotel is a unique hospitality concept located within The Heart of Europe, a $6 billion development just six kilometers off the coast of Dubai. Spread across six man-made islands, this visionary project offers guests an immersive experience where nature, design, and culture come together. Surrounded by vibrant coral reefs and inspired by European traditions, the hotel is part of a world-class destination focused on luxury and well-being.

Oystra is a paradigm of architectural innovation, redefining the standards of luxury seafront residences with its breathtaking design. The project's curved facades, flowing balconies, and seamless transitions evoke the natural flow of water, creating a living sculpture that blends effortlessly with the surrounding landscape. Inspired by the oyster's mysterious allure and the pearl's timeless mystique, Oystra achieves architectural equilibrium, compromising neither stunning form nor practicality of function.

Artist Hotel on Rainy Street is a distinctive hospitality concept that merges artful design with immersive island living. This boutique hotel invites guests into a world where every corner is inspired by creativity and every stay is a unique experience. The architecture and interiors reflect bold, expressive aesthetics, set against the atmospheric charm of rain and snow-themed surroundings, creating an escape unlike any other in Dubai.

Hotel London is a luxurious destination that masterfully blends the timeless charm of London. Set on a stunning island, this unique retreat reimagines English heritage with Victorian architecture, royal hospitality, and iconic traditions such as high tea and cozy pubs. Guests are welcomed with an immersive journey, from VIP yacht arrivals to personalized service that creates a lasting impression, inviting visitors to experience the elegance of England in Dubai's vibrant landscape.

projects.n: The Heart of Europe - Marbella Resort Hotel, Vignette Collection
projects.ov: Marbella Resort Hotel, part of the prestigious Vignette Collection, captures the vibrant energy and timeless charm of Spain's most glamorous coastal city. This intimate boutique hotel on the water's edge celebrates life with the passion and charisma of Spanish culture, where time is unhurried and every moment invites you to breathe in fresh sea air, enjoy the beach, and cherish the company of others. Here, you are so close to Dubai yet so far away, too.

W The Residences by Arada is an exclusive waterfront collection of branded homes set across a striking three-tower formation, created with the lifestyle brand W. The towers share a nine-level podium with parking, amenities and a grand lobby, each rising to forty-one residential floors and a roof level, with architecture that merges contemporary elegance with the calm of the sea. The collection offers one- to five-bedroom apartments, duplexes and expansive penthouses, the most exclusive of them crowned with private pools and wraparound terraces with sweeping views.

Masaar 3 Dalia by Arada is the seventh phase of the forested Masaar community, conceived as a family neighbourhood integrated into a green oasis with walking paths and relaxation areas. Contemporary minimalist architecture with clean volumes, panoramic glazing and a restrained palette harmonises with the landscape. The collection offers townhouses with two, three and four bedrooms and standalone four-bedroom villas, each rising over ground and first floors, with the villas adding a roof level.

Masaar 3 Sedra by Arada is the fourth phase of the forested Masaar community, a nature-inspired residential enclave designed for a calm and balanced lifestyle. Contemporary facades blend organically with the surrounding green spaces, while the homes rise from a ground floor to one or two upper levels. The collection offers townhouses with two to four bedrooms and spacious standalone villas with four and five bedrooms, each with refined layouts, high ceilings, private gardens, terraces and dedicated parking spaces.

Masaar 3 Laura by Arada is the third phase of the forested Masaar community, where villa and townhouse architecture is carefully integrated into the natural landscape. Contemporary facades blend harmoniously with generous green areas, while the homes rise from a ground floor to one or two upper levels. The collection offers townhouses with two to four bedrooms and spacious Signature and Forest villas with four and five bedrooms, each with private gardens, terraces and dedicated parking spaces.

Masaar 3 Phases 1 and 2 by Arada bring together the Dana and Lareen neighbourhoods, where contemporary architecture blends seamlessly with the landscape. Modern facades sit among generous green areas, while the homes rise from a ground floor to one or two upper levels. The collection offers townhouses with two to four bedrooms and spacious Signature and Forest Signature villas with four and five bedrooms, each with private gardens, terraces and dedicated parking spaces for the whole family.

Anantara Sharjah Resort by Arada is a five-star hotel and residences destination set directly on a sandy seafront. A signature gateway inspired by the path of the sun forms the defining architectural feature of the resort, welcoming residents and guests into an oasis of leisure. The building rises above a basement parking level, a ground floor and a two-level podium to twelve residential floors, offering a collection of one- to four-bedroom apartments and penthouses with sweeping sea views.

Aljada CBD Building 10 is a contemporary office building by Arada within the second cluster of the central business district of the Aljada community. Conceived as an innovative corporate hub, it combines a modern facade with functional design that fits naturally into the surrounding urban fabric. The building rises above two shared basement parking levels and a ground floor to seven commercial floors and a roof level, offering office suites together with a selection of retail units at street level.

Aljada CBD Building 3, also known as Wing, is a contemporary office building by Arada within the first cluster of the central business district of the Aljada community. Conceived as an innovative corporate hub, it combines a modern facade with functional design that fits naturally into the surrounding urban fabric. The building rises above two basement levels, a ground floor and a podium level to eight office floors and a roof, positioned beside the landscaped green spine of the district.

Jenna 1 by Arada is the first phase of a contemporary residential cluster at the heart of the community, designed for modern families. The multi-section building combines smooth facades with thoughtful architecture that blends into the surrounding landscape and the lively urban setting, and rises above a basement level and a ground floor to the residential floors. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, positioned between a vibrant boulevard of shops and cafes and a peaceful landscaped park.

The Gate 6 by Arada is a contemporary residential building designed for a dynamic and well-balanced urban lifestyle. The building rises from a ground floor to nine residential floors, with modern architecture and a strong focus on functionality. The collection offers stylish one-bedroom apartments and spacious two-, three- and four-bedroom family homes, thoughtfully planned to suit a variety of lifestyles, with selected residences featuring winter gardens that bring extra light and space into the living areas.

The Gate 5 by Arada is a sleek contemporary residential building that celebrates light and open living. The building rises above a basement level, a ground floor and a podium to eight residential floors, with a modern facade and generous glazing that fill the interiors with daylight. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and generous two- and three-bedroom family homes, with selected residences featuring winter gardens that extend the living space towards the balcony and blur the line between indoors and out.

The Gate 3 and 4 by Arada is a pair of contemporary residential buildings at the entrance to the community, designed for an active and well-connected urban lifestyle. Each building rises above a basement level, a ground floor and a podium to the residential floors, with clean modern facades and generous glazing. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and spacious two-, three- and four-bedroom family homes, each with a distinctive layout that supports a personalised way of living.

The Gate offers a diverse selection of residences, ranging from cozy one-bedroom apartments to spacious three-bedroom family homes, allowing residents to choose a lifestyle that suits their needs. Each unit is equipped with smart home features as standard, while many layouts include a unique “winter garden” concept that extends the living space onto the balcony, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor environments.

Safa Parkview by Arada is a contemporary residential building overlooking the green spaces and sports facilities at the heart of the community. The building rises from a ground floor to nine residential floors, with a calm, modern architectural expression and light-filled interiors. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and generous two- and three-bedroom family homes, with selected residences featuring contemporary winter gardens that blur the boundary between interior and exterior living.

Safa 1 by Arada is a contemporary residential building that embraces openness and fluid transitions between indoor and outdoor living. The building rises from a ground floor to seven residential floors, with clean lines, large windows and balconies that frame views across the surrounding parks and sports facilities. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and spacious two- and three-bedroom family homes, each planned to support a personalised lifestyle without compromising on comfort or elegance.

Octa Isle Interiors by Missoni is a landmark waterfront development by OCTA Development, bringing a distinctive, fashion-inspired approach to modern coastal living. The project stands out through its bold architecture and signature Missoni design language, combining vibrant aesthetics with refined elegance. Conceived as a statement residence, it merges creative expression with premium real estate, offering a unique lifestyle concept where design and location work in perfect harmony.

Nesba 3 by Arada is a contemporary residential building designed to accommodate a broad spectrum of lifestyles, from young professionals to growing families. The building rises from a ground floor to nine residential floors, with a modern facade, generous glazing and balconies that create a seamless connection between the interiors and the outdoors. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and spacious two- and three-bedroom family homes with practical, well-proportioned layouts and plenty of natural light.

Nesba 1 Aljada by Arada is a contemporary residential building that balances privacy and connectivity with an open, light-filled design. The building rises above a basement parking level, a ground floor and a podium to nine residential floors, combining a refined high-tech style, sustainable materials, clean architectural lines and generous glazing that bring natural light deep into every home. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and spacious two- and three-bedroom family homes, each with flexible floor plan configurations that adapt easily to different households and changing lifestyles.

Nasaq District in Aljada offers a dynamic residential experience, perfectly positioned between a vibrant boulevard filled with shops and restaurants and a serene green park. This unique setting allows residents to enjoy a balanced lifestyle, combining urban convenience with natural tranquility in one of Sharjah’s most progressive and fast-growing communities.

Il Teatro Residences 1 and 2 by Arada is a pair of identical mid-rise residential buildings overlooking one of the signature landmarks of the community, a theatre designed by the renowned Japanese architect Tadao Ando, and its multi-level pedestrian plaza. Each building rises above a basement parking level and a ground floor to seven residential floors, crowned by a rooftop infinity pool and lounge. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with two- and three-bedroom lofts.

Akala Residences by Arada is a wellness-led development of two elegant towers in a prime central setting, with facades that combine natural stone and polished metal to balance nature and modern technology. The towers share four basement parking levels, a ground floor and a three-level podium of premium amenities. One tower is dedicated to private residences, while the other houses hotel suites with hospitality services available to residents. The collection offers one- to six-bedroom apartments, including penthouses with private terraces.

Viewz Residences is a premium residential development by Danube Properties, offering a collection of studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive 4-bedroom sky villas. The project is designed to deliver a sophisticated lifestyle through contemporary architecture, spacious layouts, and exceptional attention to detail. A defining feature of the development is its collaboration with Aston Martin, which has inspired the design of selected interiors, bringing together elegance, craftsmanship, and modern luxury. The residences are thoughtfully planned to maximize comfort, functionality, and a sense of exclusivity.

Richmond District is a landmark development in Al Furjan, introducing the area’s first fully integrated residential and commercial community. The project consists of five elegant residential buildings and one office tower, all seamlessly connected by a vibrant shared podium. Designed in collaboration with John Richmond, the development reflects a bold fusion of contemporary luxury and distinctive artistic expression, creating a unique environment where lifestyle, design, and convenience exist in perfect harmony.

Ashley Hills by TownX is a masterpiece of modern architecture, redefining urban comfort with its thoughtful attention to detail and refined simplicity. This exceptional lifestyle destination features two residential blocks with carefully crafted studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, all designed to optimize space, light, and comfort for modern urban dwellers. The development's emphasis on balance and ease is evident in its open spaces, serene interiors, and atmosphere of understated elegance, making it an oasis of calm in the midst of the city.

11 Hills Park is a prestigious residential development of studios and one-bedroom apartments in Dubai Science Park, overlooking lush greenery and parkland in Al Barsha South. The architectural structure includes a ground floor, podium levels, residential floors, and a rooftop, presenting a fresh, functional design that blends seamlessly into the surrounding environment. This thoughtfully designed community combines comfort, convenience, and a focus on well-being, offering a serene retreat in the bustling city.

Luma Park Views, developed by the esteemed TownX, is a residential masterpiece that redefines the essence of sophisticated living. This magnificent complex boasts a thoughtful design, comprising a ground floor, podium levels, and residential floors, which collectively house a stunning collection of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments. Each residence is a testament to meticulous attention to detail, showcasing a contemporary aesthetic that blends sophistication with timeless charm, thereby creating an unparalleled living experience.

Listone Residence is a residential building by Lion Stone Properties in International City, designed around the idea of affordable luxury and smart living. The project offers studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments with practical layouts, with selected one-bedroom units and all two-bedroom units including an additional flexible room that can be adapted to different needs.

Laya Courtyard is a haven of modern living nestled in Dubai Studio City. Discover thoughtfully designed studio and 1-bedroom apartments that blend comfort with contemporary aesthetics. Embrace a lifestyle of convenience and charm in this vibrant community.

Inaura Hotels & Residences Downtown by Arada is a branded residential tower that combines hotel luxury with private living, shaped around design, wellness and energy. The lower facade uses reflective materials that gradually shift to transparent textures as the tower rises. The building stands above four basement levels, a ground floor and a four-level podium, with hotel and residential floors topped by a roof. The collection offers one- to four-bedroom apartments and exclusive five- and six-bedroom Sky Villa penthouses.

The Willows Residences is a limited-edition boutique development by SCC Vertex, conceived as a low-rise residential retreat within a low-density community. The building offers one- and two-bedroom apartments in two series, The Sculpted for compact, efficient living and The Cultivated with larger layouts and closed-kitchen options in select two-bedroom homes, along with retail units at ground level. Many apartments enjoy views towards the Burj Khalifa skyline or the greenery of Al Barari, combining calm surroundings with a strong connection to the city.

Symphony by Chaimaa is a masterpiece of contemporary residential design, where modern elegance and harmonious lifestyle experiences blend seamlessly together. This exquisite development features impeccably crafted one- and two-bedroom residences, each nestled within an architecturally refined building defined by fluid lines, expansive windows, and a sophisticated geometric façade that enhances both privacy and an abundance of natural light. Inspired by the concept of balance, Symphony by Chaimaa crafts an atmospheric haven where design, comfort, and well-being fuse together in perfect harmony, resulting in a truly unique lifestyle experience.

South Lofts is an elevated co-living residence by PCI, designed for founders, creatives and professionals who want living, working and unwinding to meet naturally under one roof. The building offers studio and one-bedroom apartments, with private homes complemented by an extensive network of shared spaces on the podium and the roof. The concept is built around a sense of flow, moving residents easily between focus, connection and rest throughout the day, while keeping each personal space calm and private.

Ocean Tower by Ahmed Al Ansari Real Estate Development is a contemporary residential tower that combines a refined waterfront lifestyle with a resort-style amenity offering. The building rises above a ground floor and a two-level parking podium to a rooftop, standing taller than many neighbouring buildings and occupying an unusually large plot. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected residences opening towards ocean views and a sky lounge providing elevated vistas across the surrounding waterfront.

Isla Private Residences is a boutique waterfront development on Dubai Islands by Chaimaa Holding, conceived around the philosophy of Dolce Far Niente — the art of refined, intentional living. The project comprises an exclusive collection of 76 one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences, defined by sculptural architecture, flowing terraces, and expansive glazing that frames open sea and skyline views. The building’s elegant curves, landscaped podium, and expressive rooftop silhouette create a distinctive presence within the coastal destination of Dubai Islands.

Ice Beach by Major Developments at Marjan Beach is a stunning waterfront development that perfectly blends modern architecture with a resort-inspired lifestyle. The project offers a diverse selection of residences, including one-bedroom apartments in Mini, Standard, and Luxury layouts, two-bedroom homes available in Standard and spacious Duplex configurations, elegant three-bedroom apartments, and exclusive Sky Villas for those seeking ultimate privacy and prestige. Each home is carefully designed to provide breathtaking views, abundant natural light, and a refined yet comfortable living experience.

Gateway by Premier Choice is a contemporary residential building that combines a ground floor, parking podium and residential levels topped by a rooftop sports and leisure deck. The project offers studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments designed to maximise natural light and open space. Open balconies extend each home outdoors and frame wide views of the surrounding city, creating a private outdoor space for relaxation or entertaining. A welcoming lobby with an adjoining coffee shop sets the tone on arrival.

Terva Homes by Al Mizan Group is an exclusive gated community of townhouses and villas designed around timeless elegance, comfort and architectural harmony. Balanced proportions, contemporary forms, clean lines, neutral tones and a refined palette of natural materials create residences of quiet sophistication. Each home rises from a ground floor to a first floor, and the limited collection includes three-bedroom townhouses and four-bedroom villas, each with a maid's room, designed for modern family life.

Ayami Residence by AYAT Development is a residential building inspired by the idea of everyday comfort, its name drawn from the Arabic word for my days. A contemporary, restrained aesthetic with clean lines, panoramic glazing and elegant balconies gives the building a light and balanced appearance. It rises above a ground floor and a podium to six residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments with practical layouts and welcoming interiors.

Serro 2 is a contemporary villa community designed to promote living in natural rhythm, where architecture and landscape work together to support balance and wellbeing. The project features modern, sunlit villas with clean lines and warm Mediterranean influences, expressed through white finishes and terracotta accents. The master plan is centered around walkability, greenery, and open spaces, creating a calm residential environment anchored by a central Wellness Centre and Clubhouse. The community offers 3–5 bedroom villas designed with a focus on light, flow, and functional living.

Salva is a thoughtfully planned residential villa community designed around the principles of wellness, balance, and refined living. Set within a serene master-planned environment, the project emphasizes a strong connection to nature, with landscaped surroundings, wellness-focused spaces, and an architectural language that prioritizes light, openness, and calm. Salva is positioned as a peaceful retreat that supports a healthy lifestyle while remaining well connected to key destinations across Dubai.

Serro is a boutique residential villa community designed around the concept of holistic luxury living. The project features Mediterranean-inspired architecture that blends elegant forms with a calm, nature-oriented aesthetic. The master plan emphasizes balance between built spaces and the environment, creating a serene atmosphere through thoughtful layouts, natural elements, and refined architectural details. The community consists of spacious 3–5 bedroom villas, each designed to offer privacy, comfort, and a strong connection to outdoor spaces.

Greencrest by Emaar is a beautifully designed residential project that perfectly reflects modern living with a strong sense of comfort and elegance. The development offers thoughtfully planned 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments, each created to balance functionality, space, and natural light. With Emaar’s proven track record and attention to detail, Greencrest stands out as a refined and highly desirable place to live.

Grove Ridge is a serene residential enclave nestled within the green heart of Emaar South, where contemporary architecture meets the timeless appeal of golf living. Surrounded by open landscapes, rolling fairways, and expansive skies, the project is designed to foster a sense of calm, balance, and belonging. Its architectural language reflects understated elegance, seamlessly integrating modern forms with the natural rhythm of the surrounding environment.

Vista Ridge is a refined residential enclave set within the green heart of Emaar South, where contemporary living is seamlessly integrated with championship golf course surroundings. Framed by rolling fairways and expansive open landscapes, the architecture reflects understated elegance, clean lines, and a strong connection to nature. Designed to embrace light, openness, and scenic views, Vista Ridge offers a tranquil lifestyle shaped by greenery, leisure, and the timeless appeal of golf living.

241 Waterside is a refined residential development located on Dubai Islands, designed as an architectural landmark shaped with precision and a strong sense of permanence. The project combines elegant proportions, layered terraces, and expansive glazing, creating a calm waterfront living experience framed by skyline, hotel, and community views. With its boutique scale and crafted exterior, it offers a sophisticated and private atmosphere for residents seeking an elevated coastal lifestyle.

Celesto 3 is presented as a contemporary residential tower, distinguished by its sleek vertical architecture, illuminated façade lines, and vibrant outdoor podium spaces. The project rises prominently within a rapidly evolving district positioned for major growth, supported by upcoming metro stations, enhanced mobility networks, and ongoing infrastructure upgrades. Designed to appeal to both residents and investors, Celesto 3 offers a collection of modern units complemented by efficient layouts and high rental appeal, making it a compelling entry point into a transforming community.

Sky Line by Peace Homes rises as an architectural statement of modern luxury, distinguished by clean contours, cascading green terraces, and an iconic vertical silhouette. The tower's exterior harmonizes natural elements with contemporary aesthetics, creating an elevated urban oasis. Expansive balconies wrapped in lush greenery and panoramic glazing ensure every residence enjoys a seamless indoor-outdoor connection, while the layered faсade gives the building a sculptural, dynamic presence on the skyline.

Avarra by Palace by Emaar introduces a world of refined luxury, where every detail is shaped by the signature elegance of Palace Hotels & Resorts. The project offers an exceptional collection of 1, 2, 3 and 4 bedroom apartments, along with an exclusive 6 bedroom penthouse, all designed as serene personal escapes. Contemporary architecture, expansive glass façades and sweeping balconies frame the sea, the Burj Khalifa and the vibrant skyline, creating an atmosphere of pure sophistication and calm.

ELAR1S Rise is conceived as a sanctuary of balance, clarity, and understated luxury. Inspired by the Greek elements “Element” and “Aris” (air/hope), the project embodies the essence of air, light, and life. Its flowing architectural form creates an atmosphere of calm sophistication, offering residents a sense of openness and serenity that aligns with modern urban living. Every aspect of the development reinforces an elevated lifestyle centered on comfort, well-being, and natural harmony.

Creek Haven by Emaar presents a beautifully crafted waterfront sanctuary where modern elegance meets serene living, offering an inspiring selection of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments that radiate warmth and refinement. Every home is designed as a private retreat, enriched with soothing water views and soft natural light that elevates daily living. The project embodies Emaar’s signature quality, blending contemporary style with a calm, inviting atmosphere that feels both luxurious and effortless.

Creek Bay by Emaar presents a beautifully crafted waterfront sanctuary where modern elegance meets serene living, offering an inspiring selection of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments that radiate warmth and refinement. Every home is designed as a private retreat, enriched with soothing water views and soft natural light that elevates daily living. The project embodies Emaar’s signature quality, blending contemporary style with a calm, inviting atmosphere that feels both luxurious and effortless.

Avelia at The Valley presents an elegant architectural expression shaped by the vast desert landscapes, lush meadows, and gentle horizons that characterize this serene master community. The villas feature refined contemporary forms softened by natural tones and organic lines, blending harmoniously with the surrounding greenery. Embracing the natural topography of wadis, mountains, and landscaped trails, Avelia creates a tranquil visual identity where each home feels rooted in nature and part of a calm, picturesque environment.

Ovelle at The Valley presents a refined architectural vision shaped by the serene landscapes of Emirati wadis, mountains, and expansive green meadows. Its villa façades embrace earthy tones, natural materials, and elegant modern lines, creating a harmonious dialogue with the surrounding nature. The community’s masterplan prioritizes slow living, peaceful movement, and organic integration with the land, resulting in a tranquil, nature-inspired environment where open spaces, flowing water, and golden light define the daily atmosphere.

Xenia Residence by NYX Real Estate Development brings an elegant and contemporary living experience to JVC District 13, blending calm residential charm with modern urban comfort. Its low-rise G+4 architecture creates an intimate community feel, enhanced by soft design lines and warm, inviting aesthetics. Surrounded by parks, schools, retail, and key lifestyle destinations, the project offers a balanced environment ideal for residents seeking both tranquility and connectivity within Dubai.

Il Vento by Kora Properties offers a reimagined vision of luxury coastal living, defined by timeless Italian design from Pininfarina Architecture. The project stands as a striking symbol of elegance, blending serene sophistication with an atmosphere inspired by a summer getaway. With its harmonious lines, maritime influences, and world-class aesthetics, Il Vento creates a living experience that is both exclusive and deeply connected to the sea.

The Row Saadiyat by Aldar is a boutique village of seven sculptural residential buildings conceived by Bjarke Ingels Group, with fluid, organic lines that harmonise with natural light and landscape. Each building rises from a ground floor to nine residential levels, with light facades, panoramic windows and horizontal balconies, while layered lighting creates a sculptural effect in the evening. The collection includes one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts offering a study or a maid's room.

Nasim Al Bahr Residences is a refined coastal development that captures the essence of modern seaside living through a seamless connection between architecture and nature. Designed as a dialogue between sea, sand, and sky, its sculpted twin towers reflect the natural rhythm of the Gulf, combining flowing lines, expansive glass façades, and elegant stone detailing. The result is a serene and sophisticated environment where the changing light of sunrise and sunset becomes an integral part of everyday life.

Golf Hills 2 is a contemporary residential development that seamlessly combines elegant architecture with the tranquility of lush green surroundings and panoramic golf course views. Offering a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive three-bedroom townhouses, the project is designed to create a refined living environment where modern design, natural beauty, and everyday comfort exist in perfect harmony. Spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and open-plan interiors fill each home with natural light while creating a seamless connection between indoor living spaces and the surrounding landscape.

Golf Hills is a contemporary residential development that combines elegant architecture with the tranquility of lush green surroundings and panoramic golf course views. Offering a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive three-bedroom townhouses, the project has been thoughtfully designed to create a harmonious living environment where natural beauty and modern sophistication exist in perfect balance. Expansive windows, open-plan layouts, and refined architectural details fill each residence with natural light while seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor spaces.

Alder at Park Five is the final residential phase of a master-planned community, offering a contemporary collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. The project features modern mid-rise architecture with refined façades, spacious balconies, and thoughtfully designed residences that prioritize functionality and comfort. Open-plan layouts, abundant natural light, and carefully planned interior spaces create a modern living environment suited to both end users and investors. The development emphasizes quality construction, efficient space utilization, and a contemporary residential experience.

Terra Gardens at Expo City Dubai stands as a sanctuary of modern design interwoven with nature’s calm. Surrounded by lush landscapes and elegant architecture, this community captures the essence of sustainable urban living. Each structure harmonizes sleek, contemporary lines with natural textures, creating an inviting environment where every view opens toward greenery and sunlight.

Celesto 2 by Tarrad Development rises elegantly within the vibrant DLRC community, offering residents a prestigious address directly along Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan Road. Defined by sleek lines and contemporary architectural expression, the building showcases open 360-degree views that frame the modern Dubai landscape. Its structure reflects a commitment to sophistication and practical design, blending timeless aesthetics with a prime and well-connected location.

Stax rises as a bold architectural statement in the heart of Dubai, where fluid lines and organic contours redefine the skyline with a sense of movement and light. Its sculpted façade, warm tones, and flowing balconies create a refined balance between modern elegance and natural harmony, offering a contemporary sanctuary that feels both vibrant and timeless.

projects.a: Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour
projects.ov: Lyvia By Palace is a refined residential masterpiece that embodies the spirit of curated luxury. The development offers an exclusive collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments as well as elegant 3-bedroom townhouses, each thoughtfully designed to reflect a balance between sophistication and comfort. Every home features warm neutrals, rich textures, and meticulous details that create a sense of harmony and modern elegance.

Aurea at Rashid Yachts and Marina rises gracefully on the shores of Dubai’s iconic waterfront, where contemporary design meets timeless elegance. Surrounded by sweeping marina vistas, the Dubai skyline, and lush parks, Aurea offers residents an exclusive lifestyle that blends serenity with the vibrancy of a world-class destination. Every detail of its architecture reflects sophistication, from sleek lines and expansive terraces to panoramic glass façades that capture natural light and breathtaking views.

Rise by Athlon is the first apartment collection within an active-living master community by Aldar, designed so that residents are never far from their next activity. Three low-rise buildings rise above a ground floor and a podium to four residential floors, while five themed towers reach between twenty-one and twenty-seven residential floors, creating a dynamic vertical expression of life in motion. Expressive lines, natural materials and lighting accents shape a contemporary silhouette, and the project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments.

Vindera at The Valley is a refined residential community that blends contemporary architecture with expansive green landscapes. Designed with clean lines, elegant façades, and natural surroundings, the development creates a serene environment where flower farms, open meadows, and forest-inspired trails are seamlessly integrated into a modern master plan. The overall concept focuses on calm, balance, and a strong connection to nature, offering a peaceful retreat within a well-planned suburban setting.

ELAR1S Sky is a super high-rise residential development created by Object 1, designed as a modern architectural landmark that embodies the elements of air, light, and life. The project offers a curated selection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, catering to both individuals and families seeking a refined urban lifestyle. With its striking vertical form and contemporary design language, ELAR1S Sky stands out as a visionary addition to the skyline, combining aesthetic elegance with functional living spaces.

Antalya is a contemporary residential development that brings a refined Mediterranean-inspired lifestyle into the heart of Dubai. The architecture is defined by clean lines, open compositions, and a soft, elegant aesthetic that emphasizes light, space, and balance. A curated selection of studios and multi-bedroom apartments is thoughtfully designed with functional layouts and expansive glazing, creating bright, airy interiors that seamlessly connect indoor comfort with the surrounding environment.

Fahid Beach Terraces by Aldar is a beachfront residential collection of six towers designed by the internationally acclaimed architect Koichi Takada. Flowing forms, extensive glazing and gently curving balconies inspired by tidal imprints mirror the rhythm of the shoreline. Each tower rises above a ground floor and a podium level to ten residential floors, offering one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts including a maid's room, together with five-bedroom penthouses.

Sera 2 is a thoughtfully designed residential project that combines modern architectural aesthetics with community-focused living. Set within a prime location, it offers residents a harmonious environment where clean lines, contemporary facades, and lush landscaping create a sense of serenity and sophistication.

Selvara 4 embodies the essence of refined equestrian living, where timeless architecture and natural textures create a harmonious balance with its lush surroundings. The community's design draws on clean, contemporary lines, softened by natural elements, resulting in a sophisticated aesthetic that seamlessly blends with the expansive green landscapes and prestigious polo fields. Each residence at Selvara 4 is crafted as a sensory sanctuary, featuring airy spaces that flow effortlessly, with soft natural light illuminating travertine floors, hand-finished woodwork, and veined stone accents.

Selvara 3, a masterpiece by Emaar Properties, presents a curated collection of four-bedroom villas, a masterplan community that embodies the essence of equestrian traditions and refined estate living. The villas, designed as low-density, two-storey contemporary homes, boast clean silhouettes that rise from textured landscapes, their exteriors wrapped in a soothing blend of clay, stone, and soft neutral hues that harmonize with the surrounding landscape. This understated modern contemporary architecture, infused with material warmth, positions Selvara 3 as a sensory sanctuary tailored for intentional living.

projects.a: Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour
projects.ov: Montiva by Vida is a refined residential project nestled within the vibrant Dubai Creek Harbour—a destination where contemporary architecture meets serene waterfront living. Designed with VIDA’s signature aesthetic, Montiva offers a unique lifestyle surrounded by lush gardens, botanical escapes, and panoramic views of the skyline, creek, and parks. The development harmonizes upscale urban design with the calming presence of nature, creating a tranquil retreat in one of Dubai’s most dynamic neighborhoods.

ELAR1S Axis is a contemporary mixed-use development that redefines urban living through a combination of innovative architecture and functional design. Conceived as a landmark destination, the project integrates residential and commercial spaces within a striking structure characterized by bold asymmetrical forms, clean lines, and a minimalist aesthetic. Inspired by the concepts of “air” and “element,” the development emphasizes openness, movement, and connectivity, creating an environment that reflects the evolving needs of modern city life while establishing a distinctive presence on the skyline.

Aquora is a visionary residential development by Casa Vista Development, a luxury property developer shaped by nearly two decades of entrepreneurial experience and strategic real estate expertise. This flagship project takes form on Dubai Islands as an exclusive waterfront address, conceived through a hospitality-inspired design approach that prioritizes enduring value and architectural clarity. The development offers a collection of simplex and duplex residences, complemented by a limited number of signature apartments, each framed by marina waters and open horizons that define life defined by the shore.

Canal Front Residences 3 and 4 by Meydan present an elegant waterfront development inspired by the fluid beauty of the Dubai Water Canal. The architecture features a contemporary façade with clean lines and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that reflect light and water, creating a refined and tranquil visual identity. Positioned along both the northern and southern banks, the project offers a harmonious balance between privacy and connectivity, forming a serene residential retreat within a vibrant urban setting.

Baystar by Vida is an elegant waterfront development that brings together the sophistication of Vida Hotels & Resorts with the dynamic spirit of Rashid Yachts & Marina. Featuring a sleek modern façade, the building rises gracefully along the shoreline, offering a lifestyle that seamlessly blends luxury with coastal serenity. Its design reflects a refined minimalism, enriched with soft curves and panoramic glass, capturing the rhythm of the sea and sky.

EVERGR1N House 4 is a contemporary residential development located in Jumeirah Garden City, designed as a modern urban sanctuary that blends architectural elegance with lush green surroundings. Positioned in one of Dubai’s most central and vibrant communities, the project offers residents a refined lifestyle with easy access to key landmarks and major city destinations. The building features a clean, modern façade with expansive glazing and carefully considered design elements that emphasize natural light, openness, and a strong connection to the surrounding landscape.

The Beach House Fahid by Aldar is a coastal residential collection set in the vibrant heart of an island designed around well-being, offering partial views of the expansive sea and the city skyline. The community comprises eleven elegant buildings, five rising from a ground floor to seven residential floors and the others to nine residential floors, where contemporary architecture blends with the natural surroundings. The project offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts including a maid's room.

ALTA V1EW is a contemporary residential development designed to elevate modern living through a combination of architectural innovation, lifestyle comfort, and nature-inspired design. Offering a selection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, the project caters to individuals and families seeking a refined yet practical urban home. Located within the vibrant Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) community, ALTA V1EW is positioned to provide residents with excellent connectivity to schools, retail destinations, parks, and major highways, while maintaining a serene residential atmosphere.

Rosehill offers a serene collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to harmonize with nature and elevate everyday living. Each home is bathed in natural light, framed by lush gardens and panoramic vistas of the Dubai Hills Golf Course. With open-air terraces and soft landscaping, the residences embrace a calming connection between indoor elegance and outdoor tranquility.

DWTN Residences is a landmark residential development that redefines vertical living through a unique concept of six dedicated lifestyle ecosystems integrated throughout the tower. The project comprises a limited collection of 432 exclusive residences and 90 signature residences, including one- to three-bedroom apartments, duplexes, penthouses, and an ultra-exclusive royal palace. The architectural concept transforms a traditional residential tower into a self-contained vertical community, where each ecosystem is designed to support different aspects of daily life.

projects.a: Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour
projects.ov: Discover Silva, a canvas painted with nature’s finest hues and the city’s vibrant strokes. Here, the cadence of Creek views, skyline view and jade landscapes create an inspiring backdrop for a life of poised living. From green living, calm waterside paths to dynamic retail havens, experience a curated blend of peace and vitality.

VERDAN1A 4 is a contemporary residential development located in the Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), designed to combine modern urban living with a strong connection to nature. The project offers a diverse selection of apartments, including studios, 1, 2, 2.5, and 3.5-bedroom units, making it suitable for individuals, couples, and families. With its elegant architectural approach and sustainability-focused design philosophy, VERDAN1A 4 creates a balanced environment where landscaped green areas and modern structures coexist harmoniously, delivering a lifestyle centered on comfort, wellness, and long-term livability.

Vida Residences Hillside is a stunning project offering a selection of exquisitely designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, along with spacious 3-bedroom townhouses. Each home features a private balcony that opens up to captivating views of Dubai Hillside Park, blending modern urban living with lush natural beauty. The architecture and interior design reflect a serene minimalism, using earthy tones and clean lines to create a calming atmosphere.

DoubleTree by Hilton is a residential development that blends the brand’s signature hospitality with modern urban living. Designed to offer both comfort and sophistication, the project features a selection of one- and two-bedroom apartments with contemporary interiors and smart layouts. Every detail reflects a balance between functionality and style, creating a welcoming environment suited for both everyday living and entertaining.

1WOOD Residence 2 is a contemporary residential development located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), designed to create a calm, nature-inspired living environment within the heart of Dubai. The project is defined by its warm-toned façade and use of natural textures, reflecting an architectural concept rooted in earthy materials and organic forms. Combining modern urban living with a sense of tranquility, the development offers residents a balanced lifestyle where comfort, design, and connection to nature come together seamlessly.

Franck Muller Vanguard is a landmark residential project that brings together avant-garde design and timeless elegance, inspired by the bold identity of the iconic Swiss watchmaker. The development embodies a distinctive vision of luxury living, where architectural expression, innovation, and refined detailing create a truly unique lifestyle concept in Dubai.

Oasis Lofts by Uniestate Properties is a sophisticated residential project. Offering a variety of living spaces including studios and one and two-bedroom apartments, each residence is designed with modern comfort and elegance in mind. The homes are equipped with smart home systems, providing advanced technology for seamless control over lighting, climate, and security, creating a truly futuristic living experience.

Ethan by Griffin is a boutique residential address set within the prestigious Nad Al Sheba district, where contemporary architecture meets a calm, resort-inspired atmosphere. The mid-rise structure, defined by clean lines and refined proportions, is thoughtfully designed to balance privacy with openness. A limited collection of one- and two-bedroom residences is carefully planned to maximize space, natural light, and everyday functionality, creating homes that feel both modern and inviting in the heart of the city.

Evora Residences by ANAX Developments is a contemporary residential building that pairs modern luxury with practical, well-considered design. The building rises from a ground floor and a podium level to ten residential floors topped by a roof level that completes its refined architectural profile. The collection offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts, high-quality finishes and balconies, creating comfortable homes suited to professionals, couples and growing families seeking a balanced everyday lifestyle.

Beach Residences at Siniya Island is a premium waterfront project by Sobha Realty, featuring four luxurious residential complexes: Aquamarine, Delphine, Selene, and Coraline. The development consists of a total of four towers, including two 7-story Towers A and C, one 9-story Tower B, and one intimate 2-story Tower D. Located on the scenic Siniyah Island in Umm Al Quwain, the project offers tranquil coastal living, where modern architectural aesthetics blend harmoniously with the island’s natural beauty. The residences across all three complexes boast elegant interiors and contemporary designs, providing a luxurious and serene lifestyle.

One Beverly is a statement of refined living, where the elegance of French Art Deco meets the vibrant rhythm of modern Dubai. Rising in the heart of Arjan, the project is conceived as a design-driven landmark, defined by expressive geometry, rich detailing, and a sense of theatrical sophistication. Its curated collection of studios, one- and two-bedroom residences is thoughtfully arranged to balance aesthetic beauty with everyday functionality, creating a space where architecture becomes an experience of style, light, and proportion.

Almeria is an exclusive villa phase within the Bloom Living community, offering a limited collection of 120 residences designed for privacy and refined living. The project features spacious 3- to 7-bedroom villas, combining modern architectural elements with a setting that embraces greenery and open space. Thoughtfully planned layouts, elegant proportions, and a seamless connection to the surrounding landscape create a calm and sophisticated residential environment ideal for family living.

Exotica by Al Marina rises as an eighteen‑story architectural gem crafted by Al Marina, offering eighty‑eight residential units across one‑ and two‑bedroom configurations. The façade blends contemporary sleek lines with timeless details, showcasing modern finishes and exquisite architectural accents that command visual interest. Inside, spacious living areas, stylish kitchens equipped with modern appliances, and panoramic views frame a refined ambience for residents.

Valores Residences is an upscale residential development. This project offers a sophisticated blend of style and practicality, featuring elegantly designed condominiums that cater to diverse living preferences and promise a contemporary lifestyle. More than just a residential complex, Valores Residences is designed to enhance everyday living, offering residents a sanctuary of comfort and sophistication.

Iluka Residences by MS Homes is a contemporary luxury development that redefines waterfront living by combining peaceful surroundings with the convenience of urban life. Comprising eight residential floors, the project offers an exclusive collection of one- to four-bedroom apartments, each featuring a private swimming pool. Distinguished by its elegant architectural curves and refined design, Iluka creates a sophisticated residential environment where spacious layouts, stylish interiors, and abundant natural light come together in perfect harmony.

Mayfair Gardens by Majid redefines luxury living as a stunning residential development designed to embody the perfect fusion of elegance and modern city life, offering a thoughtfully curated collection of studios and one-bedroom apartments. This exceptional address is not merely a residence but an invitation to immerse yourself in a dynamic and enchanting spirit, featuring a striking architectural design with lush vertical gardens and flowing curves that create a distinctive presence.

Haya on the Park is a contemporary residential development that brings together elegant architecture, modern comfort, and a strong connection to nature. Set in a vibrant and prestigious neighborhood, the project offers a refined collection of apartments designed for stylish urban living. Its striking façade is defined by clean architectural lines, expansive windows, and dynamic design elements, creating a sophisticated presence while allowing interiors to feel bright, open, and welcoming. Thoughtfully selected earthy tones and natural materials further enhance the atmosphere, shaping homes that feel calm, balanced, and timeless.

The Haven 2 is a contemporary residential development by Meraki Developers, designed to deliver a harmonious balance of modern architecture, everyday comfort, and sustainable living. The project features elegantly designed residences with spacious layouts, abundant natural light, and refined interiors that emphasize both functionality and timeless style. Thoughtfully planned with attention to quality and detail, The Haven 2 creates a peaceful residential environment where sophisticated design meets practical urban living.

Hyde Residences Dubai Hills is a lifestyle-driven residential development where contemporary architecture meets artistic expression, creating a vibrant and refined urban retreat. The design blends modern elegance with a creative identity, reflected in its dynamic interiors, curated art elements, and expressive common spaces. Residences feature spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow, allowing natural light to define each space while offering serene views of the surrounding greenery and cityscape.

Me Do Re 2 is a premium smart residential development that combines cutting-edge technology with contemporary architecture in the prestigious Jumeirah Lakes Towers community. Overlooking the tranquil lake and surrounded by lush green spaces, the project offers an elegant collection of residences designed to deliver exceptional comfort, functionality, and style. Thoughtfully planned interiors, refined architectural details, and intelligent living solutions create a sophisticated environment where modern luxury meets everyday convenience.

Fairmont Residences Solara Tower is an iconic high-rise development rising in the heart of Downtown Dubai, designed to deliver a refined urban lifestyle with a strong connection to nature. The 55-storey tower showcases a contemporary architectural language defined by clean lines, expansive glazing, and integrated greenery that softens its vertical form. Each residence is carefully positioned to capture panoramic views of landmarks such as Burj Khalifa and the city skyline, while spacious layouts and floor-to-ceiling windows create light-filled interiors that feel open, elegant, and seamlessly connected to the surroundings.

Jardin Astral is an ultra-luxury, garden-facing, designer apartment complex with 46 exclusive homes in the heart of Jumeirah Garden City, located just under fifteen minutes from Dubai’s most iconic urban centers. Finely balanced between the vibrant life of the city and a calm, green, walkable community, and appointed with the most luxurious amenities, this project is located at the best intersection of two aspects of life.

Nineteen Riviera Lagoon presents an extraordinary collection of villas, each meticulously designed to harmonize indoor and outdoor living spaces, thereby redefining the concept of luxurious residences.
