These opulent villas boast an impressive array of features, including a self-contained suite on the second floor, adorned with a bedroom, bathroom, terraces, and a private plunge pool, perfect for hosting discerning guests. The gated community is complemented by a serene community park, a grand entrance, and exquisite Italian kitchens, all carefully crafted to create an exclusive and refined environment.

Riviera Lodge, a distinguished residential development, presents a masterful blend of modern design and premium amenities, crafting an extraordinary lifestyle that surpasses expectations. This esteemed project boasts a range of meticulously designed one- and two-bedroom apartments, each featuring built-in kitchen appliances, a cutting-edge smart home system, and fully fitted bathrooms, providing a truly refined living environment. The emphasis on flexible layouts allows residents to tailor their spaces to suit their unique needs, making every apartment a personalized oasis.

Takaya is a premium residential project by Union Properties. This unique community offers a blend of contemporary living spaces, featuring three modern residential towers with stunning views, alongside townhouses and villas nestled around the base for privacy within a vibrant community. With its modern design and strategic location, Takaya promises an elevated lifestyle experience in one of Dubai's most sought-after areas.

One Residence is a contemporary residential development that brings together architectural expression and refined urban living. Defined by its striking façade, the building showcases a rich interplay of textures and materials, complemented by floor-to-ceiling windows that open up sweeping views of the city skyline. Bronze-finished balconies and copper accents enhance its vertical elegance, while the overall design reflects a balance between modern sophistication and timeless appeal.

Sofitel Residences by Azha Properties is a branded residence that brings the French art de vivre into everyday life. Designed as a sculpture of light and form, the building combines glass and flowing lines, with decorative facade lighting that gives it a special presence after dark. It rises above a ground floor, a mezzanine and two podium levels to eleven residential floors and two roof levels, offering one- to three-bedroom apartments and four- and five-bedroom penthouses.

Reportage Village Khalifa City is a masterpiece infused with a contemporary Italian touch. Featuring a collection of thoughtfully designed townhouses, this development strives to create a luxurious lifestyle in the beautiful capital. Surrounded by parks, schools, mosques, and community retail outlets, the project creates a vibrant and convenient neighborhood where residents can open up to life and breathe the luxury of living among lush greens.

One Crescent Palm by AHS Properties is an ultra-luxury residential landmark designed by Killa Design around the concept of villas in the sky. The building presents an exclusive collection of three- and four-bedroom penthouses, five-bedroom sky villas and six-bedroom sky mansions. Each curve of the wave-like facade is deliberately shaped to hold private pools and green pockets, giving the architecture an integrated, flowing character, while infinity-edge pools, double-height volumes and large terraces open towards the sea, Burj Al Arab and the city skyline.

Parkside Boulevard is a masterclass in refined living, where every aspect of the community has been meticulously crafted to provide a sanctuary of elegance and sophistication.This exclusive community boasts impeccably crafted residences, adorned with exquisite finishes and panoramic views, setting a new standard for urban luxury. With stunning studios and one and two-bedroom apartments available, each residence is a celebration of refined elegance and timeless sophistication, providing a unique and unparalleled living experience.

Empire Livings, conceived by Empire Developments, rises as a sleek high‑rise tower that combines a retail ground floor, two basement parking levels, three podium levels and fourteen residential floors. The development presents studios, one‑bedroom apartments and duplex units, some of which enjoy private pools, while floor‑to‑ceiling windows flood each home with natural light and frame expansive city views. Design emphasis on style and functionality creates interiors that feel both spacious and purposeful.

projects.d: Albait Al Duwaliy Real Estate Development
projects.ov: Alef Noon Residence by Al Bait Al Duwaliy is a contemporary residential tower that blends traditional and modern architectural design. Elegant forms and generous landscaped terraces give the building a refined, welcoming character. The tower rises above a basement parking level, a ground floor with retail units and a three-level podium to sixteen residential floors and a roof. The project offers studios, one-bedroom apartments and one-bedroom apartments with an extra room, designed for both residents and investors.

Topaz Residences is a prestigious development by Eagle Hills. This thirteen-storey building features a curated collection of one to four-bedroom apartments and luxury three to four-bedroom townhouses, housed within a ground floor, a two-level podium, and residential floors. The design draws inspiration from the region's traditional architecture, reimagined through a contemporary lens, with a clean, minimalist façade and a timeless palette of beige and brown tones that seamlessly combines distinguished conventional architectural practices with modern amenities.

Skyscape at Sobha Hartland II emerges as the definitive pinnacle of luxury waterfront living, a breathtaking eighty-five-story tower that elevates the very concept of sophisticated urban existence to extraordinary new heights. This remarkable residence stands as a testament to Sobha Realty's legendary craftsmanship, where exceptional attention to detail, from conceptualization to completion, reflects an unwavering commitment to timeless quality and perfection.

Kempinski Marina Residences is a premium waterfront development set within the prestigious Dubai Marina, designed to deliver refined urban living with a strong connection to its surroundings. The architecture is defined by elegant lines and contemporary forms, complemented by expansive terraces that incorporate greenery and private outdoor spaces. A selection of one-bedroom apartments to spacious five-bedroom duplexes is thoughtfully planned to maximize views of the marina and skyline, while open layouts and floor-to-ceiling glazing create bright, sophisticated interiors with a seamless indoor-outdoor flow.

Lucky Royale is a contemporary residential development offering a diverse collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive three- and four-bedroom sky villas. The project combines modern architecture with sophisticated design, creating residences that emphasize space, natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Floor-to-ceiling windows, private terraces, and carefully planned layouts enhance the sense of openness, while the overall design reflects a balance between luxury, functionality, and contemporary urban living.

Sea View Residence, crafted by the renowned Sama Ezdan, presents a masterpiece of luxury living, boasting an exquisite array of meticulously designed one and two bedroom apartments that epitomize elegance and comfort. Each apartment is a harmonious blend of natural beauty and modern convenience, with spacious interiors bathed in natural light and adorned with contemporary finishes that evoke an ambiance of sophistication and tranquility. The apartment's design is a testament to the developer's attention to detail, creating a sanctuary that perfectly balances luxury and functionality.

Lumina Vista by ARIB Developments is a contemporary residential building with original architecture and a serene outlook over the landscaped greenery of the community. The building rises from a ground floor and a podium level to the residential floors, with clean lines and generous glazing that bring natural light into every home. The collection offers studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom duplexes, designed for professionals, couples and small families seeking a calm, practical home.

Riva Residence is a beautifully designed development offering a curated collection of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments that combine style, comfort, and functionality. Each home has been thoughtfully planned with spacious layouts, elegant interiors, and modern finishes that create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The project is presented as a perfect choice for those who value both luxury and convenience, blending sophistication with practical living.

Lucky Oasis Residence is a contemporary residential development designed to deliver a refined and comfortable living experience through thoughtfully crafted interiors and modern architectural design. The project focuses on creating elegant living spaces where functionality meets sophistication, with carefully planned layouts, stylish finishes, and attention to detail throughout. Designed to cater to modern lifestyles, the residences offer a welcoming atmosphere that combines comfort, practicality, and contemporary aesthetics, creating homes that are both inviting and timeless.

Maison Elysee III by Pantheon Development is a prestigious residential tower rising 28 floors high, located in the vibrant community of Jumeirah Village Circle. The project is designed with a sense of openness, airiness, and simplicity, creating a clean and versatile living environment that serves as a perfect canvas for residents to shape their own personalized space. Its modern architectural language reflects elegance and clarity, making it a standout addition to the neighborhood skyline.

Rijas Majan is a serene boutique hotel residence. Step into a space adorned with earthy tones, where soothing neutrals are accentuated by gentle pastel greens, infusing a touch of nature into every room. This subtle pop of color brings a refreshing energy, creating a harmonious balance between modern sophistication and natural tranquility. With clean lines and simple shapes ensuring a minimalistic design, the space breathes and invites you to unwind in style.

Golf Place is a refined residential address by Prestige One, located in the vibrant setting of Dubai Sports City. Distinguished by its elegant architectural expression and carefully considered proportions, the development rises as a modern landmark overlooking expansive golf course landscapes. Designed to capture panoramic green views and natural light, Golf Place offers a serene yet dynamic living environment that blends contemporary aesthetics with the openness of its surroundings.

Six Senses Residences is the brand’s first-ever standalone branded residential development, soaring as a world-record tower and redefining sky-high living. Developed by Select Group, this iconic landmark comprises a collection of two to four-bedroom residences, half-floor penthouses, and ultra-luxurious duplex and triplex Sky Mansions. Engineered to promote sustainability and well-being, the tower integrates biophilic principles and classical feng shui throughout its design, creating a home that nurtures both body and soul.

Sobha Realty has redefined the concept of luxury residential living with the exquisite Sobha Orbis, a masterpiece that embodies the Art of Detail philosophy, where meticulous attention to detail crafts luxury living experiences that surpass the ordinary. Nestled in the dynamic cityscape, Sobha Orbis emerges as an emblem of refined living, boasting sleek architectural design and sumptuous interior finishes that evoke a timeless aura of luxury. This premium three-tower luxury apartment complex stands as a jewel in the crown of the vibrant new community, with every detail curated to indulge the senses and elevate the living experience.

Electra Acube is a high-rise residential tower by Acube Developments, named after the blue-white giant star in the Pleiades cluster of the Taurus constellation. The building rises above basement and podium parking levels and offers studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected residences featuring private pools. Clean contemporary lines, a focus on sustainable design principles and wide views over the golf course and the city define the architecture, while the grand lobby sets a refined tone on arrival.

Taraf Karl Lagerfeld Villas is a captivating collection of customizable residences, mirroring the façade of Karl Lagerfeld's Paris headquarters and inspired by eighteenth-century design, offering two distinct styles — Soft Modern and Urban Modern — tailored for high-net-worth individuals. The villas incorporate significant elements such as a special library reflecting Lagerfeld's extensive collection of over three hundred thousand books, showcasing the approach the iconic designer would have taken in building his home in Dubai.

Seville is a refined lakeside community within the Bloom Living master development in Zayed City, Abu Dhabi, inspired by the charm of Mediterranean Spanish architecture. The project blends traditional aesthetics with contemporary design, offering a collection of villas and townhouses that emphasize space, light, and comfort. Residences range from two- and three-bedroom townhouses to spacious three- to six-bedroom villas, all designed with generous layouts, elegant proportions, and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living.

Seaside is a residential development designed to bring together the ease of coastal living and the comfort of contemporary design. Offering a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences, the project is conceived as a modern retreat where elegant interiors and a welcoming atmosphere create a refined everyday lifestyle. With its prime setting and emphasis on comfort, Seaside presents a living environment shaped by sophistication, simplicity, and a strong sense of home.

South Living Tower is a contemporary residential development offering a collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed to accommodate modern family living. The project features a clean architectural design that combines functional layouts with comfortable interior spaces, creating a practical and welcoming residential environment. Residents are greeted by a double-height entrance lobby enhanced by a feature waterfall wall, while the residences are thoughtfully planned to maximize comfort, usability, and everyday convenience.

Vivanti Residences by Meteora Developers is a masterpiece of contemporary design, where elegance and sophistication entwine to create the ultimate urban living experience. Meticulously crafted by visionary designers and architects, the residences seamlessly blend minimalist elements with a warm, inviting aesthetic, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the surroundings. With expansive dimensions, walls of glass, and soaring ceiling heights, each home is a gracious oasis, perfectly suited for gatherings of all sizes, and exemplifying the epitome of refined urban residence.

Sonate Residences by Condor is a distinctive residential project designed around the concept of wellness, offering a calm and balanced lifestyle within a thoughtfully crafted architectural setting. The development rises across multiple levels, including basement, podiums, 27 residential floors, and a rooftop, forming a modern yet serene presence. Its design philosophy focuses on harmony, with clean lines, soft forms, and carefully considered spaces that encourage tranquility, making the building a true sanctuary where luxury and well-being come together.

Wadi Villas by Arista Properties is an exclusive gated enclave conceived as a private retreat, where tranquillity, greenery and architectural elegance come together. Flowing forms meet crisp horizontal lines, while facades in light natural tones with textured panels, decorative screens and panoramic glazing create a stepped composition of terraces and balconies. The homes rise above a basement level and a ground floor to two upper floors, offering four- and five-bedroom villas and six-bedroom mansions.

99 Parkplace is a collection of ninety-nine residences designed to reflect sophistication and functionality, located in the vibrant community. From the beautiful elevation to the aesthetic interiors and expertly curated amenities, everything at 99 Parkplace exudes exclusivity and charm. Offering studios, one-bedroom, one-bedroom with study, and two-bedroom with study apartments, this development is a statement about taste, appreciation for the finer things, and a desire for a life that is exquisite, exceptional, and elite.

Marlin is an interesting interplay between the simplicity of modernity and the grandeur of blue vistas, offering a lifestyle that goes far beyond the ordinary. The development comprises two striking towers designed with sweeping curved balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light and reflections of blue into every home. The collection features a refined mix of one, two, three and four-bedroom apartments, along with exclusive three and four-bedroom penthouses, each designed according to the highest standards with stunning elegance that appeals to the finest of tastes.

Sealine Residence by Al Zorah Development Company is a contemporary residential building that blends clean architectural form with coastal charm. The building rises above three ground levels to nine residential floors, with homes arranged around green courtyards that bring light and calm into the heart of the project. The collection offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments in simplex and duplex layouts, complemented by a small selection of retail shops at ground level for everyday convenience.

Sea Glints Mansions is an exclusive collection of beachfront villas set within a secure gated community beside The Oberoi Beach Resort. Contemporary architecture with generous glazing, clean lines and open terraces frames uninterrupted views of the sea. Each mansion rises from a ground floor to a first floor and offers five bedrooms together with a maid's room, providing spacious accommodation for large families. Three separate entrances allow residents, guests and service staff to move through the home with complete privacy.

Creekside Residence by Al Zorah Development Company is a waterfront residential building set along a tranquil creekside promenade and overlooking a preserved mangrove forest. Mediterranean-inspired architecture is combined with a striking form that takes inspiration from grand amphitheatres, allowing each home to become a private viewing box towards the creek, the marina and the golf fairways. The building rises above lower ground levels and a ground floor to eight residential floors and a rooftop, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments.

Gateway Porto Al Zorah is a waterfront residential development of two contemporary buildings set along a calm creek. A minimalist interpretation of Mediterranean architecture gives the project a light, timeless character, with shaded terraces, soft forms and clean facades. Each building rises from a ground floor to eight residential floors around an internal courtyard brightened by skylights. The project offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts designed as duplexes for families seeking extra space.

Al Zorah Seaside Hills is a beachfront residential community offering apartments and villas in a barefoot luxury setting, ideal for wholesome wellbeing. The apartments are arranged in low-rise buildings of varying heights that cascade above the villa rooftops, giving residents terraces with expansive views across the sea to the horizon. The project offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments alongside villas, all shaped by a contemporary, simple yet refined design language.

Al Zorah Beach Hills Villa's is a secure, gated beachfront neighbourhood of four-bedroom villas designed for a barefoot luxury lifestyle. The collection includes single-level simplex villas set on the second and third rows and duplex villas on the fourth row, each oriented to enjoy sea views. Every home sits on an extensive plot with ample gardens, a private pool and a secluded internal landscaped courtyard, while planted verges and pedestrian-friendly roads give the community a lush, resort-style character.

projects.n: The Woods Abode at Sobha Sanctuary
projects.ov: The Woods Abode at Sobha Sanctuary is an exclusive residential enclave set within one of the most coveted plots of the larger Sobha Sanctuary masterplan. The development comprises exclusive one- and two-bedroom apartments arranged across its upper residential floors. Homes are designed around park views, natural light, and a deeper connection to the outdoors. The collection, branded as The Harmony Compendium, brings together calming views and refined spaces within a single, thoughtfully designed address.

Reef 996 stands out with a modern architectural identity shaped by clean vertical lines, and an impressive integration of innovation into the building’s core design. Its structure seamlessly blends refined aesthetics with functional engineering, establishing a landmark presence defined by the world’s first Outdoor-Cooled Garden Lounges and patented Outdoor-Cooled Sunken Balconies — features that extend the living environment beyond the interior in every season.

Reef 999 is a landmark residential development by Reef Luxury Developments, located in the emerging and sought-after community. Featuring a range of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, along with four-bedroom villas, this project redefines luxury living by blending innovation with practical solutions. The development introduces the trademark climate-controlled sunken garden concept, an exclusive feature for which Reef holds the sole patent, setting new industry benchmarks and offering residents a year-round space for relaxation.

Reef 998 redefines city living with its exclusive Sunken Balcony concept featuring outdoor cooling, blending nature, comfort and innovation. This forward-thinking development offers smartly planned units with elegant finishes, where luxury meets value. With a building configuration designed to maximize space and light, Reef 998 is more than an investment — it is a lifestyle reimagined, offering residents a calm, connected community with direct access to key destinations.

The Greens at Sobha Sanctuary emerges as a truly exceptional villa community crafted for residents seeking balance, privacy, and restorative living within one of the most visionary master-planned destinations. This remarkable collection offers four-bedroom Garden Villas and five-bedroom Courtyard Villas, thoughtfully designed with smart-home readiness and generous outdoor spaces that invite residents to embrace a lifestyle of calm and connection.

The Willows at Sobha Sanctuary is a gracefully planned villa enclave shaped by flowing greens, soft landscapes and a sense of quiet continuity, designed for residents who value calm, connection and a slower, more intentional way of living. The enclave offers four-bedroom Garden Villas in several layouts, including corner and middle homes, all smart-home ready and arranged along landscaped streets with private gardens.

projects.n: The Woods Horizon at Sobha Sanctuary
projects.ov: The Woods Horizon at Sobha Sanctuary is a private residential building created around park views, natural light, and a deeper connection to the outdoors. The development comprises exclusive one- and two-bedroom apartments arranged across its residential floors, with parks framing the building at the front and rear. Every home opens onto its own balcony, giving the collection a calm, woodland character and a sense of openness.

Binghatti Skyrise by Binghatti is a landmark residential development of three high-rise towers with a crystal-like facade that catches the light like a rare gemstone. Crafted with exceptional attention to detail, the towers rise above basement and podium parking levels to more than forty residential floors, creating an iconic presence on the skyline. The collection offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments designed for refined everyday comfort.

Cello by Taraf is a stylish residential project located in the vibrant community, featuring two modern towers that highlight the elegance of contemporary architecture. Tower A and Tower B offer a diverse range of urban residences, from open studios with intelligent layouts to spacious one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, along with luxurious four-bedroom penthouses. Each residence is meticulously crafted with modern finishes and high-quality materials, catering to a sophisticated and contemporary lifestyle.

Tilal Binghatti is presented as a thoughtfully designed masterplanned villa community that reimagines the developer’s signature architectural style on the ground, creating a calm and complete living environment. The project focuses on spacious, family-oriented living, offering elegant 4, 5, 6 and 7-bedroom villas within a private gated setting designed for long-term comfort and stability. It is positioned as “a life meant to feel steady, open, and complete,” emphasizing balance, greenery, and a sense of everyday ease.

One Sky Park Featured by Versace Ceramics is a contemporary residential development located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, offering a refined lifestyle surrounded by expansive green landscapes and excellent city connectivity. The architecture reflects modern elegance with clean lines, balanced proportions, and a design approach that emphasizes openness and light. The project offers thoughtfully planned residences with spacious layouts, designed to maximize comfort, functionality, and panoramic views across Dubai’s evolving skyline.

15 Cascade Featured by Versace Ceramics is a striking residential landmark located in the heart of Motor City, Dubai, where architecture is inspired by movement, fluidity, and speed. The building’s sculptural façade reflects cascading water forms and aerodynamic curves, creating a dynamic visual identity that stands out within the urban fabric. Designed with a contemporary approach, the development offers a refined collection of residences, including studios, 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, duplexes, and exclusive penthouses with private pools, all emphasizing space, light, and modern elegance.

Sierra by Iman is a masterful creation of contemporary residential design, boasting a carefully curated collection of homes that seamlessly merge modern architecture with the sophistication of urban living. The development features a diverse array of layouts, including studios, one-, one-and-a-half-, two-, and two-and-a-half-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive four-bedroom duplexes with the luxury of private pools. The architectural style is characterized by clean lines, balanced proportions, and functional elegance, resulting in a visually stunning yet highly livable environment that redefines the norms of residential design.

113 Residences by IMAN is a boutique luxury residential development. The project combines contemporary architecture with refined design, creating an exclusive collection of residences tailored for modern urban living. The building features elegant architectural lines, expansive glazing, spacious layouts, and carefully curated interiors that maximize natural light and emphasize a sense of openness and tranquility. Positioned close to Dubai’s most iconic destinations, 113 Residences offers a sophisticated residential experience that blends privacy, comfort, and premium connectivity.

Paradise View II introduces a contemporary architectural concept shaped by clean vertical lines, expansive glazing, and generously sized balconies that create a dynamic and expressive silhouette. The building rises over a basement, ground floor, and twelve residential levels, crowned with a technical roof, forming a harmonious composition within Majan, Wadi Al Safa 3. The project blends modern design with practical structure, offering a refined residential environment in a fast-developing district.

7 Seasons is a contemporary residential address set within International City Phase 2, where modern architecture meets practical urban living. Designed as an intimate development of just 85 residences, the project offers a selection of studios, one-, and two-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully planned to maximize space, light, and everyday functionality. Clean architectural lines and a welcoming design approach create a sense of comfort and simplicity, making 7 Seasons an ideal choice for those seeking a balanced and well-connected lifestyle.

Dugasta Warsan (Jneibi) is a masterfully crafted residential development, boasting a sophisticated portfolio of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments that epitomize refined living. The project's architectural approach is characterized by modernity and understatement, with clean lines, practical layouts, and a cohesive residential identity that creates a balanced living environment. This thoughtful design caters to a diverse range of residential needs, providing a serene and organized atmosphere that is perfect for relaxation and entertainment.

Astra South by Dugasta is a contemporary low-rise residential development offering a collection of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments. The project is designed around modern urban living principles, featuring open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and private balconies or terraces that enhance the sense of space and natural light. Its minimalist architectural style, refined façade, and thoughtfully planned interiors create a residential environment that balances functionality, comfort, and contemporary design. Attention to detail throughout the development contributes to a cohesive and sophisticated living experience.

Terra Tower is a contemporary 12-storey residential development offering a collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed to accommodate a variety of lifestyles. The project combines modern architecture with thoughtfully planned residential layouts, creating comfortable and functional living spaces. Residences are designed with contemporary interiors, spacious layouts, and a focus on everyday practicality, while the overall architectural concept emphasizes elegance, quality, and long-term residential appeal.

Al Haseen Residences 5 by Dugasta embodies a perfect fusion of modern design and timeless comfort, presenting a lifestyle that is both refined and welcoming. Offering studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, every home has been thoughtfully planned with spacious layouts that maximize natural light and functionality. The development represents an elegant expression of contemporary architecture, where sophistication and practicality blend seamlessly to elevate everyday living.

Al Haseen Residences 3 is a contemporary residential development by Dugasta Properties designed to offer a modern and practical living experience. The project features contemporary architecture, efficient layouts, and thoughtfully planned residences that cater to a variety of lifestyle needs. Emphasizing quality construction and functional design, the development is created to provide comfortable living spaces with a focus on everyday convenience, modern aesthetics, and long-term residential value.

Moonsa Residences 2 is a contemporary residential development by Dugasta Properties offering a collection of studio and one-bedroom apartments designed for modern urban living. The project is distinguished by its contemporary architectural design, featuring a striking façade that combines clean lines with modern design elements to create a refined residential presence. The residences are thoughtfully planned to maximize comfort, functionality, and efficient use of space, delivering a lifestyle that balances practicality with contemporary aesthetics.

Moonsa Residences is a contemporary residential development offering a selection of thoughtfully designed studios and apartments tailored to modern urban lifestyles. The project focuses on delivering functional living spaces with contemporary architecture, efficient layouts, and carefully planned interiors. Designed to appeal to both investors and end users, the development combines modern residential design with a strong emphasis on comfort, practicality, and long-term value. Each residence is created to provide a comfortable living environment supported by quality construction and contemporary design standards.

Shahrukhz by Danube is a landmark premium office development, created as a statement address for business leaders, founders, and visionaries. Inspired by the self-made journey of Shahrukh Khan, the project celebrates ambition, success, and the pursuit of building a lasting legacy. Its striking architecture and prestigious location provide exceptional visibility, while a thoughtfully designed business environment creates a distinctive setting for companies looking to establish themselves at a prominent Dubai address.

Fairway Residences is a contemporary 14-floor residential development that reflects refined architectural elegance within a serene golf course setting. The design is defined by sleek modern lines and expansive glass façades that maximise natural light while framing uninterrupted views of the lush greenery. The building’s composition creates a strong sense of openness and harmony, blending modern urban living with the calmness of its natural surroundings, while offering thoughtfully designed residences that prioritise space, comfort, and visual connection to the landscape.

Legado by Prescott is a contemporary residential development by Prescott Developments located in Jumeirah Village Circle, offering a modern architectural statement defined by clean lines, a sleek glass façade, and a balanced composition of podium and residential levels. The project comprises two basement levels, a ground floor, five podium floors, and twenty-six residential floors, creating a well-structured vertical community. A diverse selection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as villas, ensures a flexible lifestyle offering within a refined urban environment.

Verano by Prescott is a contemporary residential development offering a well-balanced selection of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments designed to suit modern lifestyles. The architecture reflects a harmonious blend of modern design and natural inspiration, with clean lines, soft forms, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that maximise natural light. Each residence is carefully planned to create open, functional living spaces that emphasise comfort, elegance, and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor environments.

Floarea Skies by Mashriq Elite Developments is a contemporary residential development that brings together sophisticated architecture, premium design, and modern urban living in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle. Offering a collection of thoughtfully designed residences, the project is distinguished by its elegant façade, landscaped surroundings, and spacious interiors filled with natural light. Every home has been carefully planned with functional layouts, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and refined finishes, creating an atmosphere that balances comfort, style, and everyday practicality.

Provenza Residences by IKR Development is a refined residential project located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, offering a curated collection of studio, one- and two-bedroom apartments, including exclusive units with private plunge pools. Inspired by French architectural elegance, the development combines timeless aesthetics with modern functionality, expressed through clean lines, generous glazing, and carefully composed façades. Each residence is designed to deliver a sophisticated urban lifestyle, where comfort, light, and space are seamlessly integrated.

Floarea Oasis by Mashriq Elite is a contemporary residential development that blends elegant architecture with a peaceful, nature-inspired atmosphere. Offering a collection of studios, one-, and two-bedroom apartments, the project is designed to maximize natural light, space, and everyday comfort. Its refined façade, expansive balconies, and thoughtfully planned interiors create a sophisticated living environment where modern design meets practical functionality, providing residents with a stylish urban retreat in the heart of Dubailand.

The Caden by Prescott Real Estate Development rises at the meeting point of city energy and natural calm within Meydan Horizon, one of Dubai’s most forward-looking communities. Its design captures the duality of urban vitality and serene living — modern architecture opening toward tranquil lagoon views, with interiors that emphasize light, balance, and intelligent comfort. The Caden’s sleek façade and landscaped surroundings reflect a vision of elevated simplicity, where every line and material choice enhances harmony between space, nature, and technology.

Floarea Breeze by Mashriq Elite Developments brings a refined vision of island-inspired living to the heart of Dubai Islands. Designed to merge serenity with connectivity, the project captures the essence of coastal life through thoughtful architecture and natural surroundings. Its tranquil environment, enhanced by landscaped greenery and open waterfront views, creates a haven where modern comfort meets the rhythm of the sea. With easy access to major landmarks and Dubai’s key hubs, the community offers both retreat and convenience in perfect balance.

Greenz by Danube is an exclusive residential development offering a limited collection of fully furnished premium townhouses and villas designed with modern architecture and elegant Italian-style interiors. The development features a range of townhouses, semi-detached and twin villas available in 3, 4, and 5-bedroom configurations. Each home is designed with generous layouts, including maid’s rooms, expansive living spaces, and private rooftop gardens that enhance both functionality and luxury living.

Vestoria Bay by Ahmadyar Developments is a sculptural residential building inspired by the calm beauty of the desert and the soothing rhythm of the sea. Wave-like balconies, clean lines and soft natural textures define an architecture that echoes the coastline. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, townhouses and penthouses, with selected homes featuring private pools and jacuzzis, panoramic balconies and garden views. A curved, softly lit lobby creates a calm sense of arrival.

Palatium Residence by Ahmadyar Developments is a contemporary residential building that rises above a ground floor and a multi-level parking podium. The project offers studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, complemented by retail units at ground level. Every home is designed around refined everyday living, with advanced smart home automation, generous natural light and views over the surrounding community and its green parks. Professional maintenance services support residents and keep the building in excellent condition.

Serenz by Danube is a striking 50-storey residential development located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. Conceptualized as «A World of Amenities», the project sets a new benchmark for modern urban living by seamlessly blending luxury, comfort, and functionality within a vibrant community setting. Serenz by Danube represents a new standard of residential living in JVC—where thoughtful design, world-class amenities, and prime connectivity come together to create a truly elevated lifestyle.

Cove Boulevard by Imtiaz Developments is a residential tower. The project embodies modern elegance with its sleek white façade, curved architectural elements, and distinctive protruding balconies. Designed to offer a sophisticated yet comfortable living experience, the tower features fully furnished studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-bedroom apartments, with select units boasting private pools on their balconies — an exclusive touch of luxury with breathtaking views of the cityscape.

Wynwood Horizon by Imtiaz is a contemporary residential development offering a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive three-bedroom penthouses. The project is designed with a focus on space, natural light, and refined modern living, featuring thoughtfully planned layouts and elegant interiors that create a comfortable residential environment. Large windows, spacious living areas, and carefully considered design elements enhance the sense of openness throughout the residences, while the overall architectural concept combines contemporary aesthetics with functionality and everyday comfort.

Wynwood by Imtiaz is a contemporary luxury residential development designed to combine striking architecture with sophisticated urban living. The project offers a collection of residences ranging from one-bedroom apartments to spacious duplexes, all conceived with an emphasis on space, natural light, and refined design. Floor-to-ceiling windows, expansive terraces, and carefully crafted interiors create a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living areas.

Kore by Imtiaz is an inspiring residential project that draws its name from the body's centre of strength and stability, and it is designed entirely around human performance, longevity and healthy living. Far more than a residence with a gym, it brings together personalised training, intelligent fitness technology, nutrition-focused living and advanced recovery experiences, helping residents live with greater energy, balance and focus every day. The collection offers beautifully planned studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, each created to support a truly holistic wellness lifestyle.

The Archive is a residential masterpiece that redefines the concept of home, masterfully blending architectural brilliance with a deep appreciation for literature and learning. At its heart lies a meticulously curated collection of ten thousand real books, creating an unparalleled living experience that invigorates the mind and nourishes the soul. Every space within this visionary development has been thoughtfully conceived to honour the art of reading and the beauty of contemplation, from the majestic two-storey library wrapped by a graceful spiral stair to the serene writer's room that inspires creativity.

Raw District Phase 2 by Imtiaz Development is an exceptional residential project that brings together contemporary design, comfort, and a vibrant lifestyle in one outstanding destination. Sea Cliff by Imtiaz is a premium waterfront residential development rising on Dubai Islands, where contemporary architecture meets the calm rhythm of the sea. Hatimi is a refined residential development set within Dubai Islands, offering a contemporary vision of elevated coastal living. Havencia by ALA Developments is a premium residential project designed to redefine modern living through elegance, comfort, and thoughtful architectural design. Artistry One Residences is a sculptural residential tower rising gracefully in the heart of Dubai Design District, conceived as a living expression of creativity, balance, and refined urban living. Yas Beach Residence is a stunning waterfront development. One 678 Residences is a contemporary high-rise development that redefines urban living through its elegant architecture and functional design. Serenia District West Residence is a premium residential development by Palma Holding, offering a refined collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed for modern urban living.
