The Terraces at Sobha City is a thoughtfully master-planned residential development defined by contemporary architecture, open spatial planning, and a strong connection to nature. The project features a collection of garden villas designed with an emphasis on natural light, privacy, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Residences are positioned to maximize views of landscaped greenery and water features, while private gardens and elevated terraces extend the living experience beyond interior spaces. The overall design integrates green corridors, shaded walkways, and water elements, creating a calm and balanced urban environment.

Bling Avenue 1 is a boutique residential development set in the dynamic area of Dubai South, designed to create a harmonious balance between modern living and a strong sense of community. The architecture reflects a contemporary approach, combining clean lines with open layouts that enhance space, light, and comfort. Offering a selection of one- and two-bedroom apartments, the project emphasizes functional design, spacious interiors, and large balconies that bring a natural flow between indoor and outdoor living.

Brabus Island is a distinctive waterfront development set in the prestigious Al Seef District, redefining luxury living through bold, automotive-inspired architecture. Designed in collaboration with BRABUS, the project features sculptural forms, dynamic lines, and a striking contemporary aesthetic that echoes the precision and power of high-performance design. Positioned along a serene turquoise coastline, the development combines dramatic visual identity with open, light-filled residences, where expansive glazing and flowing layouts create a seamless connection between indoor spaces and the surrounding waterfront.

One By Preston is a contemporary residential landmark rising in the heart of Dubai South, conceived as a forward-looking expression of modern urban living. Developed by Preston Properties, the project reflects a vision of «building the future, today», combining sleek architecture with smart, sustainable design principles. Its strategic location within a master-planned city places residents at the center of Dubai’s next growth corridor, offering excellent connectivity to major highways, Expo City Dubai, and Al Maktoum International Airport, while maintaining a calm, community-focused atmosphere.

The Spark by ESNAAD is a contemporary residential development set within Mohammed Bin Rashid City, designed to reflect a modern urban lifestyle with a focus on functionality and refined simplicity. The architecture embraces clean lines and a structured aesthetic, while interiors are thoughtfully planned with logical layouts that maximize space, light, and everyday comfort. Positioned within one of Dubai’s most dynamic districts, the project offers seamless connectivity to key destinations, balancing city energy with a sense of calm and privacy.

Kayan Community presents a refined residential concept where nature, architecture, and lifestyle come together in perfect harmony. The development features two distinctive villa typologies — the contemporary Rawya Villas and the culturally inspired Rihal Villas — offering 4- and 5-bedroom configurations designed for modern family living. Each residence is carefully positioned within a serene natural setting, where clean architectural lines, expansive glazing, and organic materials create a seamless dialogue between indoor comfort and the surrounding landscape.

The Artery Residences presents a vibrant, contemporary, and luxurious living environment, masterfully designed for young adults, individuals, and young newly married couples. This bold and dynamic architectural statement reflects a modern lifestyle while remaining welcoming and inclusive, boasting a premium seaside front that offers beautiful sea views and a coastal experience that resonates with its luxurious yet artistic identity.

SHA Residence Emirates by IMKAN Properties is a pioneering wellness-focused residential development located on SHA Island at AlJurf, created in collaboration with the world-renowned SHA Wellness Clinic. Designed as the first fully integrated healthy living island, the project redefines luxury through a holistic approach where every architectural and spatial decision is centered on health, longevity, and balance. The residences are thoughtfully integrated into the natural landscape, with architecture that embraces the coastline, maximizes sea views, and enhances natural ventilation through carefully oriented layouts.

Naseem Al Jurf is a thoughtfully designed residential development that redefines modern luxury through a seamless blend of architecture, nature, and refined living. The project offers a diverse mix of residences, including canal-front villas, spacious family homes, and contemporary apartment buildings, all carefully integrated within a master-planned natural environment. The architecture emphasizes elegance and balance, with clean forms, generous glazing, and a strong connection to landscaped surroundings that create a serene and sophisticated atmosphere.

projects.n: Hilton Residences Abu Dhabi Al Raha
projects.ov: Hilton Residences Abu Dhabi Al Raha is a remarkable branded residential development by Emirates Developments, where the global legacy of Hilton hospitality is woven into the rhythm of everyday living. Rising across ten residential floors, the project delivers 176 beautifully crafted homes, spanning one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, three-bedroom townhouses, four-bedroom apartments and spectacular five-bedroom penthouses.

J-Haus Residences is a boutique residential development conceived to reflect contemporary urban living with a refined, design-forward approach. Located within Jumeirah Village Circle in Dubai, the project is defined by its elegant architectural expression and focus on lifestyle-driven living. The concept brings together modern aesthetics, thoughtful spatial planning, and a calm residential atmosphere, creating homes that feel both exclusive and personal. Designed for individuals who value style, comfort, and functionality, the development presents a harmonious balance between sophistication and everyday practicality.

Marina Star is an elegant residential tower set within one of Dubai’s most prestigious waterfront locations, offering a refined interpretation of contemporary urban living. Designed by Condor Developers, the building rises across twenty-six residential floors with a sleek architectural language defined by soft curves, rounded forms, and flowing lines. Expansive balconies and terraces are enhanced with greenery, creating a seamless connection between architecture and nature, while panoramic windows and open layouts ensure light-filled interiors with stunning views of the canal and city skyline.

La Mer by Elie Saab is an exclusive branded residential development on Al Marjan Island, offering a refined waterfront lifestyle shaped by couture-inspired design and architectural elegance. Comprising three distinctive towers, the project captures the essence of sophisticated coastal living, where bespoke interiors, serene surroundings, and panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf come together in perfect harmony. Every aspect of the development reflects Elie Saab’s signature aesthetic, blending timeless luxury with contemporary comfort in one of the region’s most prestigious island destinations.

projects.n: The Orchard Place Towers A & B
projects.ov: The Orchard Place Towers A & B is a thoughtfully designed residential development in Jumeirah Village Circle, created to offer a calm and comfortable lifestyle surrounded by greenery. Framed by gardens on three sides, the project brings a sense of privacy and tranquility to the heart of the city, creating an atmosphere that feels both peaceful and connected. Every aspect of the development is carefully considered to provide a refined living environment where everyday life feels effortless, relaxed, and elevated.

The WADI is a waterfront residential development located within the Yas Canal community in Abu Dhabi, designed as a destination where nature, architecture, and everyday living seamlessly intersect. Set next to Yas Island, the project is shaped by flowing canals and landscaped surroundings, creating a tranquil yet vibrant environment inspired by the rhythm of water.

Oceana is a sanctuary by the sea — a retreat that seamlessly blends nature's rhythm with modern elegance, nestled on the tranquil shoreline. The architectural design mirrors the horizon, allowing the beauty of the ocean to flow effortlessly into every space. With its fluid lines, open layouts, and resort-inspired atmosphere, Oceana embodies serenity and sophistication, creating a sense of calm that transcends the everyday.

Sila represents a thoughtful vision of modern residential living shaped by sustainability, design excellence, and a deep connection to nature. Conceived as a contemporary residential community, the project blends architecture and landscape to create homes that feel calm, refined, and closely aligned with the environment. The villas and townhouses are designed as elegant family residences, offering spacious layouts, natural light, and an atmosphere that celebrates both privacy and community living.

Reportage Tower is a high-rise residential development, which offers contemporary high-end apartments with views of the canal. Its modern sustainable facade creates a distinctive architectural presence in the centre of the island, which is recognized as one of Abu Dhabi’s prominent luxury destinations. The development comprises 280 residential units and 12 commercial retail spaces, providing a combination of residential and commercial offerings within the project.

Selina Bay, a residential complex by Reportage Properties, consists of two multi-storey buildings, West and East, each with basement, ground, and 18 residential levels. The project features modern architecture and landscaped grounds. Residence formats include studios, 1-3 bedroom apartments, and duplex penthouses with 3-4 bedrooms, as well as 4-bedroom townhouses.

Baia by Reportage Properties is a refined residential community inspired by the natural rhythm of waterfront living, where architecture and lifestyle flow in perfect harmony. This exclusive development offers elegant 3 and 4 bedroom townhouses, thoughtfully designed to combine privacy, space, and a strong sense of connection. With its intimate scale and carefully crafted layout, Baia creates a peaceful yet sophisticated environment where every moment feels meaningful and elevated.

Sensi is a refined residential sanctuary located on Saadiyat Island, where culture, nature, and understated elegance converge. Conceived as more than a place to live, the project is shaped by a philosophy of balance, clarity, and emotional connection to space. Minimalist architecture, light-filled volumes, and carefully composed proportions create an environment where design does not dominate, but gently supports a slower, more meaningful way of life inspired by art, light, and the surrounding landscape.

The District is a thoughtfully designed, fully integrated community located on the serene Al Reem Island in Abu Dhabi. It embraces a modern, vertical living concept where everything is just steps away—offices, medical centers, shopping outlets, fitness hubs, and more. This development is tailored for those who seek a lifestyle of convenience, where the boundaries between work, wellness, and leisure naturally blur.

Perla 1 at the Bay is a brimming gem at the bay, a signature Italian-designed development. Being the first building in Abu Dhabi with only one elevation, all units have direct sea views embracing the shades of blue. Designed to meet all refined tastes, this high-rise building features duplex apartments and three-story townhouses, each with an equal share of sunshine and sea views, making every moment an exciting experience to look forward to. From high-quality finishing and modern facades to perfectly designed spaces and interior art, every bit of space is well-thought to reflect the very essence of magical Yas Island.

Vista 3 is a masterpiece of modernity and aesthetics, standing as a super high-rise building right at the waterfront in one of most sought-after destinations. Following Abu Dhabi's futuristic approach, this stunning residential tower provides the whole lifestyle of Al Reem Island with its luxury, modernity, and accessible fun for all. Offering a wide range of unit types from one to five-bedroom apartments, Vista 3 embraces the colourful horizon of Al Reem Island, where every day is your best day.

Mas Barsha Residency is a contemporary residential project set within the well-established and vibrant district of Al Barsha. The architecture reflects a modern urban aesthetic with clean lines, balanced proportions, and a practical yet refined façade that integrates seamlessly into the surrounding neighborhood. Designed for comfortable city living, the project offers a calm residential atmosphere while remaining closely connected to key lifestyle and business destinations across Dubai.

Verdana VI is a premier residential community, offering a contemporary and luxurious lifestyle in close proximity to Dubai's major attractions. Surrounded by parks, schools, mosques, and retail outlets, this thoughtfully designed development provides a serene and well-connected living environment. Featuring a mix of townhouses and apartments, each residence is crafted to the highest international standards in design, quality, and space, creating homes that are both elegant and functional.

Verdana IV, crafted by Reportage, stands as a contemporary residential enclave offering studios and apartments ranging from one to three bedrooms alongside townhouses configured with two to four bedrooms. The development comprises a multi‑storey block rising nine residential levels and a separate tower ascending fifteen residential levels, both anchored by basement tiers and podium decks. Architectural intent focuses on sleek silhouettes and generous floor plates that nurture airy living spaces.

Verdana III is a premier residential community, complementing the green picture of luxury and privacy with a collection of townhouses and apartments built to the highest international standards. Step into a world where modern elegance meets nature's touch, and art freely expresses itself. This integrated community offers exceptional facilities and a location in the heart of the city, yet away from the hustle, ensuring a serene and fulfilling life where every day can be fully embraced.

Rabdan Gardens is a beautifully crafted residential project by Rabdan Developments, designed to offer a calm and elegant lifestyle in the heart of the city. The architecture embraces soft curves, natural harmony, and park-facing layouts, creating a truly premium living experience. The development features a refined collection of studio, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments designed with generous layouts and thoughtful proportions.

Al Habtoor Tower is located along the Dubai Water Canal and forming a distinctive addition to the Dubai skyline. The tower offers an all-inclusive luxury living environment with stunning views of the city, Dubai Water Canal, and the sea. Designed as a vertical city, Al Habtoor Tower combines elegant residential spaces with a wide range of lifestyle amenities and services.

Alba Tower by Reportage Properties is an exclusive residential mid-rise tower bringing the whole city's luxury to your doorstep. With its meticulous Italian design and captivating interiors, this development offers an extraordinary living experience and a seamless blend of style and convenience. Featuring a collection of one and two-bedroom apartments, Alba Tower redefines urban living, providing a haven of comfort, sophistication, and tranquillity in the heart of the city.

Taormina Village is an extraordinary residential community that redefines luxury living with its exquisite selection of townhouses and villas. Offering a range of three, four, and five-bedroom residences, this development combines elegance with functionality, ensuring spacious and beautifully designed homes for every lifestyle. The pristine white facades and lush green surroundings create a harmonious balance between modern architecture and nature, with every detail thoughtfully crafted to deliver a refined and sophisticated living experience unlike any other.

Reportage Hills is the first of Reportage Properties' upscale signature line, a contemporary gated townhouse community tailored to redefine high-end living. This exclusive community offers a collection of three, four, and five-bedroom townhouses with timeless designs and world-class amenities. With sleek architecture that sings in shades of blues, evoking a rhythm of calm elegance and soulful sophistication, Reportage Hills stands out as an icon of timeless beauty.

House of WELL by WELL Concept Development is a boutique residential development on Dubai Islands, combining contemporary architecture with a refined wellness-focused lifestyle. The project offers 1, 2 and 3-bedroom residences, podium villas and exclusive penthouses, featuring spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, natural tones and high-quality finishes designed to maximize light, comfort and a sense of openness.

Masaar 2 Anber is a residential sanctuary designed to bring harmony between modern living and nature. Nestled within a lush, tree-lined environment, this gated community offers a peaceful escape from the bustling city, allowing residents to reconnect with the beauty of the outdoors. Thoughtfully planned walkways, green spaces, and a stunning swimmable forest lagoon with a waterfall create a serene atmosphere where tranquility and well-being take center stage.

AHS Twin Towers marks the remarkable evolution of an iconic address into a new generation of Grade A commercial space, a landmark reimagined after more than two decades as one of the city's most recognised hospitality destinations. Inspired by the fluid forms of desert dunes, this extraordinary transformation introduces a refined architectural language that honours the building's original character while creating a distinctive new expression for the landmark address.

projects.n: The Ritz Carlton Al Wadi Desert Resort
projects.a: Al Wadi desert, Ras Al Khaimah
projects.ov: The Ritz-Carlton Residences, Ras Al Khaimah, Al Wadi Desert is an exclusive collection of luxurious residences located within the pristine Al Wadi Nature Reserve. This unique project offers the perfect combination of modern amenities in the lap of traditional Arabian hospitality, situated on the idyllic dunes of the Wadi. Designed by H+A, a boutique studio specializing in hospitality and lifestyle design, the residences leverage the existing resort's DNA to enhance the unique desert nature reserve and rich cultural heritage, creating an ideal blend for those who seek to bring the outdoors inside without sacrificing luxury.

Saro at Masaar is a tranquil residential enclave designed for those seeking a slower, more balanced pace of life surrounded by nature. Set within a lush woodland environment where greenery defines the landscape, the community encourages outdoor living through its expansive green spine, offering space for walking, cycling, relaxation, and everyday wellness. It is a place where privacy, calm, and connection to nature shape the overall lifestyle.

Luce is a magnificent building shaped by glass and light, embracing its seafront setting. This sublime building, composed of brilliant glass panels and oriented towards the sea and sunlight, becomes a showcase of captivating design. Offering a collection of brilliantly spacious apartments, Luce is where natural light, elegant materials, and breathtaking ocean views come together to create a living experience of unparalleled brilliance.

Khalid Bin Sultan City by BEEAH Group is a master-planned residential community designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with fluid lines inspired by the iconic BEEAH Headquarters. Sleek, modern homes are set within lush green landscapes and supported by sustainable, net-zero-ready infrastructure. The community offers two-, three- and four-bedroom townhouses and four- and five-bedroom villas, each rising from a ground floor to an upper floor and designed for spacious family living.

Azizi Riviera 56 is envisioned as a refined residential destination in the prestigious Meydan district, offering a serene waterfront lifestyle complemented by exceptional urban connectivity. Designed for individuals and families seeking comfort, elegance, and long-term convenience, the development combines contemporary architecture with a calm coastal atmosphere. Its strategic position within Meydan One grants residents immediate access to entertainment venues, leisure destinations, dining experiences, and essential services while remaining closely connected to major landmarks such as Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport.

Ivy Gardens 2 by Samana Developers is an architectural marvel that redefines luxury. This symphony of contemporary design and timeless elegance stands as a beacon of prestige, where every facet of existence is concealed in lavish sophistication. Featuring studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments with private pools, this development is meticulously crafted to cater to the most discerning tastes, offering a tapestry of opulence that is simply awe-inspiring.

Samana Mykonos Signature is the epitome of luxury living in Dubai, building on the phenomenal success of its predecessor to take refined living to new heights. This exclusive residential property features a collection of studios and one and two-bedroom apartments, all designed to exceed even the loftiest of expectations. From its striking, minimalist yet stunning architecture to its vibrant hues, every detail has been carefully crafted to transport residents to the sun-kissed shores of the Greek island of Mykonos, creating the perfect retreat from the stresses of everyday life.

Royal Yacht Club Residence is a refined waterfront development set on Dubai Islands, positioned at the heart of a vibrant marina promenade. Conceived as a contemporary landmark, the project features two elegant towers united by a sculptural architectural expression overlooking the yacht harbor and open sea. Its location combines privacy with connectivity, placing residents within a curated island environment defined by beachfront access, marina views, and proximity to the city’s key destinations. The concept is rooted in a maritime lifestyle, where light, horizon lines, and fluid balconies echo the movement of the water.

Grandala is a residential masterpiece that embodies the perfect fusion of refined design, cutting-edge technology, and lavish hospitality, tailored to discerning individuals who crave both comfort and sophistication. This visionary project boasts a unique blend of luxury and practicality, with architecture that redefines modern living through meticulous planning, premium services, and a profound sense of community. The residences at Grandala are meticulously crafted to maximize space, flexibility, and elegance, featuring exquisite materials such as marble and stone flooring, advanced climate systems, and innovative modular furniture.

Samana South Haven 2 emerges as a truly exceptional residential address, a stunning architectural statement that brings a new direction to call home in one of the city's most dynamic and rapidly growing districts. This remarkable development offers a curated collection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom residences, thoughtfully designed to deliver a lifestyle of balance, refinement, and modern comfort.

Samana Business Hub emerges as a landmark commercial and lifestyle destination, born from movement, trade, and ambition, and designed to amplify the energy of a district that drives global commerce and connects continents. This exceptional development by Samana is built to reflect the vital role in Dubai's economy, offering world-class infrastructure alongside thoughtfully curated experiences that make business excellence and lifestyle elevation inseparable. With its strategic positioning within Dubai's economic core, this is a place where businesses that drive the economy forward find their perfect home.

Samana Barari Avenue is a premium commercial development by Samana Developers, conceived as a business park reimagined for success in the heart of Majan. Blending cutting-edge architecture with high-end office spaces and prime retail outlets, it is a landmark destination where visionaries, entrepreneurs and established enterprises come together to reshape the future of business. Strategically positioned along Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, the project sits within easy reach of Dunecrest American School, Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure, Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport.

V-Suites is a 19-story residential development which offers a contemporary approach to modern luxury and urban living. The project is designed around the concept of comfort, wellbeing, and refined living, creating a serene residential environment where every detail is focused on enhancing the everyday experience. Its visionary design combines a sophisticated atmosphere with practical spaces tailored to contemporary lifestyles.

Helvetia is a thoughtfully designed residential development set in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, offering a refined approach to modern urban living. The architecture emphasizes clean lines, open-plan layouts, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that fill each home with natural light. Surrounded by landscaped greenery, the project creates a balanced environment where contemporary design meets a calm, family-friendly atmosphere, with residences crafted to deliver both functionality and understated elegance.

The Waterway by Prestige One Developments is a refined waterfront residential address in Meydan, created to offer a lifestyle shaped by elegance, openness, and exceptional views. Positioned in one of Dubai’s most promising residential settings, the project is designed to immerse residents in a scenic environment framed by water, greenery, and the city’s iconic skyline. With panoramic outlooks over the Crystal Lagoon, Water Canal, Flamingo Sanctuary, Dubai Creek, Burj Khalifa, and the wider Dubai skyline, The Waterway delivers a living experience that feels both tranquil and deeply connected to the energy of the city.

Urban Life is an exquisite residential masterpiece. This contemporary development offers a collection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully designed to blend comfort with elegance. With its sleek and stylish interiors, panoramic views of the iconic Dubai Skyline, and a modern architectural marvel, Urban Life redefines city living with sophistication and urban charm.

Habtoor Grand Residences is a luxury high-rise tower set within the Habtoor Grand resort on Jumeirah Beach, rising from a ground floor to forty-nine residential floors. Glass facades, clean vertical lines and dynamic contours create a striking silhouette along the shoreline. The project offers two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, along with townhouses and penthouses, with most residences oriented towards the Arabian Gulf, Dubai Marina, Bluewaters and Palm Jumeirah.

Manta Bay is an exclusive waterfront residential development designed to redefine contemporary coastal living through innovative architecture and premium design. The project features a collection of thoughtfully planned residences with panoramic glazing, spacious private terraces, and open layouts that maximize natural light and create a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces. More than 80% of the development is dedicated to landscaped greenery, creating a tranquil environment where modern architecture and nature exist in perfect harmony, while every residence is designed to provide comfort, privacy, and uninterrupted views.

Icon Tower is a landmark residential development strategically positioned to contribute significant value to the growing Yas South area. The project comprises a prime residential tower offering a diverse mix of studios, 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments, designed to cater to a wide range of lifestyles and resident profiles. Its presence reinforces the district’s transformation into a vibrant waterfront destination, combining urban convenience with a strong residential identity.

Mayyas at The Bay is a contemporary residential development located on Yas Island, designed for those who value an active island lifestyle enriched by entertainment, leisure, and dining experiences. Developed by Advanced Properties, the project introduces a vibrant living environment that blends coastal energy with everyday comfort, offering residents immediate access to the island’s dynamic attractions while maintaining a sense of privacy and ease.

Fairmont Marina Residences Abu Dhabi is an exceptional branded residential development set along the calm waterfront of the Arabian Gulf, offering a lifestyle defined by prestige, elegance, and resort-style luxury. Positioned within the iconic twin-tower landmark crowned by a dramatic arch, the project reflects refined Arabian-inspired design and timeless sophistication. Each residence is thoughtfully crafted to combine spacious layouts, premium finishes, and breathtaking sea views, creating a private sanctuary in one of Abu Dhabi’s most distinguished waterfront destinations.

The Beach Residences is a harmonious blend of contemporary design and beachfront serenity. This architectural masterpiece features striking facades that frame expansive, floor-to-ceiling windows, inviting the warmth and glow of natural light into every corner of your home. Offering a refined collection of residences, the development presents not just a home but also a promising investment opportunity in an area witnessing significant growth and development.

JW Marriott Residences on Al Marjan Island by Marriott International offer a refined residential experience where luxury hospitality meets coastal living. Designed as a destination where everyday life feels like a getaway, the project is immersed in a setting of sea, sand, and open skies, creating an atmosphere defined by relaxation, elegance, and a sense of escape. The concept reflects the brand’s philosophy of warmth, comfort, and curated living, transforming each residence into more than just a home.

Empire Estates presents a sophisticated residential concept that blends elegance with modern architecture, delivering spacious apartments crafted with meticulous planning. The development’s creator remains undisclosed, yet the design showcases a grand reception area, intelligent elevators, and a meticulously styled lobby that greets residents with immediate refinement. Each tower’s silhouette is defined by clean lines and a contemporary façade that signals a premium urban lifestyle.

Armani Beach Residences by Arada brings together two renowned creative names on a single residential project, with architecture by Tadao Ando and interiors by Armani/Casa. Designed to achieve harmony between architecture, the surrounding seascape and the senses, the building blends traditional Japanese sensibility with contemporary minimalism. It rises above two basement parking levels and a ground floor to nine residential floors and a roof, offering two- to five-bedroom residences, spectacular penthouses and two-level Presidential Suites.

Iconic Tower by Mered is a landmark residential development that embodies contemporary luxury, architectural excellence, and timeless Italian design. Created in collaboration with the world-renowned design house Pininfarina, the project presents an exclusive collection of sophisticated residences where innovation, elegance, and functionality come together in perfect harmony. Every aspect of the tower has been thoughtfully designed to maximize natural light, spaciousness, and refined aesthetics, creating an elevated living experience that reflects the highest standards of modern urban living.

LIV Waterside is an exclusive gated waterfront community by LIV Developers offering a diverse collection of residences, including one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, duplex residences, penthouses, townhouses, luxury villas, and mansions. Designed to create a seamless connection between contemporary architecture and waterfront living, the project emphasizes spacious layouts, natural light, and refined modern design.

Royal Park - The Majesty of Living is a residential community developed by Reportage Properties consisting of 6 buildings. The community includes apartments with 1-4 bedrooms, three-storey townhouses, and duplex penthouses. The architectural design blends timeless elegance with modern elements. Residents can expect panoramic city views from their residences.

The Rings is an ultra-luxury waterfront development by PMR Property, designed by the world-renowned architects Foster + Partners, setting a new benchmark for exclusive living along the Dubai Water Canal. Comprising two architecturally striking buildings, the project features an exceptional collection of expansive duplex and triplex residences designed as private mansions. Floor-to-ceiling glazing, dramatic double-height living spaces, and breathtaking views of the Dubai Water Canal and the iconic Burj Khalifa create a residential experience defined by elegance, privacy, and timeless sophistication.

Quattro Del Mar is an architecturally stunning development that stands as a testament to minimalist elegance. Featuring four interconnected towers with unique façades that mirror the sparkling waters of the Arabian Gulf, this visionary project offers a collection of chic one-bedroom apartments to opulent three-bedroom duplexes. The iconic Sky Bridge connects the towers, weaving together lush gardens and dynamic social spaces to create a sky-high community, while the elegant Champagne cladding and glass mirror the lagoon's tranquility and captivating sunsets.

projects.n: W Hotels and Residences Al Marjan
projects.ov: ​​W Al Marjan The Residences is the new address of beachfront luxury. Located alongside W Hotel, this project offers direct beach access, remarkable design, and uninterrupted views of the Wynn Resort, all wrapped in the signature energy and elevated branding of W. Every residence comes fully furnished to exacting standards of W, with quality guaranteed by Marriott. The project sits on a front-row waterfront plot with clear views toward the upcoming Wynn Resort, creating powerful long-term value and premium rental potential. Situated on prime beachfront overlooking the Arabian Gulf, the Residences are  exclusive to only 200 Residences.

The Beach House is an exclusive collection of residences situated in the most prime beachfront location. Featuring a curated selection of studios, simplex, and duplex apartments, this landmark development models the luxury of simplicity and convenience. Exceptional living spaces with striking full-height floor-to-ceiling windows frame panoramic beach views, creating an urban oasis of luxury where residents can enjoy the perfect retreat for mind, body, and soul.

Vista del Mar is an exclusive waterfront residential development offering a refined collection of apartments and villas designed to embrace the beauty of coastal living. Comprising just 90 residences, the project features elegant one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside spacious three- and four-bedroom villas, all thoughtfully positioned to capture spectacular views of the waterfront, lush mangroves, the iconic Ferrari World, and the nearby shoreline. Contemporary architecture, clean lines, and expansive glazing create bright, sophisticated living spaces that blend seamlessly with the surrounding natural landscape.

Vela Viento by Omniyat is a landmark residential development that redefines contemporary luxury living in Dubai. Designed by the globally renowned Foster + Partners, the tower is characterized by fluid horizontal lines and elegant curves that create a dynamic architectural rhythm. Interiors are crafted by the Parisian design studio Gilles & Boissier, bringing a refined balance of modern sophistication and timeless elegance. The project features an exclusive collection of two- to four-bedroom residences and signature penthouses, many with double-height spaces and private terrace pools, emphasizing seamless indoor-outdoor living.

Dusit Princess Rijas is a contemporary hospitality project that reflects a modern approach to comfortable and efficient living. The development offers stylish studios and apartments with open-plan layouts, large windows, and private balconies or spacious terraces, creating bright and airy interiors. Inspired by Thai resort aesthetics, the architecture combines natural wood elements, soft tones, and warm lighting to deliver a calm and inviting atmosphere designed for both short and extended stays.

Moonstone Interiors by Missoni emerges as an extraordinary residential masterpiece on Al Marjan Island, offering a refined collection of 225 residences ranging from one to four-bedroom apartments and luxury villas, all inspired by the organic beauty of coral formations. This exceptional development derives its name and architectural identity from the Moonstone coral, with a distinctive M-shaped design that maximizes breathtaking sea views from every residence.

Aras Heights by Aras Group is a contemporary residential building that combines modern architecture with advanced home technology. Laconic forms and strict geometric lines define the facades, while the building rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to nine residential floors and a rooftop with a swimming pool and relaxation areas. The collection offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with carefully planned layouts that enhance everyday convenience and comfort.

Izzzi.LifeMINT is a boutique residential investment project designed to combine stable income generation with fully managed convenience. Positioned as an opportunity for investors, the development offers fully furnished apartments within a low-rise building format, tailored to deliver consistent rental returns. With a holiday homes license and professional management by IZZZI, the project is structured to maximize efficiency while minimizing the typical complexities associated with property ownership.

48 Parkside, developed by Tabeer Developments, is a masterfully crafted residential development that epitomizes the perfect blend of luxury and comfort. This extraordinary development boasts a collection of meticulously designed one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, each offering breathtaking views of a lush adjacent park and a serene rooftop garden, creating a tranquil urban oasis. Tabeer Developments has outdone itself in translating dreams into architectural masterpieces that redefine the standards of luxury real estate development.

310 Riverside Crescent is a residential masterpiece that redefines luxury living, nestled within a stunning eight million square feet development, adorned with a breathtaking beach and blue lagoon, expansive open spaces, and lush landscapes. The residences are draped around the beautiful lagoons, offering a serene and tranquil atmosphere, where nature and luxury blend in perfect harmony. Every day is an incredible experience filled with serenity and beauty, as residents can stroll down the boardwalk, taking in the glistening lagoon on one side and the city skyline on the other, creating a truly magical experience.

Oak Yard is a visionary residential project by Yard, designed to transform the city into a thriving garden and create a more natural, comfortable, and harmonious place to call home. This development embodies the philosophy of seamlessly blending the tranquility and natural beauty of a yard with the urban landscape, addressing the scarcity of green space in Dubai. Featuring spacious homes with maximum-sized kitchens and living rooms, each residence includes terraces that connect residents to the outdoors, master bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and private bathrooms, and strict delineation of public and private areas for uncompromised privacy.

Crystal Residences is an elegant residential development by Eagle Hills. This twelve-storey tower offers a collection of opulent waterfront units, including one to four-bedroom apartments, three to four-bedroom townhouses, and four-bedroom duplexes, all crafted with the sole purpose of providing the finest living experience. The building's architecture has been meticulously designed to provide natural shading for outdoor areas year-round, blending elegance and comfort with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf.

The 350 Riverside Crescent is a masterpiece of luxury, nestled within a breathtaking development that spans eight million square feet, featuring serene waterfronts, tranquil lagoons, and a profound connection with nature. This remarkable enclave boasts open spaces and lush landscaping that invite residents into a world of natural splendor, redefining the concept of luxury living. Every detail of the tower, from its meticulously designed apartments to its lavish surroundings, exudes opulence and refinement, creating a world of absolute luxury and comfort.

340 Riverside Crescent is a spectacular tower nestled within Sobha Hartland II, encompassing a rich sense of community and superlative waterfront living in one of the city's most sought-after locations. This exquisite development offers elegant-styled abodes expertly crafted to create a sense of relaxed wellbeing amid lavish surrounds for everlasting luxury. With a collection of residences that mirror the soul, 340 Riverside Crescent is a depiction of true vibrancy, close to the pulsating heart of Dubai, offering a front-row seat to outstanding waterfront living.

projects.d: Khamas Group of Investment Companies and Kappa Acca Real Estate Development
projects.ov: Marriott Residences by Khamas Group is a contemporary residential development located in Jumeirah Village Circle, offering a refined blend of branded living and modern design. The building is thoughtfully structured with a ground level, multi-level podium, and residential floors above, creating a well-balanced architectural composition. Clean lines, functional layouts, and a focus on comfort define the project, with a selection of studios and one-bedroom apartments designed to maximize space, light, and everyday practicality within a premium urban setting.

Cape Hayat is a luxurious waterfront development located on Hayat Island, offering a refined coastal lifestyle surrounded by panoramic views of the ocean and mangroves. The project captures the essence of a serene seaside retreat, where architecture and nature exist in perfect harmony. From tranquil surroundings to thoughtfully designed residences, every detail is created to enhance everyday living and deliver a sense of calm, beauty, and exclusivity.

MJL Elara by Meraas is a premium residential development designed around family living, with a strong focus on spaciousness, comfort, and privacy. The development offers a higher proportion of 2- and 3-bedroom residences, complemented by contemporary architecture and thoughtfully planned layouts that maximise views in all directions. Controlled access and direct entry to each building from the shared basement and main lobby provide residents with added convenience and security.

Zuha Island is a world-class boutique retreat offering a collection of just thirty limited-edition exclusive private residences. Set on an island spanning generous grounds with pristine beachfront encircling rich greenery, this extraordinary development provides residents with generous plots, breathtaking city skyline views, and the utmost level of privacy. Each palatial villa reflects the rhythm of the waves and embraces the natural beauty of the island, creating a symphony as unique as its owner.

Sun Island Villas, the distinguished offering of Ajmal Makan, delivers a curated collection of four to seven‑bedroom waterfront residences within Sharjah Waterfront City. The development comprises three hundred twenty‑one exclusive villas, each crafted with contemporary amenities and forward‑looking technologies that integrate smart systems and artificial intelligence. Architectural intent blends striking aesthetics with intelligent design, ensuring each home maximises comfort, well‑being and future‑ready living.

The Haven is a beautifully conceived residential development of twin towers, joined together by a welcoming community centre and a grand entrance lobby. Every detail has been meticulously designed to engage the five senses, following biophilic design principles that nurture a natural connection to greenery, daylight and well-being. The development offers 322 residential units, ranging from cosy studios to spacious three-bedroom apartments, making it an inspired choice for anyone seeking a luxurious and healthy lifestyle.

Blue Bay Walk comprises six residential and commercial towers that host a collection of studio, one‑bedroom and two‑bedroom apartments crafted for refined coastal living. An elegant platform unites paired towers, providing ample parking beneath and a soaring service deck that cradles swimming pools, a children’s play zone, a spa, and inviting seating alcoves with uninterrupted beach vistas. The development integrates a seamless blend of residential units with boutique retail and dining outlets, establishing a self‑contained community that radiates warmth and sophistication.

Oasis Two is a unique residential project that truly feels like a place you can call home. The development offers modern, well-lit duplex apartments with a contemporary exterior look and thoughtfully designed interiors that reflect forward-thinking, sustainable living. Residents can choose from a generous mix of one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-bedroom apartments, each crafted to deliver a perfect blend of comfort, style and everyday functionality.

Samana Golf Views by Samana Developers is an epitome of sophistication, designed for those who seek the very exclusive in everyday living with its refined charm and unrivaled amenities. This exclusive property boasts stunning architectural features and spacious layouts that exude elegance through top-of-the-line finishes and exceptional attention to detail. Every aspect has been meticulously crafted to set a new standard for luxury living, where sophistication meets the greens and residents can elevate their lives to new heights of opulence.

Marina Arcade is a 47-story contemporary residential tower in Dubai, strategically positioned between Dubai Marina and Dubai Media City. The building offers convenient access to public transport, including the Dubai Tram and Metro. The location provides a desirable urban living experience with a sense of privacy, situated away from the intensity of the Marina District. Residence formats available include loft apartments on floors 2 & 3, signature sky homes, penthouses, and triplex sky villas.

Aysha Residences is a refined waterfront development set within the prestigious Maryam Island masterplan, offering a seamless blend of coastal living and contemporary design. Positioned along the Al Khan Lagoon and directly connected to the promenade and beachfront, the six-storey building presents a collection of 137 residences, from studios to spacious three-bedroom apartments. The architecture draws inspiration from regional traditions, expressed through a calm palette of beige and brown tones, textured façades, and clean modern lines, creating a timeless and elegant presence by the water.

Serenia Living is a premium beachfront residential development by Palma Holding, located at the prestigious West Crescent of Palm Jumeirah рядом с Atlantis The Palm. The project offers a refined collection of residences designed to deliver panoramic views of the sea, Palm Island, and Dubai skyline. Its modern architecture and meticulously curated interiors reflect a high level of sophistication, creating a seamless blend of luxury, privacy, and coastal living.

The 320 Riverside Crescent is a breathtaking residential masterpiece that redefines the epitome of sublime living, boasting an impressive presence with its fifty-seven stories of elegance and sophistication. This captivating development harmoniously integrates the elements of water and people, creating a unique way of life that is infused with enchantment and fulfillment.

Janayen Avenue is a contemporary residential development within the prestigious Mirdif Hills community, developed by Dubai Investments. The project offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious 3 and 4-bedroom duplexes, all designed to provide a balanced lifestyle in a serene and well-planned environment. The architecture reflects a modern aesthetic, complemented by thoughtfully designed spaces that combine comfort, functionality, and a strong sense of community.

Raffles Residences and Penthouses at The Palm Dubai is an ultra-exclusive address that brings together the legacy of Raffles Hotels & Resorts with one of the city’s most prestigious waterfront locations. Set on Palm Jumeirah, the development presents a limited collection of grand residences, penthouses, and villas defined by expansive layouts and a stately architectural presence. The design reflects timeless elegance, combining refined proportions, panoramic terraces, and a seamless connection to the surrounding sea, creating homes that embody both privacy and grandeur.

LIV Marina is a contemporary waterfront residential tower by LIV Developers offering a collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive penthouses. Rising 44 storeys, the project is designed to maximize natural light, open space, and panoramic views through expansive floor-to-ceiling windows and thoughtfully planned layouts. The architecture and interiors reflect a modern luxury aesthetic, while the residences feature open-plan living areas, generous ceiling heights, and carefully curated design details that create an elegant and comfortable living environment.

Me Do Re is a premium residential development that brings together smart technology, contemporary architecture, and refined design in the heart of Jumeirah Lakes Towers. Overlooking the tranquil community lake, the tower offers a collection of elegantly designed residences that maximize natural light, open space, and panoramic waterfront views. Combining sophisticated aesthetics with intelligent living solutions, Me Do Re creates a modern urban sanctuary where luxury and everyday convenience exist in perfect harmony.

Rukan Tower is a contemporary residential development in Dubai, distinguished by its unique architectural identity that blends modern design with subtle Eastern influences. Set within a dynamic urban environment, the building stands out with its elegant façade of glass, clean lines, and soft curves, creating a visually striking presence while maintaining a sense of harmony and balance.

Vienna House Residences by Wyndham is a fully furnished, hospitality-branded residential development that defines a serviced island lifestyle aligned with contemporary living and long-term value. This exceptional project offers a range of studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and penthouse residences, each crafted to provide the perfect blend of comfort and sophistication. As one of the few hospitality-branded residences permitting short-term rentals, this development represents a unique opportunity for both lifestyle buyers and investors seeking higher yields and growing demand.

Verde Villas is a collection of four-bedroom garden villas by Ajmal Makan on Al Thuraya Island, part of the developer's Sharjah Waterfront City master development. Positioned on the garden side of the island, in the second row behind the beachfront homes, the villas are set among landscaped green spaces and calm lakes, with the island beach within easy reach. The concept pairs contemporary architecture with the natural setting, offering spacious layouts on private plots designed for families seeking a quieter, nature-focused island lifestyle.

Shahrukhz Residences is a waterfront residential tower inspired by Shah Rukh Khan and built around the idea of living life king style. A sculpted façade with flowing curves and warm metallic accents rises above the sea, while every level is oriented towards open water and the city skyline. The collection spans studios and flexible studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, King's layouts with signature dressing areas, and a separate wing of Ocean Residences with larger suites set closer to the water.

Sawa Residences is a striking residential tower where every decision has been shaped around the way people genuinely want to live. The collection spans compact one-bedroom homes, full one-bedroom residences, and generously proportioned two- and three-bedroom apartments, so there is a home here for almost everyone. Rising above a beautifully sculpted podium across twenty residential levels, served by five lifts and two separate entrances, the building feels both effortless and impressively well planned.

Riviera Residences 2 by Mered is an exceptional waterfront development inspired by the timeless elegance of the Mediterranean Riviera, combining striking architecture with a refined coastal lifestyle. The project offers a selection of 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, bay villas, duplexes, sky villas and an exclusive penthouse, creating a diverse collection of elegant homes.

projects.n: The Residences at Sheraton Al Marjan Island Resort
projects.ov: The Residences at Sheraton Al Marjan Island Resort exemplifies the essence of refined elegance and a bold vision of coastal luxury living, where architecture, design, and atmosphere blend in perfect harmony to create a sense of space filled with ease, beauty, and the privilege of belonging to an exclusive community. This exquisite development offers more than just residences, presenting a new paradigm of living where every detail is meticulously crafted to deliver a sense of comfort, luxury, and serenity.

The Canopies Sanctuary is a residential neighbourhood by Aldar, set among landscaped parklands and planned around architecture and nature sharing the same space. Mid-rise buildings with curved, arched balconies frame a landscaped podium, while sculptural canopy structures shade garden paths, seating areas and outdoor spaces meant for everyday use. The residences include studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, and three-bedroom apartments with a maid's room and a study. Gardens form the centre of the community, with dedicated places to exercise, work and meet neighbours.

JOUD Residence by One Development is a striking AI-integrated residential tower that redefines modern urban living with a refined and forward-thinking approach. The project features 289 contemporary units, offering a wide selection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully designed to suit different lifestyles. Positioned as a highly sophisticated development, it seamlessly blends intelligent living concepts with elegant design, creating a truly elevated residential experience.

Aram Tower by Urban Capital Development is an elegant mixed-use residential project featuring a refined collection of 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious 3-bedroom duplexes. The development also includes dedicated office and retail spaces, creating a well-balanced environment that combines modern living with everyday convenience.

Address Branded Residences is a waterfront residential tower developed by ALAIN in partnership with Address Hotels + Resorts, bringing the brand's hospitality expertise to residential living. The slender tower is designed by the architecture studio Design Tomorrow, with a sculpted facade of curved balconies and floor-to-ceiling glazing that opens the homes to views of the city skyline and the water. The residences comprise one- to four-bedroom apartments and penthouses, planned to make the most of every space and suit different lifestyles.

Omoria Private Residences is an ultra-luxury boutique coastal development that introduces a new standard of refined living, combining world-class hospitality with private residential comfort. Developed by Innovate Living, the project represents a unique concept of curated lifestyle, where every detail is designed to deliver exclusivity, privacy, and sophistication. The development offers a limited collection of bespoke residences, including 1 to 4-bedroom suites, expansive duplexes, and a signature penthouse, all complemented by generous layouts and panoramic sea views that create a serene, resort-like atmosphere.

Casa Aura Residence is a contemporary low-rise development located in Dubai South, offering a refined collection of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Designed to balance elegance and functionality, the project combines modern architecture with spacious layouts, open-plan living, and expansive balconies, creating a comfortable and harmonious environment for everyday life.

Creek View by Iraz Properties is a contemporary waterfront development in Al Jaddaf, designed to combine modern architecture with a calm, urban lifestyle. The mid-rise structure features a well-balanced composition of clean lines, glass elements, and functional design, rising across multiple residential levels above dedicated parking and a ground-floor entrance. A curated selection of studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive penthouses, is thoughtfully planned to maximize space, natural light, and panoramic canal views, creating a refined and comfortable living environment.

Vedaire Residences by Elton is a boutique residential development set in the heart of Meydan, offering a refined collection of homes that blend contemporary elegance with timeless architectural character. Positioned on a prominent corner plot, the building is designed to capture panoramic views of Burj Khalifa and surrounding green landscapes. Clean lines, balanced proportions, and expansive glazing define the architecture, while interiors are thoughtfully planned with open layouts, natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow, creating a calm and sophisticated living environment.

Velor is a statement of refined urban living, positioned among globally recognized landmarks and designed to offer a lifestyle defined by elegance, exclusivity, and attention to detail. The development presents a seamless fusion of architecture and experience, where every element — from spatial design to everyday interactions — is carefully curated to create a sense of sophistication and ease.

Four Seasons Private Residences DIFC is a visionary residential project in the one of the city's most prestigious lifestyle and business destinations. Comprising four aligned towers rising above Gate Avenue, this development features a limited collection of fifty-nine exceptional homes, including two exclusive penthouses. Designed by acclaimed Pritzker Prize-winning architect Sir David Chipperfield, the property presents a striking composition of non-parallel façades that reveal a gentler, curved internal façade embracing an immersive courtyard garden.

Dolce Residences by Wyndham presents a curated mix of studios, one‑, two‑ and three‑bedroom homes together with thoughtfully designed retail spaces. The architecture is defined by fluid silhouettes, expansive glass façades and cascading terraces that grant each dwelling a striking presence on the horizon. A singular design approach maximises sea‑view orientation while delivering a sleek, contemporary silhouette.

Marquis Aura by Marquis is an exceptional residential and retail development that combines modern luxury with elegant architecture and thoughtful design. The project offers a stunning collection of 220 residences, including studios, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, 2-bedroom apartments with maid's rooms, and exclusive 3-bedroom apartments, alongside retail spaces that add convenience to everyday living.
